jobs.description:
Overview

Do you want to build an impactful career to change the world for the better?

Geosyntec has an exciting opportunity for a Mid-Career Water Resources Engineer. You will have the opportunity to work fully remote from your home-office in Altoona, PA and join our growing practice supporting our Blue Bell, PA operations. The position will directly support and lead the expansion of our hydraulic engineering capabilities in the dams and levees market, leveraging existing staff resources, and collaborating with other senior dam and levee practitioners across the firm. Projects span hydraulic modeling of various complexities; hydraulic structure evaluation and design (e.g. spillways); supporting probabilistic risk analysis; hydraulic and hydrologic modeling for large riverine systems; flood modeling; and dam breach consequence assessment studies.

Geosyntec is an innovative, international engineering and consulting firm serving private and public-sector clients to address new ventures and complex problems involving our environment, natural resources, and civil infrastructure. Our engineers, scientists, technical and project employees serve our clients from offices across the world. Ranked by ENR as one of the top environmental engineering design firms, Geosyntec is internationally known for its technical leadership, broad experience, and exceptional client service.

We invest in our people. Each employee is unique, and your career at Geosyntec will be too. We offer competitive pay and benefits and well-being programs to support you and your family.

To Learn More Visit:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to expand the hydraulic engineering practice within Geosyntec’s Dams and Levees business line.
  • Work on rehabilitation and design of existing and new spillways, outlet works, and other appurtenant dam and levee hydraulic structures.
  • Downstream hazard assessment and dam breach modeling for inundation mapping and support of direct and indirect economic consequence estimation.
  • Inspections of existing hydraulic structures and dam safety review of previous analyses and studies against the current state of the practice and design criteria.
  • Flood hazard studies, reservoir routing and stage-discharge frequency analyses in support of semi-quantitative and fully quantitative risk assessments;
  • Interacting with client representatives;
  • Task and project-level responsibility for scoping, performing, managing, and delivering multiple concurrent project assignments;
  • Consistent with our sell-manage-do business model, play a role in lead generation, business development, staff development, and mentoring;
  • Help broaden our reputation and visibility via publishing and presenting at prominent industry conferences such as US Society on Dams, Association of State Dam Safety.
  • Task and project management, including planning and directing staff, budgeting and budget management, adherence to schedule, quality, client satisfaction, and profitability;
  • Recruiting, supervising, and mentoring junior staff; and
  • Preparing technical reports, letters, memoranda, plans, specifications, presentations, and proposals.

Education and Licensure

  • Bachelor's degree in science field, preferably biological sciences, engineering or related field. (required)
  • Advanced degree (e.g., M.S. or Ph.D.) in epidemiology or related field. (preferred)

Skills, Experience and Qualifications

  • At least 5 years (7+ preferred) of related experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience. (required)
  • Experience with multi-disciplinary project teams. (required)
  • Experience with project management and business development. (preferred)
  • Excellent leadership and detail oriented. (required)
  • Experience performing hydrologic studies for dams and specific experience performing probabilistic flood hazard analyses. (preferred)
  • Experience with modeling tools such as platforms like HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS (1-D and 2-D), or similar (required). CFD or other 3-D models (preferred). HEC-LifeSim, HEC-FIA, DAMRAE or similar. (preferred)
  • Team player who enjoys networking, exceptional oral and written communication skills. (required)
  • Ability and willingness to perform fieldwork and travel for site visits, inspections, and other business-related meetings or conferences. (required)
  • Regular field work and overnight travel. (required)
  • Current OSHA 40-hr HAZWOPER training and refreshers. (preferred)
  • Health & Safety training, medical monitoring, and client-driven drug and background testing may be required.
  • Valid U.S. driver’s license and a satisfactory driving record for business travel. (required)

About Hercules

Hercules (hercules.app) is an AI app builder — like Lovable, Replit, or Base44. We have 300k+ users and receive ~250 support tickets a day, and that number is growing fast.

About the role

We're looking for a technical support and operations lead to run our support team. You'll own the customer support experience end to end, and build the AI automations that let a small team handle a huge and growing ticket volume.

What you'll do

  • Resolve tier 1 tickets (general platform Q&A)

  • Resolve tier 2 tickets (billing and admin operations)

  • Manage engineers to resolve tier 3 tickets

  • Maintain our knowledge bases

  • Build and maintain AI automations to automatically resolve tickets at 10x scale

  • Build and maintain AI automations that summarize voice of customer and product feedback for the whole company

What we're looking for

  • Excellent communication (we have a very high bar)

  • Able to close ~150 tickets per day (with heavy AI help)

  • Prior experience in a customer support role

  • Experience building and maintaining knowledge bases and SOPs

  • Extensive Stripe experience (refunds, chargebacks, credit notes)

  • Experience building AI automations

  • Experience managing a support team

  • Able to work one weekend a month

Nice to have

  • Some coding experience (or vibe coding)

  • Very fast typist (or uses an AI dictation tool like Wispr Flow)

What are Hercules' operating principles?

Hercules' operating principles guide how we make decisions every day. We take them very seriously. Most of them are choices that we as a company uniquely prioritize, and so can be learned on the job. However, we do specifically filter for these principles in our hiring process:

  • We move with urgency. We ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly. Our bias for action speeds our learning and delights our customers.

  • We strive for excellence. Doing things well is in our DNA. We have good taste. We get the details right. Our outputs are exceptionally simple and self-serve. We're proud of our work.

  • We are hungry. We are willing to work hard and break through walls to achieve the outcomes we want. We are willing to operate at any level to get things done. We are politely relentless.

Is Hercules in-office or remote?

Hercules' founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates in US time zones who would be willing/able to travel to the office regularly.

What are Hercules' benefits?

  • Healthcare, vision, and dental

  • Use whatever AI productivity tools you'd like

  • Take what you need vacation policy

  • Daily lunches, dinners, and snacks in the office

  • We guarantee you will do the best work of your career here

What's the compensation?

$100k-$250k + equity (depends on seniority, experience, and location)

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

We are looking for a 3D Animator to lead the creation of high-quality 3D animations, visual storytelling, and motion content across BJAK’s marketing, product, and brand initiatives.

In this role, you will bring concepts to life through compelling animation, character performance, camera work, environmental storytelling, and cinematic visuals. You will work closely with creative, marketing, and product teams to create engaging content that elevates the BJAK brand while mentoring junior artists and helping define animation standards across the organization.

3D Animation & Creative Execution

  • Create high-quality 3D animations for marketing campaigns, product showcases, social media content, and brand storytelling.

  • Develop engaging character, object, and environmental animations that communicate ideas effectively.

  • Translate storyboards and creative concepts into polished 3D animated content.

  • Produce cinematic camera movements, transitions, and visual sequences that enhance audience engagement.

  • Ensure consistency in animation quality, visual style, and brand identity across all deliverables.

Creative Direction & Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with Creative, Marketing, Product, and Content teams to develop compelling visual narratives.

  • Contribute to concept development, storyboarding, and creative ideation sessions.

  • Mentor and provide guidance to junior animators and designers.

  • Work alongside motion designers, video editors, illustrators, and creative producers to deliver cohesive multimedia campaigns.

  • Develop reusable animation assets, templates, and production standards.

  • Strong experience with lighting, rendering, compositing, and animation pipelines.

  • Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, and related creative tools.

  • Strong understanding of animation principles, timing, weight, movement, and storytelling.

  • Experience creating high-quality character, product, or environment animations.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and creative problem-solving skills.

  • A strong portfolio or showreel demonstrating advanced 3D animation work is required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Unreal Engine, Houdini, or real-time rendering workflows.

  • Knowledge of character rigging, simulations, dynamics, and visual effects.

  • Experience integrating AI-assisted creative tools into animation workflows.

  • Background in advertising, digital products, technology, fintech, or startup environments.

Location

jobs.excerpt: WHO WE ARE: MagicSchool is the premier generative AI platform for teachers.
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE: MagicSchool is the premier generative AI platform for teachers. We're just over 2 years old, and more than 7 million teachers from all over the world have joined our platform. Join a top team at a fast growing company that is working towards real social impact. Make an account and try us out at our website and connect with our passionate community on our Wall of Love.

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, Mid-Market - Texas, you will lead critical partnerships across midsized school districts in the state to ensure our tools reduce teacher burnout and accelerate student learning at scale. As a Texas market expert and commercial lead, this consultative position involves managing a multimillion-dollar book of business. Key responsibilities include driving customer adoption and leading renewal efforts within the unique Texas educational landscape.

You will oversee complex onboarding and renewal processes, coach teachers and administrators through change, and design interventions that boost adoption.

This role is regional, meaning you should live in Texas and/or bring extensive experience in Texas EdTech (understanding TEA/SBOE dynamics) to be considered for this role.

Responsibilities

In this role, you will own a portfolio of school and district relationships and be responsible for driving the following measurable outcomes:

  • Portfolio Growth and Retention: You will manage a portfolio of approximately 50-75 mid-market districts while maintaining a Net Revenue Retention (NRR) rate above target through strategic price increases and seat expansion.

  • Product Adoption: You will drive active usage across your districts by delivering high-impact training and implementation strategies and creating compelling support materials, such as tutorials and one-pagers, that ensure implementation is scalable and our tools become essential to daily teacher workflows.

  • Churn Mitigation: You will identify at-risk accounts and execute intervention playbooks to maintain a gross churn rate below company thresholds, specifically focusing on a 90 day action plan for high-stakes renewals.

  • Multi-Stakeholder Discovery and Solutioning: You will run structured discovery across district roles and map MagicSchool solutions to each persona's priorities to drive multi-threaded engagement.

  • Strategic Relationship Management: You will build deep trust with district executive leadership, managing accounts through data-driven storytelling and consultative selling.

  • Leadership and Mentorship: You will scale our collective impact by contributing high level insights to the Customer Success playbook, driving cross functional strategy in leadership meetings, and mentoring junior team members to elevate the entire regional organization.

  • Key Metrics of Success

    • Revenue Retention (GRR, NRR)

    • Churn Rate

    • Pilot conversion

    • Expansion Growth

    • Operational Excellence

Qualifications/Competencies/Skills

To be successful in this role, you’ll bring the following skills and competencies:

  • Ownership Mentality: You take full responsibility for your portfolio, working with a high degree of urgency and a bias toward action.

  • Commercial Fluency: You are comfortable leading complex financial negotiations, including discussing contraction risks, pricing adjustments, and expansion opportunities.

  • Texas K-12 Expertise: You possess a deep understanding of the Texas educational landscape.

  • Relationship-Driven: You build deep trust with teachers and district leaders alike.

  • Team Selling Approach: You operate as the "CEO of your accounts," proactively identifying internal resources and mobilizing cross-functional partners to deliver without waiting to be asked.

  • Consultative Discovery and Multi-Stakeholder Management: You run structured discovery across senior district roles (Director of Technology, C&I, ELL, cabinet), translate what you learn into prescriptive, persona-aligned recommendations, and guide district leaders toward the right solution rather than reacting to requests.

  • Book Segmentation & Prioritization: Independently segment your book by ARR, strategic influence, and use case potential to focus time where it drives the most impact.

  • Executive Communication: You are concise, credible, and compelling with senior district leaders. You inspire confidence through clarity.

Experience

Required

  • 3 - 7 years of experience as an individual contributor managing mid-market or enterprise accounts in a SaaS environment, ideally in EdTech

  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding NRR and GRR targets

  • Direct experience leading commercial conversations across renewals, expansion, and pricing

  • Comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder organizations and building relationships at the executive level.

  • Technically proficient in Salesforce or a comparable CRM.

  • Willingness to travel within the state as needed to support district relationships (30%).

Preferred

  • Background in education as a former teacher, coach, or school administrator, a plus

Why Join Us?

  • Work on cutting-edge AI technology that directly impacts educators and students.

  • Join a mission-driven team passionate about making education more efficient and equitable.

  • Flexibility of working from home, while fostering a unique culture built on relationships, trust, communication, and collaboration with our team - no matter where they live.

For full time employees:

  • Unlimited time off to empower our employees to manage their work-life balance. We work hard for our teachers and users, and encourage our employees to rest and take the time they need.

  • Choice of employer-paid health insurance plans so that you can take care of yourself and your family. Dental and vision are also offered at very low premiums.

  • Every employee is offered generous stock options, vested over 4 years.

  • 401k match & monthly wellness stipend.

Our Values:

  • Educators are Magic: Educators are the most important ingredient in the educational process - they are the magic, not the AI. Trust them, empower them, and put them at the center of leading change in service of students and families.

  • Joy and Magic: Bring joy and magic into every learning experience - push the boundaries of what’s possible with AI.

  • Community: Foster community that supports one another during a time of rapid technological change. Listen to them and serve their needs.

  • Innovation: The education system is outdated and in need of innovation and change - AI is an opportunity to bring equity, access, and serve the individual needs of students better than we ever have before.

  • Responsibility: Put responsibility and safety at the forefront of the technological change that AI is bringing to education.

  • Diversity: Diversity of thought, perspectives, and backgrounds helps us serve the wide audience of educators and students around the world.

  • Excellence: Educators and students deserve the best - and we strive for the highest quality in everything we do.

Compensation Range: $104K - $120K

In this position, you’ll act as a client-facing learning consultant who partners closely with subject-matter specialists to design, develop, and facilitate in-person, virtual, and hybrid courses and labs for highly technical and regulated environments. You may also develop job aids, infographics, and short videos to supplement live training. You’ll apply your expertise in how people learn to create solutions that enable your audiences to continuously develop their skills and perform confidently on the job. Your work will target two primary learner audiences: 1) S&L personnel within NPG engineering and design disciplines and 2) S&L’s external clients within the nuclear industry.

Typical Activities Include

  • ILT Design and Development:

  • Designing evaluation plans and measures to assess training effectiveness.

Overview

The 340B Pharmacy Claims Reviewer performs scheduled reviews of prescription claims and supporting documentation to verify 340B eligibility, identify potential diversion or duplicate discounts, and support accurate claim qualification. The role documents and reconciles findings, monitors trends, and collaborates with the assigned 340B Account Specialist and other internal stakeholders to strengthen compliance, data integrity, and realized program savings.

Pay Range: $27.00 to $30.00 per hour.

About VytlOne

Did you know that patients see their pharmacist an average of 12 times a year? Pharmacy is at the heart of healthcare. Come join VytlOne and make a direct impact on patients’ lives. Improve your own wellbeing with our robust benefits and flexible work environment. At VytlOne, you have a career with limitless possibilities and the charge to make a difference. A company of 1,000 diverse people and almost 100 years of pharmacy experience, we offer the stability of a Fortune 500 company with the energy and innovation of a startup. We provide services and technology that fuel the entire pharmacy ecosystem, but we are more than pharmacy services. We enable pharmacy care.

Responsibilities

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS (These duties must be performed with or without reasonable accommodation. This document in no way states or implies that these are the only duties to be performed by the employee occupying this position):

  • Perform scheduled audits of prescription claims and supporting documentation in accordance with established procedures, client requirements, and service-level expectations.
  • Research and resolve reconciliation exceptions identified during monitoring and claims review; escalate unresolved or material issues as appropriate.
  • Review Medicaid claims and related indicators to identify and help prevent potential duplicate discounts.
  • Evaluate 340B patient eligibility and claim qualification, including in mixed-use settings and clinics, by reviewing patient medical records, prescription details, insurance information, provider relationships or referrals, and hospital or encounter status, as applicable to the company’s responsibilities to the client.
  • Verify that required documentation supports 340B eligibility and identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent information that affects claim qualification.
  • Accurately record audit results, reconciliation activity, supporting rationale, and follow-up actions in designated systems or tracking tools.
  • Identify recurring trends, process gaps, and potential compliance risks, and communicate findings and improvement opportunities to the assigned 340B Account Specialist and other appropriate stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify documentation, resolve claim qualification issues, and support consistent application of established 340B criteria.
  • Protect patient, prescription, and client information and follow all applicable privacy, security, and confidentiality requirements.
  • Promote and comply with the VytlOne Business Code of Conduct, Ethical Business Conduct policy, Compliance Program, and other company policies and procedures.
  • Promptly report suspected misconduct, compliance concerns, or allegations of impropriety through the appropriate reporting channels, including the Compliance Department.
  • Remain eligible to participate in federal healthcare programs and free from exclusion on the Office of Inspector General and System for Award Management exclusion lists.
  • Complete required training within established timeframes and maintain job-related knowledge through assigned education and updates.

  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

    • Qualifications

    • Associate degree in pharmacy technology, healthcare administration, business, or a related field preferred. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.
    • Active pharmacy technician certification (CPhT) preferred.
    • Two years of experience in pharmacy operations, pharmacy claims, healthcare auditing, 340B program support, or a related healthcare environment required.
    • Experience reviewing prescription claims, patient eligibility, medical records, or Medicaid billing is preferred.
    • Working knowledge of 340B Drug Pricing Program requirements, pharmacy claims processing, patient eligibility, duplicate discount prevention, diversion prevention, and audit documentation.
    • Ability to review and interpret prescription claims, medical records, insurance information, provider referrals, and related documentation accurately and consistently.
    • Strong analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills.
    • Ability to document findings, maintain accurate audit records, identify trends, and communicate deficiencies and improvement opportunities clearly.
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and the ability to learn and use 340B, pharmacy, claims, and client-specific systems.
    • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet established deadlines, protect confidential information, and work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with internal stakeholders.

    Why VytlOne?

    VytlOne offers a progressive culture that promotes teamwork and where employees are valued as the Company’s best asset. We work hard, but we make sure to have fun along the way, too. Competitive salary, plus a great benefits package are available including:

    • $850 individual, annual medical deductible
    • $25 office visit copays
    • Low biweekly premiums
    • Company paid basic life/AD&D, Short-term and Long-term disability insurance
    • Rx, dental, vision, short-term disability, and FSA
    • Employer-matched 401k Plan
    • Industry leading PTO plan
    • Professional Leadership Development.
    • Earned Wage Access.
    • And More!!

    The innovative spirit at VytlOne will transform the way you think about pharmacy & healthcare services. As we pave the way in a relentless commitment to positive health outcomes, it’s never been a better time to be part of the VytlOne team!

jobs.description:

Oath, a public benefit company, regenerates life in depleted soils globally with naturally occurring, beneficial microorganisms to address some of agriculture’s biggest challenges, including yield, nutrient density, and soil carbon. You will have access to a team of highly trained scientists, study directors, and a wide network of collaborators, enabling you to integrate and enhance your existing skill set.

Position Summary:
This role is a critical part of the Business Development team in Europe, reporting to the BD Lead Europe. The Regulatory Affairs & Field Sciences Manager Europe is responsible for achieving and maintaining regulatory Freedom To Operate (FTO) for Oath's 'Oath Soil Life' microbial soil amendments throughout Europe, as well as coordinating field trials implementation through several trialing partners across Europe.The field science focus is on ensuring the delivery of high quality trial results across a range of CROs and trialing partners, across the region. The regulatory focus is on leveraging EU member state legacy regulations and securing Mutual Recognitions across the region. The scope includes the European Union, the UK, Turkey, and the Middle East, to be addressed as required.

Responsibilities:

Regulatory (60%)

  • Develop and execute the regulatory strategy for Oath Soil Life in Europe, prioritizing the use of member state legacy processes and the Mutual Recognition (MR) directive to gain FTO
    quickly and cost-effectively.
  • Manage all aspects of the product registration process, including preparation and submission of necessary documentation to regulatory bodies, such as applications for a
    certificate of conformity in Austria (e.g., via § 9 DMG).
  • Oversee regulatory compliance for Oath Soil Life, ensuring strict adherence to all local, national, and international regulations across Europe, UK, Turkey, and the Middle East.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with regulatory agencies or coordinate with local contractors to efficiently secure approvals and maintain compliance.
  • Monitor changes in the European regulatory environment, including new regulations like EC 2019/1009, and update strategies to maintain a competitive advantage.
  • Document all regulatory submissions, official communications, and prepare detailed reports on the regulatory status and compliance efforts for internal and external
    stakeholders.
  • Provide regulatory support for business development activities and market entry initiatives in the region, particularly for countries requiring local trialing/data such as Turkey.

Field Sciences (40%)

  • Support the elaboration of the field and nursery trial programs across Europe (incl. UK) and Türkiye.
  • Oversee and track the execution of field and nursery trial programs to confirm the performance of Oath Soil Life across diverse ecological conditions.
  • Guarantee the timely submission of premium experimental data while providing technical oversight for trial quality assurance and control processes.

Competencies:

  • In-depth knowledge of European and national regulatory frameworks for abiotic agricultural inputs, especially biostimulants, soil amendments, and microbial products.
  • Proven track record in managing product registration, dossier preparation, and achieving regulatory compliance for commercial products.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the conceptualization, planning, and operational execution of regional trial programs.
  • Exceptional ability to establish project timelines and manage complex regulatory and field sciences milestones.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills for discussions with regulatory bodies, CROs and managing internal/external stakeholder relationships.
  • Ability to work effectively within a high-performing Business Development and cross-functional team.

Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5-7 years of relevant experience in Regulatory Affairs within the agricultural sector.
  • Demonstrated experience in European regulatory affairs, particularly using EU Mutual Recognition and legacy national abiotic registration processes.
  • Comprehensive grasp of the scientific protocols and prerequisites for field-based research.
  • Field trial experience highly desirable
  • Degree in Agronomy or a related field

Location:

  • Remote, preferably from Ireland or Spain, Italy, Germany
  • 80-100%

About the Role

You will be responsible for overseeing all legal and compliance aspects related to licensing, intellectual property, and content distribution for games, apps, and digital products. This role requires strong legal expertise, negotiation skills, and a deep understanding of licensing frameworks ensuring that all agreements, contracts, and content operations are compliant, secure, and aligned with business objectives. You will work closely with product, publishing, partnerships, and executive teams to support growth, protect the companys interests, and enable smooth content distribution globally.

Key Responsibilities

Legal Drafting & Contract Management

Draft, review, and negotiate license agreements, publishing agreements, distribution contracts, content-use agreements, and third-party collaborations.
Ensure contracts include clear terms on rights, obligations, payment, royalty/share models, deliverables, termination clauses, warranties, indemnities, and compliance with applicable laws.
Manage renewals, amendments, and terminations of licensing agreements.
Intellectual Property & Rights Management
Manage IP rights registration, protection (copyrights, trademarks, domain names), and enforcement.
Conduct due diligence on third-party content, assets, and collaborations to verify rights clearance and avoid infringement risks.
Monitor and respond to copyright/IP infringement claims, takedown notices, and licensing disputes.

Regulatory Compliance & Legal Risk Mitigation
Advise on and ensure compliance with relevant regulations (data privacy, consumer protection, digital content laws, age ratings, export controls, regional compliance).
Develop and maintain legal policies and documentation: EULA, Terms of Service (TOS), Privacy Policy, license usage terms, user agreements.
Conduct internal audits of licensing and content distribution practices; identify legal risks and propose mitigation strategies.

Partner & Publisher Liaison

Act as primary legal contact for external partners, publishers, distributors, licensors, and affiliates regarding licensing and content deals.
Facilitate negotiations, contract signings, renewals, and compliance checks with partners and third parties.
Support business development and partnership teams by providing legal guidance on prospective collaborations.

Cross-Functional Support & Advisory

Collaborate with product, development, finance, and management teams to align legal strategy with business objectives.
Provide legal support and guidance for monetization models, in-app purchases, licensing of IP, and content distribution strategies.
Advise on mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and licensing-related transactions including due diligence, contract structuring, and risk assessment.

Dispute Resolution & Legal Representation
Manage and resolve licensing disputes, contract breaches, IP infringement cases, and compliance issues.
Coordinate with external legal counsel as needed for litigation, arbitration, or other legal actions.
Maintain accurate records of legal cases and licensing history for audit and compliance purposes.

Policy Development & Legal Governance

Maintain up-to-date knowledge of global and regional laws relevant to gaming, software, digital content, data privacy, and licensing.
Develop internal legal frameworks, guidelines, and compliance protocols for licensing, content usage, and partnerships.
Provide training and legal awareness to internal teams on licensing obligations, compliance, and best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

Law degree (LLB / LLM) and valid license to practice law (or equivalent qualification).
Minimum 57 years of professional experience in licensing, intellectual property, media & entertainment law, or technology/software law.
Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating complex licensing, distribution, and content-use agreements.
Strong knowledge of intellectual property law, digital media law, data protection/privacy laws, and international content distribution regulations.
Excellent analytical, drafting, and negotiation skills.
Strong communication and stakeholder-management abilities, with the ability to explain complex legal matters clearly to non-legal teams.
High ethical standards, integrity, and ability to handle confidential information sensitively.
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple contracts/projects simultaneously, and meet tight deadlines.
Proactive approach to risk management, compliance, and legal governance.

Strong legal acumen and commercial awareness
Excellent negotiation and contract-drafting capability
Attention to detail, precision, and thoroughness
Effective communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with business, tech, and creative teams
High level of integrity, professionalism, and discretion
Proactive mindset: risk-aware, solution-oriented, and forward-thinking
Adaptability to evolving regulations and business models
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities

What We Offer

Senior legal role with influence over content licensing and business strategy
Opportunity to work across creative, technical, and business domains in a dynamic gaming/software company
Exposure to global licensing and distribution practices, intellectual property management, and digital content regulation

Job Summary

Program Analyst, Informatics Senior-Level, Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP)

Job Summary:

Aptive seeks a Program Analyst, Informatics Senior-Level to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) on the Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) contract. You will plan, analyze, and evaluate the effectiveness of OCI interoperability programs and operations, and turn what you find into recommendations that improve how Veteran health information is exchanged and used. The role supports the Interoperability specialty area, including Veterans Health Information Exchange (VHIE) operations, exchange partner management, and VA commitments under the Veteran Interoperability Pledge and the Elizabeth Dole Act. You will work within Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Trains alongside interoperability specialists, terminologists, and VA Business Owners.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Program Analysis and Evaluation. Plan, analyze, and evaluate the effectiveness of OCI interoperability programs and operations, such as VHIE, exchange partner management, and terminology services.
  • Data-Driven Assessment. Use source data and qualitative and quantitative methods to assess program performance, such as exchange volume and quality, ticket resolution, and partner onboarding throughput.
  • Program Status and Performance Reporting. Synthesize data into program status, performance metrics, and trends, including recurring health data exchange reports.
  • Outcome Measurement. Support VHIE evaluation and outcome-oriented measures, including progress reporting related to the Elizabeth Dole Act and the Veteran Interoperability Pledge.
  • Process Improvement Recommendations. Identify opportunities to improve business processes, such as exchange issue escalation, ticket management, and partner onboarding, and recommend changes.
  • Risk Identification and Mitigation. Identify, document, and track program risks and issues; develop and refine mitigation strategies; maintain risk registers.
  • Roadmap and Estimation Support. Support three-PI roadmap updates and document the level of effort and labor categories needed for Features selected in PI Planning.
  • Value Measurement. Help define business value measures in Epic hypothesis statements and Feature acceptance criteria, and track baselines and results across each Planning Interval (PI).
  • Agile Team Participation. Apply SAFe Lean-Agile principles as a member of agile teams; participate in PI Planning, backlog refinement, iteration ceremonies, and system demos.
  • Governance Contributions. Contribute inputs to the OIP governance charter, SAFe alignment plan, and compliance documentation.
  • Executive Communication. Prepare briefings, decision papers, and reports that convey status, recommendations, and risks to stakeholders at all levels.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in program analysis, data analysis, or informatics.
  • Relevant clinical informatics experience in a VA health care setting.
  • Demonstrated ability to plan, analyze, and evaluate operating programs using source data and qualitative and quantitative methods.
  • Experience identifying and mitigating program risks.
  • Experience with, and demonstrated understanding of, SAFe Lean-Agile principles and practices.
  • Experience presenting status, recommendations, and risks to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a VA background investigation at the level assigned to the position; must reside and work in the United States with U.S. work authorization.

Desired Qualifications

  • Degree in informatics, health care administration, public health, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree.
  • Current SAFe certification (e.g., SAFe Agilist).
  • Experience with health information exchange or interoperability programs.
  • Experience with VHIE, JLV, or Federal EHR (Oracle Health) programs.
  • Experience building performance dashboards in Power BI, Tableau, or Excel.
  • Experience with Jira or Jira Align reporting.

GCG's Custom Engineered Solutions (CES) business unit is currently seeking Customer Support Representatives to support our OEM and Industrial customers and Account Managers.

This role manages day-to-day customer orders, coordinates with internal teams on production and delivery, and proactively resolves issues to ensure an exceptional customer experience.

The ideal candidate is organized, responsive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm CST or EST

What you'll do

  • Process and manage customer orders, including POs, EDI, and related documentation
  • Support Account Managers and customers with order status, production schedules, delays, and supply chain updates
  • Coordinate order changes, including expedites, pushouts, cancellations, and rescheduling
  • Manage customer complaints and RMAs through resolution
  • Maintain accurate customer records, open-order reports, and communication logs
  • Support contract amendments and special projects
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, and other teams to resolve issues and meet customer needs
  • Perform other duties

What you'll bring

  • 3+ years of Customer Service, Customer Support, or Sales Support experience; previous experience with distribution or manufacturing preferred but not required
  • High School Degree or Equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor’s Degree preferred

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, and other business applications

  • Experience using an ERP system

  • Experience managing high volumes of online orders, ensuring accuracy
  • Experience in processing RMAs (Return Merchandise Authorizations), including initiating, tracking, and completing return requests
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and changing requirements in a deadline-driven environment
  • Professional verbal and written communication and listening skills
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively
  • Experience with wire, cable, electrical, or electronics manufacturing is a plus
What We Offer
  • Competitive salary, starting at $50,000 per year based on relevant industry experience
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options (CDHP and PPO) to get you the coverage you need
  • Robust Financial Security: Company-paid life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, plus options for supplemental critical illness, accident, and hospital indemnity plans
  • Generous Time Off: PTO plan with paid holidays, paid parental leave, and paid compassionate care leave to support personal well-being and family needs
  • Wellness & Support Programs: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), wellness incentives, and telehealth access
  • Extras That Matter: Dental and vision plans, FSAs/HSAs with company contributions, pet insurance, legal services, and ID theft protection for peace of mind
  • An employee-centric company that values and truly appreciates our most important asset: You!

About Custom Engineered Solutions (CES)

Paige, a GCG company, has been delivering innovative wire and cable solutions for over 65 years. Serving industries including renewable energy, data communications, industrial applications, irrigation, and more, we are committed to engineering excellence, customer-driven innovation, and high-quality products that help businesses solve complex challenges with tailored solutions. Built on a foundation of expertise, flexibility, and humility, we are dedicated to solving customer challenges, adapting to their needs, and continuously improving. At Paige, we remove ego from the equation, fostering a collaborative, customer-focused culture that drives long-term growth, innovation, and enduring partnerships. Join us and be part of a company shaping the future of connectivity.

About GCG

At GCG, our mission is to power, connect, and automate our world. With the responsive DNA of a startup and the size of a global leader, we offer top brands and extensive value-added services that make us an invaluable partner to our customers in multiple industry verticals across the globe.

We are committed to meeting the needs of our customers, while focusing attention on our responsibility to the environment, our associates, and the communities we serve.

Our Use of AI in Recruiting

At GCG, we use AI technology to assist with our interviews by automating note-taking, allowing our hiring teams to focus fully on the conversation. This technology supports efficiency and accuracy in capturing candidate insights during interviews but is not used to evaluate resumes. All resume reviews and candidate assessments are conducted directly by our corporate recruiting team and hiring managers to ensure a thoughtful, human-centered approach.

jobs.description:
Our client, a leading Software, Information and Communication Technologies company, operates internationally (Athens, Brussels, Luxembourg, Copenhagen, Stockholm, London, Nicosia, Hong-Kong, Valetta, etc). Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Role Overview

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

🧠 About Legion Health

At Legion Health, we believe everyone deserves fast, affordable, and world-class health care, and we’re developing the AI infrastructure to deliver it ourselves at world scale.

Legion is building autonomous medical care (the AI doctor), starting with psychiatry. Our AI-native care-delivery platform currently automates 95% of the administrative work required for us to deliver direct patient care. We also recently became the first company ever to receive regulatory authorization to let AI prescribe psychiatric medications, allowing us to not only collapse health care’s admin costs but also its clinical labor costs—shifting this industry’s economics from humans to tokens.

Our technical moat is hard to copy—we combine rich data, production AI, doctors in the loop, and end-to-end care operations to deliver measurably better care to a clinically complex patient population. This has helped us produce tens of thousands of total visits in just 2 years, all while holding ops costs flat and achieving industry-leading patient NPS and retention. While the last generation of healthcare startups made the existing system incrementally more efficient, Legion is rebuilding full-stack care delivery from first principles. Our vision? A 10X better patient experience that’s higher quality, less expensive, and more scalable than ever before. And a 10X better clinician experience that frees our providers to focus on what matters most: caring for patients.

Legion Health is backed by Y Combinator, leading venture capital firms, and founders from Function Health, Modern Health, Everly Health, Trusted Health, Clipboard Health, PatientPing, Sesame Care, Faire, EasyPost, and fuboTV.

Join us as we build the future of health care: faster, higher-quality, and more affordable, powered by doctors and AI working together.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Job Type: Full-Time

  • Role Type: Provider Partnerships / Field Sales / Referral Growth / Growth / Sales

  • Ideal Experience Level: 4+ years carrying and hitting a quota in a full-cycle, customer-facing role

  • Location: Regional territory (field-based), with occasional travel for team offsites and strategic meetings

  • US Visa Sponsorship: Yes

🚀 The Opportunity

Legion is hiring a Provider Partnerships Lead to build and own the referral relationships that connect providers to Legion's psychiatric care. This is a ground-floor, quota-carrying role on a brand-new team: you'll be one of Legion's first dedicated field sales hires, which means you'll help define the playbook, not just run it.

PCPs see mental health needs in their patients every day but rarely have a fast, trusted place to send patients. You'll be that trusted place — building in-person relationships with physicians, medical assistants, office managers, and administrators that turn a single conversation into a durable referral pipeline.

You will own your defined territory like a business: unlocking new practice relationships, running the full partnership cycle, and growing referral volume in accounts you've already won.

✅ Responsibilities and Deliverables

  • Carry a quota for provider referral partnerships and referral volume in your territory, and treat it as your scoreboard.

  • Run the full cycle: self-source through prospecting, build the case with practice decision-makers, and close.

  • Keep your pipeline and account activity clean and current in the CRM.

  • Spend the majority of your week in the field meeting with physicians, medical assistants, office managers, and administrators; supplement with virtual outreach and follow-up.

  • Represent Legion credibly to clinical and administrative customers, translating a new category of AI-enabled psychiatric care into a clear, compelling referral case.

  • Map the decision-making unit inside each practice and build multi-threaded relationships that move a partnership from first meeting to live referrals.

  • Become a trusted resource to providers by educating them on Legion's model and the impact fast, accessible psychiatric care has on their patients.

  • Set each practice up for a clean handoff so patient referrals convert into scheduled visits.

  • Feed what you learn in the field back into messaging, targeting, and the sales playbook. You're building this function, not inheriting it.

  • Partner with leadership on territory design, targeting, and process as the team scales.

  • Collaborate with your peers across territories sharing what's working, troubleshooting objections together, and helping build a team where everyone's win rate goes up.

🏆 You’ll Be Successful If You…

  • Are driven by the number: hitting quota is satisfying, beating it is the point, and you don't need anyone chasing you for it.

  • Would rather write the playbook than inherit one, and see the ambiguity of a new category as opportunity, not friction.

  • Earn trust with physicians quickly. You can get in front of a busy clinician, read the room, and move a skeptical conversation toward a signed partnership.

  • Treat change as normal. Territories, tooling, and the field/virtual mix will evolve as we scale, and you adapt fast while staying focused on results.

  • Are energized by the mission of making fast, affordable psychiatric care accessible through better referral pathways.

  • Welcome coaching and feedback and treat growth as a team sport.

🧰 Ideal Background and Skills

  • 4+ years carrying and hitting a quota in a field-based or B2B2C role; healthcare, medical device, or pharma referral sales strongly preferred.

  • Comfort and skill in front of clinical and administrative buyers; you can build physician rapport and move a conversation toward a partnership.

  • Strength selling in person, with the judgment to know what a given relationship needs.

  • Highly organized and analytical, comfortable owning a number and reasoning from your own pipeline data.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with the polish to represent Legion well externally.

  • Familiarity with CRM and sales tooling.

  • Existing relationships with provider referral networks are a plus, but not required.

💰 Compensation & Benefits

  • Comp: OTE range of $120,000 to $180,000 depending on experience. Competitive base + uncapped, performance-based variable commission tied to your number, plus meaningful early-stage equity

  • Additional Perks: Mileage and travel reimbursement at the IRS standard rate, coverage for field and provider engagement expenses, cell phone stipend

  • Time Off: Flexible, unlimited vacation policy

  • Work Setup: Remote, in-field with some travel for team meetings

  • Benefits: Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Impact: Build the referral engine that connects primary care to the future of psychiatric care

  • Growth Opportunities: As we scale, this role can grow into a leadership role, building out enablement or larger partnership role.

📝 How to Apply and Hiring Process

  • Apply here:

  • Overview of our hiring process:

    1. Resume + Recruiter Screen

    2. Hiring Manager Interview

    3. Founder Interviews (2)

    4. Professional Reference Checks

  • Estimated time-to-hire: 3 weeks

  • Start date: ASAP

Additional Information:

Review this Doc first!

How to Prepare for the Recruiting Process -

📢 Why Are They Hiring a Bilingual Insurance Executive Assistant? 🏢

Our client is hiring a Bilingual Insurance Executive Assistant to be the agency owner's right hand in the business. As the agency continues to grow, the client needs a reliable, independent professional who can take full ownership of commercial insurance operations, from client intake and quoting to binding, payments, certificates and renewals, while serving clients warmly in both Spanish and English. This role will free the owner to focus on building client relationships and growing the agency.

If you're a warm, organized and process-driven bilingual insurance professional who enjoys helping small business owners stay protected, and you take pride in keeping every policy, payment and inbox in order, this role could be a great fit for you. ✨

✅ Qualifications:

Must-Haves:

  • 🗣️ Bilingual Fluency (Spanish & English)– Fluent spoken and written Spanish and English to serve Spanish-speaking small business owners and contractors.
  • 📋 Commercial Insurance Experience– Ideally 2–5 years as an Insurance CSR, Administrative Assistant, or VA in US commercial insurance, with working knowledge of coverage limits, certificates, quoting, and renewals.
  • 📞 Warm Phone Demeanor– Friendly, patient, and personable on the phone—especially when calling clients about upcoming or overdue payments.
  • ✍️ Strong Written Communication– Clear, professional English email communication and the ability to manage a high-volume inbox.
  • ⚡ Fast, Process-Oriented Learner– Picks up workflows quickly through visual, step-by-step demonstrations and executes repetitive tasks consistently and accurately.
  • 💎 Uncompromising Integrity– Honest, transparent, and quick to raise a hand when a mistake happens so it can be fixed together.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • 🖨️ Printer & Scanner (Highly Preferred)– Useful for printing carrier supplemental forms, scanning signed waivers and agreements, and re-uploading them to carrier portals.
  • 💻 AMS & Carrier Portal Experience– Familiarity with an agency management system and US carrier/wholesaler quoting portals.
  • 🤖 Comfort with AI Tools– Openness to using AI tools to work smarter and faster.

Your responsibilities include:

📝 Client Intake & Application Quoting

  • Receive scanned client intake forms via email and verify that all details are complete
  • Create and update client records in the agency management system
  • Enter application details into commercial carrier and wholesaler quoting portals to generate premium quotes
  • Call clients on complex or high-risk applications to gather missing operational details for underwriting
  • Process carrier supplemental questionnaires—collect answers from clients, complete forms digitally or by hand, and upload them back to portals
  • Monitor quoting progress and notify the agency owner as soon as a quote is finalized so she can present it to the client

📑 Policy Binding, Financing & Invoicing

  • Complete the binding workflow with carriers once the client has signed and approved payment
  • Prepare finance agreements and track check deposits and clearance before disbursing payments to the finance company
  • Issue digital invoices and send payment links via email or text through the agency's new finance platform
  • Support the transition of existing policyholders from the legacy finance system to the new digital platform

📞 Pending Cancellations & Payment Reminder Calls

  • Start each morning by pulling pending cancellation reports from carrier and finance portals
  • Make friendly outbound reminder calls to clients with payments due (typically 2–3 per day)
  • Help clients make payments by phone or guide them through digital payment links to prevent policy lapses

📜 Certificates of Insurance & Workers' Comp Waivers

  • Issue Certificates of Liability Insurance for homeowners, general contractors, and commercial clients
  • Prepare 3-part building permit certificate packages (General Liability, Workers' Compensation, and Disability)
  • Add Additional Insured endorsements as required by project specifications or municipal codes
  • Generate Workers' Comp waivers through state or carrier portals and send them to clients for signature

🔄 Policy Renewals & Carrier Shopping

  • Track upcoming renewals 6 weeks before expiration, alert the agency owner, and re-engage clients
  • Re-quote expiring policies from a discontinued wholesaler and shop them across alternative carriers to secure replacement coverage

📧 Inbox Management & Bilingual Call Handling

  • Own the agency's primary shared Gmail inbox—filter, categorize, and clear it daily
  • Respond to routine client inquiries directly and escalate owner-level items
  • Handle forwarded office and mobile calls with warm customer service in English and Spanish
  • Route appointment and meeting requests to the front-desk assistant who manages the owner's calendar

  • Design the visual language, design system, and UI components for A1's product across web and mobile.

  • Experience working closely with product and UX designers in fast-moving teams.

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. Job Summary

Senior Budget Analyst, Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP)

Job Summary:

Aptive seeks a Budget Analyst - Senior to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) on the Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) contract. You will lead budget planning, forecasting, and execution analysis for OCI’s clinical informatics portfolio, applying Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) and Managing for Results (MFR) practices so that funding decisions keep pace with the work. The role supports the Clinical Informatics Solutions specialty area, including Electronic Health Record (EHR) issue management, clinical content standardization, and informatics workforce programs. You will work within Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Trains alongside OCI leadership, program analysts, and VA Business Owners.

Primary Responsibilities

  • PPBE and MFR Implementation. Implement and manage PPBE and MFR activities for the clinical informatics portfolio, in line with applicable budget laws, regulations, policies, and precedents.
  • Multi-Year Programming. Conduct multi-year programming studies and budget analyses, including survey methods, findings, evaluations, and recommendations.
  • Budget Formulation. Lead budget formulation efforts; develop, manage, and maintain spreadsheets and budget artifacts, including inputs to the Congressional Budget Justification.
  • Health Care Budgeting and Forecasting. Forecast portfolio costs and funding needs, including staffing demand tied to Federal EHR deployments and VistA/CPRS sustainment.
  • Level-of-Effort and Cost Estimation. Lead estimates of the level of effort and labor categories needed for Features selected in Planning Interval (PI) Planning, supporting the Government’s next call order.
  • Appropriation Tracking. Record and track the Government’s appropriation decision for each Feature, consistent with VA funding requirements.
  • Execution and Variance Analysis. Track obligations, expenditures, and burn against Government spend plans; analyze variances and recommend corrective actions.
  • Management Briefs. Draft briefs for VA management on the portfolio budget, cost drivers, funding risks, and tradeoffs.
  • Budget Reporting. Develop budget dashboards and recurring reports in Excel or Power BI.
  • Agile Team Participation. Participate in PI Planning and backlog refinement to provide cost and capacity inputs, and align Lean portfolio budgets with prioritized Epics.
  • Analyst Guidance. Provide guidance and review for junior budget and program analysts.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of 6 years of professional experience in budget, financial, or cost analysis.
  • Proven experience implementing and managing PPBE or MFR across a large integrated government organization.
  • Experience with budgeting, planning, and forecasting in the health care industry.
  • Knowledge of federal budget-related laws, regulations, policies, precedents, methods, and techniques.
  • Experience developing budget artifacts and briefs for senior leadership.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a VA background investigation at the level assigned to the position; must reside and work in the United States with U.S. work authorization.

Desired Qualifications

  • Degree in accounting, finance, business, public administration, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
  • Experience supporting VA or VHA budget formulation or execution.
  • Experience preparing inputs to the Congressional Budget Justification.
  • Experience with federal financial management systems, such as FMS or iFAMS.
  • Experience with Lean portfolio budgeting in SAFe environments.
  • Experience building dashboards in Power BI.
  • Certified Defense Financial Manager (CDFM) or Certified Government Financial Manager (CGFM).

jobs.title: Senior Software Release Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Engineering, a related specialized area or field is required or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience.
jobs.description:
Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, a related specialized area or field is required or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience plus a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree plus a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:Ability to obtain a Department of Defense Secret security clearance is required at time of hire. Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. Government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. Due to the nature of work performed within our facilities, U.S. citizenship is required.

Responsibilities for this Position

What You'll Own

  • Release engineering strategy. Design and build the release process for our software products. Establish how versions are created, validated, promoted, and deployed across development, staging, and production environments.
  • Release automation. Develop and improve CI/CD workflows that make releases repeatable, observable, and low-risk. Define versioning conventions, release gates, approval paths, artifact handling, and deployment promotion practices.
  • Automated testing in the pipeline. Partner with software and AI engineers to build automated testing into delivery pipelines. Ensure unit, integration, regression, security, and other appropriate checks run consistently before software advances to the next environment.
  • Testing rigor and quality gates. Help establish practical standards for test coverage, test reliability, and release readiness. Drive adoption of quality gates that catch issues early without creating unnecessary delivery friction.
  • Release coordination and traceability. Maintain clear visibility into what version is deployed in each environment, what changed between releases, and which validations were completed. Create release records that support troubleshooting, auditability, and informed decision-making.
  • Deployment safety and rollback. Build and validate release and rollback procedures so teams can deploy confidently and recover quickly when a release does not perform as expected.

What You Won't Own

  • Feature development or product backlog prioritization.
  • Day-to-day production operations and incident response.
  • Defining business requirements.

Why This Role Matters

We are building a disciplined, automated way to release software across multiple teams. This role will turn releases from a collection of manual steps into a reliable engineering capability: tested, traceable, repeatable, and continuously improving.

You will work closely with engineers to make quality part of the delivery process itself. The goal is not gatekeeping. It helps teams move quickly because releases are well-tested, predictable, and easy to understand.

In a defense environment, release confidence matters. Knowing what was deployed, how it was validated, and how to recover from an issue is essential to secure and dependable software delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related field, plus 8 years of relevant experience.
  • Experience building, operating, or improving CI/CD pipelines for production software.
  • Experience with release engineering practices, including versioning, artifact management, environment promotion, release approvals, and rollback planning.
  • Experience implementing automated testing in CI/CD pipelines, including unit, integration, regression, and security testing as appropriate.
  • Experience with source control and CI/CD platforms such as Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps, or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of software quality practices and the ability to translate testing expectations into practical pipeline controls.
  • Strong documentation and cross-functional communication skills.
  • U.S. citizenship required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting AI-enabled or data-intensive software systems.
  • Experience in defense, aerospace, or another regulated environment.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code, including Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with containerized delivery, container registries, and orchestration platforms.
  • Experience introducing or maturing release engineering and software quality practices across multiple engineering teams.

What Sets You Apart

  • You can take an inconsistent release process and turn it into a dependable, automated system.
  • You know how to increase testing rigor while keeping engineering teams productive.
  • You build pipelines that provide useful feedback, not just more steps.
  • You can answer what version is deployed, what changed, and what testing it passed.
  • You treat rollback as a planned capability, not an emergency improvisation.

Details

  • Remote — 100% telework
  • 9/80 schedule
  • Defense industry experience is not required

Salary Note

This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled.

General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team!
