jobs.title: Director of Product Hardware
jobs.excerpt: OverviewRachio is looking for a Director of Product Hardware to own what Rachio builds in the physical world: the devices roadmap, the product definition behind each device, and the product development process (PDP) that takes a hardware concept from idea through EVT, DVT, and PVT to a product that ships on time, in full, and at the right cost.
jobs.description:
Overview

Rachio is looking for a Director of Product Hardware to own what Rachio builds in the physical world: the devices roadmap, the product definition behind each device, and the product development process (PDP) that takes a hardware concept from idea through EVT, DVT, and PVT to a product that ships on time, in full, and at the right cost. This is a senior leader role at Rachio and the head of our hardware portfolio: smart sprinkler controllers, hose timers, outdoor lighting, and the partner and OEM products we build with and for others, along with the tethered software experiences (setup, control, and device features in the Rachio app) that make them work. This is a high growth mode that requires someone who can span both strategic thinking and execution to deliver on the roadmap.

The role sits at the center of how Rachio develops and launches products. You partner with the Director of Product Marketing, who owns the go-to-market (GTM) process, on what we build and when; you own the "working backwards" definition of why we're building it, for whom, and what it has to do. You work daily with Engineering (firmware, electrical, mechanical, and industrial design), Supply Chain and Operations, Design, Support, Finance, and Sales to get products defined, built, certified, and delivered. It's inherently technical and inherently commercial: you are measured on shipping products customers love - on time, at cost, and at quality - and on how those products perform in market (activation, returns, CSAT, and attach to software and subscriptions), not on the volume of specs written.

The right person is equally comfortable writing a one-page product definition for the exec team, sitting in a firmware trade-off conversation with engineering, and spending time understanding customer pain points and usage data to inform what we are prioritizing building next. You will operate at startup velocity across projects in very different stages: finding product/market fit for new hardware concepts, accelerating the growth of fledgling products, and helping scale our mature ones.

A note on how this role works. Rachio runs a flat organization that maintains a high ownership and fast paced start-up culture. As such, this is a senior individual contributor role. Your influence comes from the quality of your product judgment, the clarity of your writing, and your credibility with the engineers, designers, and operators who build what you define - not from headcount. If there's a gap in the organization or resourcing standing between a product and its launch, you are expected to step in and fill it. If you're looking for a role where you set direction and a team executes it, this isn't that role. If you want to shape a category-leading device portfolio and see your decisions show up on shelves and in yards, it is.

Responsibilities

Own the hardware roadmap and product strategy

  • Own the devices roadmap across new products, line extensions, and lifecycle work on launched products, and keep it led by data: customer research, product telemetry, support and returns data, channel input, competitive intelligence, and market trends.
  • Co-lead the development of consumer-focused new product strategy and vision with leadership, supported by internal and external analysis, and translate it into a sequenced plan that Engineering and Supply Chain can commit to.
  • Own and prioritize the lifecycle roadmap for shipped hardware: firmware and feature updates, cost-downs, quality fixes, and the improvements that make the product easier to buy, set up, and love.
  • Manage the trade-offs among customer experience, performance, cost, schedule, and operational support load, and make the call - with a written rationale - when they conflict.

Own product definition and the product development process (PDP)

  • Write the "working backwards" documents for each new product and major feature: the customer problem, the value to customers, partners, and channels, the target price and cost, the success criteria, and the questions we have to answer before we commit.
  • Turn those into detailed, crisp business requirements and user stories that Engineering and Design can build to, spanning hardware, firmware, and the tethered app experience.
  • Run the hardware PDP as a mechanism, not a meeting: clear stage gates from concept through EVT, DVT, PVT, and ramp, clear owners and exit criteria at each, and an honest review of what we learned at the end.
  • Contribute to engineering decisions on technology and architecture - radios and protocols, sensors, power, enclosures - with enough fluency to be useful in the room and to recognize when a decision is a one-way door.
  • Delegate CX problem and solution discovery to Design where appropriate (and know when that is), and facilitate their design development process and decision-making.

Integrate with Supply Chain and Operations

  • Work with Supply Chain from concept forward on cost targets, supplier and contract manufacturer selection, tooling, and certification timelines, so initial inventory availability and delivery SLAs are set before we sell the product, not after.
  • Own the product inputs to supply and demand planning: launch quantities, ramp assumptions, transition and end-of-life plans, and the demand signals coming from channel and partner commitments.
  • Proactively identify and resolve the strategic issues - component shortages, cost overruns, schedule slips, quality escapes - that would keep the team from meeting its strategic, financial, and technical goals.

Drive hardware launches with GTM

  • Partner with the Director of Product Marketing on hardware GTM launches: crisp definition of the product experience (hardware and software) and its value to the customer, and the technical inputs that positioning, packaging, and channel enablement depend on.
  • Own launch readiness on the product side: certification, firmware and app readiness, in-box content, support documentation, and the go/no-go criteria for build and ship.
  • Create commitment to the devices roadmap and overall product vision internally, with Rain Bird, and with key external partners: retailers, distributors, and OEM and platform partners.
  • Work closely with engineering and project management to deliver products to market, performing the role of scrum master or product owner as needed for execution.
  • Own and close the post-launch feedback loop: what's confusing customers, what's driving returns and support contacts, and what we fix in the next firmware or hardware revision.

Voice of the customer and measurement

  • Own product discovery for hardware across homeowners and professional installers - interviews, surveys, field visits, and product data - and partner with Product Marketing on the broader customer research agenda.
  • Instrument products so success is measurable: activation, engagement, return rate, defect and warranty rates, CSAT/NPS, and attach to software and subscription offerings.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of technical experience in product management, product marketing, program management, or engineering, including significant time owning hardware products end-to-end.
  • 5+ years of full-lifecycle consumer hardware/devices product management experience as the lead PM on the product: concept, definition, development, launch, and lifecycle management.
  • 3+ years of professional experience working with mobile apps and/or connected consumer devices.
  • Comfort operating as a hands-on individual contributor. You write the working backwards doc, build the requirements, run the PDP gates, and sit in the DVT review yourself rather than assigning it.
  • Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy, including electrical and mechanical engineering and industrial design trade-offs.
  • Working knowledge of embedded firmware, mobile technology, web services, and back-end application infrastructure - enough to reason about what a feature actually requires.
  • Experience coordinating hardware development cycles with software development schedules, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver products on tight deadlines.
  • Experience taking new hardware concepts from raw product intuition through fast, measurable tests to a decision, including the ones that failed.
  • Strong analytical foundation: practical working knowledge of statistics and one or more of SQL, Python, or R for ad hoc analysis and prototyping, and comfort defending your assumptions.
  • Exceptional written communication. Distill a complex set of trade-offs into a written narrative a leadership team can act on.
  • Bachelor's degree.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience building a hardware product development process (NPI/PDP) from scratch, or materially rebuilding one that wasn't working.
  • Experience shipping products through contract manufacturers, including EVT/DVT/PVT builds, DFM, certification (FCC, UL, CE), and factory visits.
  • Experience with smart home platforms and protocols - Matter, Thread, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth - and the platform partners that certify them.
  • Experience in two-step distribution or professional trade channels (irrigation, landscape, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, building products) alongside retail and D2C.
  • Experience with outdoor products, lighting, water management, or the sustainability categories.
  • Experience with partner, OEM, or white-label hardware programs.
  • Hands-on experience maintaining a residential yard and irrigation system (or willing and able to).
  • Engineering degree, MBA, or advanced degree.

Salary range for candidates based in Colorado - New York- New York City or Maryland : $232,000 - $348,000

Salary ranges include base salary and annual incentive bonus if applicable.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

jobs.excerpt: About DarkroomDarkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow.
jobs.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

As a Director of Growth Strategy, you will be responsible for a small portfolio of game-changing brands that have engaged with Darkroom to accelerate their growth. You are one-half management consultant — spending your day dissecting inefficiencies within the business and marketing programs — and one-half marketing strategy leader, building and orchestrating a Darkroom team meant to deliver growth. This is a client-facing position meant for the best and brightest in growth marketing and media strategy, capable of leveraging their unique skillset.

Perfect candidates will be obsessed with growth strategy for consumer brands, experts at deploying efficient omni-channel paid advertising campaigns that deliver impact, with particular expertise in and knowledge growing the DTC channel at large. You should be comfortably managing the go-to-market for fast-growth emerging brands pre-revenue as equally as managing a $50M DTC P&L for a household consumer brand.

This position is the most senior position on a Darkroom omni-channel client engagement (meaning the client may be working with us across multiple sales channels — Amazon, DTC, TikTok Shop, Retail). Being successful in this role requires mastery of the DTC function, a willingness to understand (and master) how integrated paid media drives growth impact on the other channels (Amazon, Retail), and effective communication across teams and departments. You will be Directly managing the relationship with the client, scaling ad accounts upwards of $1M USD per month, and having excellent client relationship management skills. You live and growth strategy, funnel construction, and performance marketing. You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.

You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling Darkroom’s footprint across a portfolio of high-growth consumer brands. You’ll be responsible for owning full funnel advertising efforts, including weekly client team touch-bases and QBRs, while working closely with all Darkroom teams to ensure performance goals are met.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands-on experience in a broad range of verticals, while developing the skills needed to be a future CMO.

Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

What you’ll do:

  • Develop integrated growth strategies that deliver millions in yearly growth for clients.

  • Developing campaigns where all marketing channels are working together and be able to clearly articulate overall themes as well as trends across the paid media plan.

  • Work on financial projections, budgets, P&L, and other financial documents to be shared internally, with the client, and used as a north star for work.

  • Work with our data team to deliver financial projections, customer cohort analyses, and media plans.

  • Work with Darkroom Finance team to project client spend and increase it based on performance.

  • Leverage these data insights to develop unique marketing strategies across various industries.

  • Lead multiple teams of designers, paid acquisition marketers, retention marketers, and data analysts across the globe for your client portfolio.

  • Work with Darkroom success to develop fractional and dedicated marketing org charts based on client needs.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 10+ years of paid media experience with a minimum of 7 years in DTC or E-Commerce.

  • You are a master of the DTC P&L and are comfortable engaging in discussions around contribution margin, new customer revenue, and repeat revenue.

  • You understand revenue is a derivative of AOV, CVR, CPM, Traffic and can articulate this in a marketing pro-forma.

  • You have a great willingness to understand (and master) how integrated paid media drives growth impact on the other channels (Amazon, Retail), not just DTC.

  • You are a master of constructing e-commerce funnels that include irresistible offers, healthy AOV, and speak to the UVPs of a product. You can build creative strategies off these funnels and communicate them clearly to the client.

  • You are excited by complex challenges that require innovative marketing strategies to unlock scale.

  • Your 5-10 year plan has you becoming a CMO or CEO of your own brand.

  • You are excited by the challenge to work at the intersection of growth marketing, creative advertising, and financial analysis.

  • You have an acute attention to detail and are capable of project managing large teams with various functions.

  • You are able to be flexible, understand shifting client needs, deal with ambiguity, and adapt to the situation.

  • You are not afraid to be a leader and deliver thoughtful direction that keeps projects on track.

  • You are proficient in financial projections, dealing with P/Ls, and holding your own with Private Equity firms, CEOs, CFOs, or a management team when challenged to defend your strategies surrounding marketing movements and paths to scale.

  • You are excited to work with innovative data models that give you unique insights into product, customer, and marketing data. You thrive on this data to develop new strategies.

  • Know the entire acquisition marketing landscape, and have a perspective on how to build world-class campaigns in today’s changing landscape – this includes knowledge of the tools to use, running effective campaigns, the metrics to measure, and the proper attribution methodologies

  • You like building teams and are comfortable being the quarterback, directing retention, paid media, creative, and data teams in harmony to deliver efficient growth.

  • Experience in online sales channel strategies; Shopify, Amazon, third-party fulfillment, and wholesale.

  • You understand media measurement and the differences between MTA, MMM, and In Platform attribution. You are keen to figure out how best to think about measurement for your clients.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

Our Hiring Process and Compensation:

The hiring process for this position typically follows three stages; phone screen, hiring manager, and Executive calls.

Compensation:

The base salary range for this role is $130,000 per year. This range represents the anticipated minimum and maximum for this position and applies to candidates based in New York, including New York City, in compliance with the New York State Pay Transparency Law and the New York City Salary Transparency Law. Actual compensation within this range will be determined based on experience, skills, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for performance-based compensation. Job Description

NetImpact Strategies builds software for Federal agencies, and we build it with AI. We are hiring engineers who own a solution end to end: sit with the customer, turn what they need into a specification, direct AI coding agents to build it, prove it works, get it into a Federal production environment, and hand it to sustainment. You will work in Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, and our proprietary AI software generation platform every day.

The Technical Architect extracts meaning from what a customer is asking and converts it into the right technology. The role is senior enough to own the architecture, close enough to the customer to understand the intent behind a request, and accountable when the solution goes live. The Core functions of the role are Research, Design, Architect, Code with AI, Solution Validation, and discipline to be productive with Client intimacy.

What makes the role different

This is not a conventional architect who designs and hands off, a people manager, or a quota-carrying salesperson. AI generation changes how code is produced, but it does not transfer accountability: production code ships under this role’s ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Participate directly in requirements capture, translate customer needs into fit-for-purpose solutions, and define the technical scope and boundaries for fixed-price engagements.
  • Convert customer requirements into structured specifications, acceptance criteria, and architectural decisions that enable AI-assisted software development, while validating generated solutions before release.
  • Lead production integration, guide deployments, and remain accountable through deployment, stabilization, customer acceptance, and knowledge transfer to ensure successful delivery.
  • Ensure solutions are extensible, maintainable, and transferable so they can be supported and enhanced by other qualified team members.
  • Deliver production-ready solutions by supporting cloud deployments, CI/CD, legacy system integration, and compliance with ATO/RMF, Section 508, and NIST requirements.
  • Create reusable assets, share lessons learned across the organization, and identify opportunities for follow-on work while transitioning commercial activities to the appropriate stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • Demonstrate a strong foundation in software engineering principles and manual coding, with the ability to architect and deliver solutions across modern programming languages, frameworks, cloud platforms, AI-assisted development tools, and low-code platforms.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.6+ years of professional software delivery, including enterprise systems you carried into production and supported after go-live.
  • A complete solution built primarily with agentic AI coding tools. At least one working, end-to-end application you built by directing Claude Code, Codex, Copilot agent mode, Cursor, or an equivalent tool. Work or substantive personal projects both count. You will be asked to show it and to build live during the interview.
  • Enterprise delivery experience. Demonstrated ownership of enterprise-scale software delivery, including production integration, deployment, operational constraints, and post-launch stabilization.
  • Architect-level depth. Strong systems-design judgment plus working fluency across analysis, product ownership, software development, project delivery, security, data, integrations, and operations.
  • AI-directed solution delivery. Evidence of independently building complete working solutions primarily through AI-assisted generation. Substantive personal projects may demonstrate this capability.
  • Generated-code verification. Ability to read unfamiliar generated logic, identify failure modes, design appropriate tests, and determine whether the system is safe and correct enough to ship.Technology breadth. Ability to compare and select technologies based on context rather than defaulting to a familiar stack.
  • Customer and contextual judgment. Ability to uncover the meaning behind stated requirements, read stakeholders, and adapt the approach to the engagement’s real constraints.
  • Problem solving and persistence. A record of making progress through ambiguity, obstacles, incomplete information, and cross-organizational dependency.
  • Software-delivery orientation. Hands-on experience must be primarily in delivering software solutions rather than infrastructure or operations alone.Willingness and demonstrated ability to work across greenfield builds, modernization, integration-heavy environments, and inherited in-flight work.
  • Full-stack fluency across the environments above, with production experience in at least one .NET or Java enterprise ecosystem and at least one major cloud.
  • Verification mindset. You define acceptance criteria, design test strategies, use automated testing, and instrument systems so behavior can be observed. You treat "the agent said it works" as the start of verification, not the end.
  • Customer-facing communication. You can run a discovery session, demo to a skeptical stakeholder, and explain a technical trade-off to a non-technical program owner.
  • US citizenship and eligibility for a Secret clearance.

This role is probably not for you if:

  • You want to design the system and let someone else build it.
  • You want to be handed a design and build exactly that.
  • You use AI coding tools as autocomplete and prefer to write the code yourself.
  • You need a single familiar stack to be productive.
  • You would rather not demo to a customer, or hear from one that the first version missed.

About Us

At NetImpact Strategies, we post salary ranges in compliance with the specific labor laws and regulations of each county and state, ensuring transparency and fairness in our hiring practices. Overview/About Lumanity

Lumanity is dedicated to improving health outcomes by accelerating and optimizing access to life-changing medicines. As a global strategic partner that brings together strategy, evidence, engagement, and technology, we were designed to engineer breakthrough value to tackle our clients’ toughest challenges by revolutionizing how value is generated, demonstrated, and communicated.

Responsibilities / Position overview

We are seeking an idea-generating, solutions-oriented agency leader to serve as Vice President of Client Engagement within our Market Access division, which helps pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies gain market access for their brands and thrive in the changing healthcare landscape. Our Market Access business operates at the intersection of traditional market research, strategy consulting, and advertising agency services. This innovative model allows us to help clients deeply understand their customer targets and engage with precision and purpose to drive results.

In this management level, client-facing role, the Vice President, Client Engagement operates at a senior- level planning, coordinating, and directing advertising campaigns for agency clients as well as identifying and addressing changes in the marketing environment.

We’re looking for an experienced marketing leader with market access experience who can lead a large cross-functional team. This role requires someone who is an excellent communicator with strong writing skills who can effectively present strategic and tactical plans to senior management.

You should be able to utilize your experience and expertise to confidently provide insights and recommendations to clients.

Day to day responsibilities include:• Provides leadership role for client and agency product teams • Responsible for the strategic development and implementation of integrated marketing programs as well as ensures that all professional activities are in line with the agreed upon strategic direction• Supervises creative development to ensure it adheres to the highest quality standards and communicates against strategy and objective across all communication channels• Serve as primary team interface with client product directors and directors of marketing strategy liaison with client on brand and business issues • Leads and supervises all activities between agency departments on the team• Reviews monthly and quarterly financial tracking reports with Operations lead and presents reports to client brand management • Formulates plans to extend business with established accounts • Supervises and participates in new-business development• Supervises account team members and monitors their performance both with their client counter parts and internally with other creative and operational departments. Distributes projects and reviews their progress continually to ensure professional growth is attained. • Effectively leads client engagement and ensures the organic growth of the business through client relations• Efficiently manages account budget, identifies areas of risk and provides solutions• Identifies process or procedure opportunities for improvements and suggests resolutions• Actively instills the company culture amongst the team• Excels at client relations to ensure that the client has the optimal customer service experience

Qualifications

•Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, advertising or related field• Minimum 8-10 years of experience in a fast-paced agency environment• Demonstrated experience and success in leadership of cross-functional agency teams• High motivation, good work ethic, maturity and personal initiative• Strong oral and written communication skills • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail• Occasional travel may be required

Benefits

We offer our employees a comprehensive benefits package that focuses on what matters to you – health and well-being, personal finances, professional development, and a healthy work/life balance:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance options
  • 401(k) plan with employer match
  • Generous amount of paid time off annually + paid holidays
  • Flexible spending accounts for health and dependent care

Overview

DecisionPoint is seeking an experienced Military OneSource Mobile Application Engineer to support the MODES III program. This individual will develop, modernize, test, deploy, and maintain secure iOS and Android applications supporting military members, families, and service providers. The engineer will support the My Military OneSource, Chill Drills, MilProvider, and future applications. The ideal candidate has experience developing production mobile applications, integrating RESTful APIs and cloud services, managing mobile CI/CD pipelines, and supporting Apple App Store and Google Play releases.\ This position is fully remote.

Duties & Responsibilities

Mobile Application Engineering
  • Develop and maintain mobile applications for Apple iOS and Google Android.
  • Implement new features, enhancements, and modernization initiatives.
  • Translate user stories, UX designs, and technical requirements into reliable mobile solutions.
  • Develop responsive, accessible, and platform-appropriate user interfaces.
  • Troubleshoot crashes, performance issues, integration failures, and production defects.
  • Support native and cross-platform mobile development technologies.
API, Cloud & DevSecOps Support
  • Integrate mobile applications with RESTful APIs, databases, identity services, AWS-hosted systems, and third-party services.
  • Implement authentication, push notifications, analytics, secure storage, caching, synchronization, and offline functionality.
  • Support Git-based source control, automated testing, build processes, and mobile CI/CD pipelines.
  • Manage application signing, provisioning, testing, deployment, and release activities.
  • Support application submissions and updates through Apple App Store and Google Play.
Security, Accessibility & Quality
  • Apply secure mobile-development practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Support vulnerability remediation, code reviews, automated testing, and production monitoring.
  • Develop applications consistent with Section 508 and applicable accessibility requirements.
  • Support RMF, Zero Trust, NIST SP 800-53, privacy, and Authority to Operate requirements.

Agile Delivery & Collaboration
  • Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with product owners, UX designers, business analysts, testers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, and Government stakeholders.
  • Provide estimates, technical documentation, status updates, and implementation recommendations.
  • Contribute technical ideas and modernization recommendations to the mobile product roadmap.
The Military OneSource Mobile Application Engineer will help deliver secure, accessible, and reliable mobile services that connect military members and families with trusted information, resources, and support.

Qualifications

Education

  • Experience with a cross-platform framework such as React Native, Flutter, Ionic, or Capacitor.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs and cloud services.
  • Experience with authentication, secure storage, caching, synchronization, or push notifications.
  • Experience with Git, automated testing, Agile delivery, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience troubleshooting and supporting production mobile applications.
  • Experience preparing and deploying applications through Apple App Store or Google Play.
Preferred Experience & Certifications
  • CompTIA Security+ certification.
  • Experience supporting Federal, DoD, or other regulated applications.
  • Experience with AWS-hosted mobile services.
  • Experience developing for both iOS and Android.
  • Experience with Xcode, Android Studio, App Store Connect, and Google Play Console.
  • Experience developing offline-capable mobile applications.
  • Experience with mobile analytics, crash monitoring, and performance diagnostics.
  • Experience applying Section 508 requirements to mobile applications.
  • Experience with RMF, NIST SP 800-53, Zero Trust, and Authority to Operate requirements.
  • Experience working from Figma designs and established digital design systems.
Desired Professional Characteristics
  • Strong mobile troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Commitment to application security, accessibility, reliability, and quality.
  • Ability to communicate technical recommendations and tradeoffs clearly.
  • Ability to work independently within a fully remote Agile team.
  • Strong interest in building digital services for military members and their families.

jobs.title: Client Strategy Manager
jobs.excerpt: About UsHigharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built.
jobs.description:
About Us

Higharc is a VC-backed startup that is changing how new homes are designed and built. Join a founding team who’ve shipped products for Autodesk, Electronic Arts, Nike, and Apple. We have raised over $175M with support from top-notch venture capital firms and more than 18 strategic investors: industry leaders in construction, building products manufacturing, and distribution.

Higharc is seeking a Client Strategy Manager to own the adoption strategy for your book of business. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Client Strategy, you'll lead customers from cross-departmental alignment through implementation, launch, measurable adoption, and long-term value realization.

What You'll Do

This is not a high-volume SaaS account management role. You'll own a small number of complex enterprise homebuilders and help them adopt Higharc in ways that materially change how their business operates. Adoption here isn't about usage, it's about changing how builders work.

You'll partner with a dedicated Project Manager who owns project plans, reporting, documentation, and system hygiene. With that discipline in place, you focus on customer outcomes, executive alignment, adoption strategy, change management, and account health.

Expect to:

  • Own adoption outcomes from post-sale alignment through launch, rollout, value realization, and long-term account health.

  • Lead executive conversations on your own around business goals, adoption milestones, risks, tradeoffs, and value.

  • Guide clients beyond recreating legacy workflows toward new workflows, decision rights, and the adoption behaviors required to realize value.

  • Orchestrate internal teams across Implementation, Solutions, Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales to keep outcomes moving.

  • Diagnose adoption risk early, align stakeholders, and restore momentum when programs stall.

  • Translate patterns in client friction into structured product, implementation, and account intelligence.

About You

You're a strategic client relationship owner who can multithread through messy, high-stakes operational change. You're comfortable standing on your own with senior stakeholders, you know when to pull in executive support from Higharc, and you can tell a clear story about where a customer is, where they need to go, what's at risk, and what decisions move them forward.

You bring curiosity and horsepower to quickly understand how builders operate across Architecture, Purchasing, Sales, and Operations. You're highly self-directed: you investigate ambiguity, form a point of view, and move work forward without close management.

You have:

  • 5+ years in client success, implementation leadership, enterprise account management, consulting, solutions, or program leadership, with direct ownership of complex, high-value customers or transformation programs

  • Strong executive communication skills and the ability to independently influence senior customer stakeholders

  • Excellent judgment in diagnosing customer risk, adoption friction, stakeholder misalignment, and organizational blockers

  • Strong consultative and cross-functional leadership instincts — you can challenge customers respectfully when legacy assumptions limit value, and lead across implementation, product, engineering, sales, support, and executive teams

  • Comfort using data, customer health signals, and AI-enabled tools to understand account health and adoption progress

  • The ability to synthesize project details into an accurate account narrative without owning every administrative detail

  • Willingness to travel 25%, with occasional fluctuations during customer launch periods

A major plus if you also bring:

  • Experience in residential homebuilding, construction technology, AEC, manufacturing, ERP, or other operationally complex industries

Working at Higharc

Remote work and travel: Our company is entirely remote, and has been since we were founded in 2018. Remote work means more time with family, less time commuting, and the flexibility to blend work and life. We value in-person collaboration and asynchronous deep-work time, which is why we schedule regular team meet-ups in our hubs across the US and, depending on the role, prioritize hiring in those hubs. If your role requires frequent travel beyond pre-scheduled team meet ups, we will represent that to the best of our ability as early as possible in the interview process.

Compensation and benefits: Higharc offers competitive salaries with significant equity, in a fast-growing, well-funded company. We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with flexible PTO, and meaningful maternity/paternity leave to all U.S based employees that are full-time. You'll also have access to other big-company benefits such like short and long-term disability plans and a 401K. We also provide a stipend to create the ideal home office and support ongoing L&D.

Please note: we are seeing an uptick of fraudulent recruiting activity claiming to be associated with Higharc. All communication and outreach from our in-house team will come from an @higharc.com email address.

Service areas include architecture + interiors, civil engineering, construction solutions, environmental, investigative, land surveying, planning + economic development, structural engineering, transportation, and utility infrastructure

Group: Federal

Location: Remote – U.S. based

We are making a deliberate, multi-year investment to expand and strengthen our federal practice across the Department of Defense and select federal civilian agencies. We are seeking a Federal Executive to provide Executive/Officer level leadership, vision, and strategic direction for the Federal Group and its role within American Structurepoint.

This person will lead federal practice pursuits and efforts, including the strategic efforts of a diverse team of specialized technical leaders.

The selected candidate will drive agency engagement, IDIQ/MATOC positioning, and capture excellence — while also expanding the firm’s relationships with prime general contractors to secure increased Designer of Record (DOR) roles on federal design/build projects.

This is a build-and-scale opportunity within a financially strong, well-established A/E firm committed to expanding its federal footprint. The ideal candidate is a respected industry leader with extensive experience in Department of Defense architectural building projects, business management, and client development.

Federal Strategic Planning & Business Leadership

  • Lead the development and execution of the Group’s annual and long-term business plans, including growth priorities, market strategy, financial objectives, and organizational capabilities.
  • Identify priority agencies, contract vehicles, and geographic markets aligned with firm capabilities.
  • Shape investment decisions related to capabilities, staffing, and partnerships necessary for federal expansion.

Design/Build & Prime Contractor Engagement

  • Identify high-performing federal primes and cultivate long-term teaming alignment.

  • Ensure capture strategy translates into compelling, compliant proposals.

Strategic Teaming & Partnerships

    • Prime/sub partnerships
    • Strategic sub-consulting agreements
    • Mentor-Protégé programs
    • Joint Ventures
  • Build a durable partner ecosystem aligned with the firm’s federal growth objectives.

Relationship Management & Market Presence

  • Establish and maintain senior-level relationships within DoD and federal civilian agencies.
  • Engage contracting officers, program managers, small business offices, and program stakeholders.
  • Represent the firm at industry events, pre-proposal conferences, and agency briefings.
  • Increase the firm’s visibility and credibility within priority federal markets.
  • Other duties as assigned

  • Experience expanding A/E participation in federal design/build projects.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title - IP LawyerAbout the RoleWe are seeking a highly-skilled and commercially-aware IP Lawyer to lead the protection and management of the organisations intellectual property assets in the cybersecurity and IT services domain.
jobs.description:
Job Title - IP Lawyer

About the Role

We are seeking a highly-skilled and commercially-aware IP Lawyer to lead the protection and management of the organisations intellectual property assets in the cybersecurity and IT services domain. The role encompasses strategic oversight of IP strategy and policy, hands-on execution of filings, enforcement, licensing and ensuring the businesss technology and brand assets are safeguarded and monetised appropriately.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and implement a comprehensive IP strategy aligned with business goals: map asset types (trademarks, patents, copyrights, trade secrets, software code) by geography and class, and manage annual filing/renewal road-maps.

Conduct IP clearance and due-diligence searches for trademarks, patents, designs, software modules and domains; advise on go/no-go decisions for new product launches or branding initiatives.

Manage prosecution and portfolio maintenance: supervise filings, handle examiner actions, coordinate renewals, recordals, and maintain an audit-ready docket or registry.

Oversee enforcement and dispute resolution: respond to infringements (digital, counterfeiting, domain abuse), handle takedowns, oppositions/cancellations, customs seizures, UDRP/URS, litigation support as required.

Draft, review and negotiate IP-related provisions in commercial agreements: licensing, technology transfer, distribution, service contracts, software-as-a-service (SaaS) and outsourcing agreements.

Provide IP guidance and training to internal stakeholders (engineering, product, marketing, sales) on correct use of IP, brand protection, open-source compliance and risk mitigation.

Engage and manage external counsel, agents and service providers; monitor budgets and deliverables associated with IP enforcement, filings and licenses.

Monitor market developments, IP jurisprudence, regulatory changes in the UAE/GCC region and globally; integrate insights and recommend improvements or SOPs for IP protection.

Prepare and present regular reports and dashboards to senior management or board: portfolio performance, risk exposures, KPI tracking (e.g., registration success rate, average time to takedown, cost-benefit).

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.), Juris Doctor (J.D.) or equivalent; admission to practise in at least one recognised jurisdiction.

Minimum 57 years of hands-on experience in intellectual property law (preferably within software/IT services or cybersecurity) experience in the UAE/GCC region is highly desirable.

📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Vous intervenez au sein d’une équipe réunissant des experts en cybersécurité, des architectes, des équipes infrastructures et des partenaires externes. Vous veillez à la bonne exécution de projets de sécurité à forte composante technique, en assurant leur alignement avec les besoins métier, les contraintes organisationnelles et les exigences réglementaires.

Vous intégrez l’équipe de gestion de projets du pôle sécurité, sous la supervision du responsable de pôle, avec une coordination fonctionnelle assurée par un chef de programme en charge du portefeuille cybersécurité.

Missions principales

  • Assurer la livraison des projets dans les délais et avec le niveau de qualité attendu.
  • Piloter des projets de cybersécurité de bout en bout, de l’étude jusqu’à la mise en production.
  • Définir le périmètre, les objectifs, le planning, les ressources, les budgets et les livrables.
  • Identifier, analyser et suivre les risques projet.
  • Assurer le reporting auprès des instances de gouvernance et des sponsors.
  • Organiser et animer les réunions de travail, ateliers et comités de pilotage.
  • Contribuer aux projets de sécurité des infrastructures IT.

Les interventions portent principalement sur des projets IAM couvrant notamment :

  • le cadrage, la sélection, le déploiement et la mise en production de composants IAM ;
  • la gestion du cycle de vie des identités et des comptes : arrivée, mobilité, changement de fonction et départ ;
  • le provisioning et le déprovisioning automatisés des accès ;
  • la définition des rôles et des habilitations, avec application des principes de moindre privilège, de séparation des tâches et de RBAC ;
  • la fédération d’identités, le Single Sign-On, l’authentification multifacteur, l’authentification sans mot de passe et les approches Zero Trust ;
  • les campagnes de revue et de certification des accès, la traçabilité et le reporting de conformité ;
  • l’intégration de l’IAM avec les référentiels RH, les annuaires, les applications, les environnements cloud et les services d’infrastructure ;
  • la prise en compte des comptes à privilèges, des comptes techniques et des identités non humaines, en coordination avec les dispositifs PAM ;
  • la migration des identités et des habilitations, les tests, la conduite du changement et l’adoption par les utilisateurs ;
  • des projets complémentaires liés aux architectures SASE, ZTNA, VPN, pare-feu, réseaux sécurisés et environnements cloud.

Les projets confiés peuvent aller d’études stratégiques et de consultations de marché à des déploiements opérationnels de solutions de sécurité.

Coordination des parties prenantes

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes infrastructures, réseaux, cloud, sécurité et les fournisseurs.
  • Faciliter les arbitrages entre besoins métier, contraintes techniques et exigences de sécurité.
  • Garantir une coordination fluide entre l’ensemble des intervenants du projet.
  • Accompagner les équipes durant les phases de migration, de test, de validation et de mise en production.

Selon les priorités du service, vous pouvez également contribuer à d’autres thématiques du programme sécurité.

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée en gestion de projet, avec une expérience récente et démontrable de mise en œuvre d’une solution IAM dans un environnement complexe, idéalement au sein d’une organisation de grande taille ou d’un contexte hybride.

Vous êtes capable de transformer des besoins métier et de sécurité en une feuille de route IAM réaliste, de gérer les dépendances techniques et organisationnelles, et de conduire la solution jusqu’à son adoption et son exploitation.

La connaissance d’autres domaines de sécurité des infrastructures constitue un atout complémentaire, notamment PAM, PKI, HSM, sécurité cloud, réseaux, pare-feu, VPN, SASE ainsi que les référentiels de cybersécurité tels que NIS2 et ISO27001.

Compétences attendues :

  • solide capacité de coordination ;
  • gestion de projet et gestion des risques projet ;
  • gestion du changement humain ;
  • gestion des fournisseurs et des marchés publics ;
  • maîtrise des concepts et solutions IAM, RBAC, Zero Trust, SSO et PAM ;
  • bonne compréhension de PKI, HSM, réseaux, pare-feu, VPN, SASE et sécurité cloud ;
  • excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et orale.

Qualités personnelles recherchées :

  1. Leadership et capacité à fédérer des équipes pluridisciplinaires.
  2. Sens de l’organisation et des priorités.
  3. Esprit d’analyse et capacité de synthèse.
  4. Rigueur méthodologique.
  5. Autonomie et proactivité.
  6. Diplomatie et aptitude à faire converger des intérêts parfois divergents.
  7. Capacité à vulgariser des sujets complexes auprès de publics non techniques.

La maîtrise du français est requise.

Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

  • Facilitate and lead project kick‑off, safety, and execution alignment meetings with key internal and external stakeholders to establish roles, responsibilities, and delivery expectations.

  • Complete formal project closeout activities, including financial closeout, documentation archiving, client acceptance, and lessons‑learned workshops to support continuous improvement. [

  • Remain current on project management best practices, PMAP methodologies, utility delivery trends, and Power Delivery industry standards

  • Collaborate with cross‑disciplinary professionals to deliver integrated, future‑ready power delivery solutions, strengthening WSP’s position as a trusted advisor to utility clients.

Who You Are

  • 12+ years of progressive post‑education experience in a project management or senior technical leadership role, preferably supporting power delivery, transmission & distribution (T&D), substation, or utility capital projects.

LMI is seeking a Platform Engineer to design, deploy, operate, and sustain secure cloud-native platform capabilities for a Department of War mission partner. This remote role will focus on Amazon Web Services (AWS)-hosted Kubernetes environments that connect to and operate within the Department of Defense Information Network (DODIN). The Platform Engineer will support platform architecture, infrastructure automation, container orchestration, application onboarding, cybersecurity compliance, observability, troubleshooting, and continuous service improvement. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who can translate mission and application requirements into reliable, repeatable, secure, and supportable platform services.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors, helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

This is a remote position within the continental United States and requires an active Secret security clearance. The employee must be available during core working hours aligned to the mission partner and may be required to travel periodically to government or LMI locations for integration, testing, maintenance, or mission support.

Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, configure, operate, and sustain AWS-based platform services supporting mission-critical Department of War applications and workloads.
  • Administer Kubernetes clusters and supporting services, including cluster configuration, node groups, namespaces, role-based access control, ingress, service discovery, storage, secrets management, network policies, autoscaling, upgrades, and lifecycle maintenance.
  • Build and maintain repeatable infrastructure and platform configurations using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or equivalent customer-approved technologies.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, GitOps workflows, container registries, artifact repositories, automated testing, and deployment controls.
  • Onboard, configure, deploy, and sustain containerized applications across development, test, staging, and production environments.
  • Integrate platform services with DODIN network services, identity and access management, public key infrastructure, logging, monitoring, vulnerability management, endpoint security, and other government enterprise services.
  • Implement and maintain secure platform configurations aligned with approved security baselines, Defense Information Systems Agency Security Technical Implementation Guides, Risk Management Framework requirements, and Authority to Operate conditions.
  • Monitor platform availability, performance, capacity, security posture, and application health using AWS-native and customer-approved observability tools.

The American Heart Association has an excellent opportunity for a Senior Program Manager, Mission Advancement Operations.

This position can be home-based.

Mission Advancement is a 100+ person department accountable for outright and deferred major and principal gift revenue development from individuals, as well as for foundation giving and government funding. Mission Advancement Operations provides the strategies, programs, processes, systems, and workforce capabilities that enable the department to achieve its annual goals and advance its long-term transformation. Mission Advancement revenue has doubled during the past five years through the combined strength of donor- and volunteer-facing teams and strategically designed operational infrastructure. We intend to build on this trajectory through integrated processes and systems, workforce development, and emerging technologies that strengthen future capabilities.

Mission Advancement Operations provides revenue-generation infrastructure and business operations services. Revenue-generation infrastructure includes individual and foundation prospect research, portfolio management, lead-generation and content marketing communications, donor and professional advisor engagement, operation of the American Heart Association Professional Advisor Network, proposal development, and resource management. Business operations services include budget management, talent development and training, performance management, gift processing, reporting and compliance submissions. The division also manages a robust technology portfolio comprising an average of 10–15 active projects across these service areas.

Responsibilities

Reporting to the National Vice President, Development Operations, the Senior Program Manager, Mission Advancement Operations leads planning, implementation, and performance reporting for a broad portfolio of operational and transformation priorities. The role provides the structure, coordination, and execution discipline needed to advance work across the full scope of Mission Advancement Operations and to communicate progress, outcomes, and return on investment.

This position translates operational vision, priorities, and assignments into structured implementation plans, delivery, and measurable results. While project management and communication are critical strengths of the individual in the position, this is a delivery role, responsible not only for planning and coordinating but also for getting work done.

The position may supervise up to one staff member and is accountable for establishing the program management structure and execution discipline required to advance the operational and transformation portfolio.

Advance Operational Excellence

  • Translate operational vision and priorities into clear and actionable program plans, workstreams, milestones, ownership, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Develop and manage the portfolio of Mission Advancement Operations goals and projects. Maintain visibility into progress, risks, decisions, outcomes, and staff contributions across the portfolio; elevate matters requiring National Vice President action or direction; and drive timely decision-making and follow-through.
  • Lead cross-functional planning and implementation for annual and multi-year operational priorities in partnership with the National Vice President, Operations Leadership Team, and other stakeholders. Facilitate planning and solution development, establish roadmaps and project plans, clarify participant roles, maintain action-item accountability, monitor progress, and recommend corrective action when needed.
  • Ensure completed projects and initiatives transition successfully to operational owners with appropriate documentation, controls, and sustainment plans.

Advance Operational Technology and Transformation

  • Manage day-to-day delivery across the technology project portfolio. Coordinate follow-up with Business Technology implementers, monitor milestones and dependencies, resolve execution barriers, and provide the National Vice President with clear updates on progress, exceptions, decisions, and escalation needs.
  • Work closely with the VP and operations leadership colleagues to implement the ELEVATE vision for technology-enabled transformation.
  • Ensure the identification, documentation and establishment of the semantic layer needed for future transformative technology projects across Mission Advancement.
  • Establish and maintain Mission Advancement agent register
  • Coordinate approved artificial intelligence, automation, Copilot, and agent-enabled initiatives including support for engagement related to workforce upskilling.

Workforce Effectiveness and Change Enablement

  • Manage the Mission Advancement onboarding and offboarding process and resources, including the strategic content development of role-specific plan templates, development and maintenance of Mission Advancement subject matter expert presentations, coordination with national HR onboarding, and engagement/notification of stakeholders.
  • Project manage the implementation of prioritized improvements arising from employee engagement surveys and other department feedback.
  • Plan and oversee Mission Advancement department meetings and Operations Division meetings. Develop agendas with leadership input; coordinate presentations, executive talking points, production, and stakeholder readiness; and ensure decisions and follow-up actions are documented and advanced.
  • Prepare for and oversee production of the annual Mission Advancement Awards, Operations Division awards and related processes and materials.
  • Coordinate approved professional development initiatives for Mission Advancement, including implementation planning, stakeholder communication, participation support, and progress tracking, as directed by the National Vice President.

Staff Supervision

  • May supervise, coach, and develop up to one staff member.
  • Establish clear priorities, performance expectations, development objectives, and workload alignment.
  • Delegate appropriate project coordination, documentation, reporting support, meeting logistics, and action tracking while maintaining accountability for timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Maintain an operating model that distinguishes senior program management responsibilities from project coordination support.

Division Performance Measurement

  • Partner with the National Vice President and Operations leaders to establish a layered portfolio of key performance indicators across the division’s scope. Track and analyze results, develop clear reports and infographics, and validate data with workstream owners to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent reporting.
  • Alert to opportunities, recommendations for action, and escalation points for the National Vice President.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum five (5) years of management experience in the nonprofit setting, to include project management, program management, campaign management, and/or P&L responsibility.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs or projects from planning to execution to final reporting.
  • Experience translating a senior leader’s vision and priorities into implementation plans, coordinated workstreams, and measurable results.
  • Experience applying project management, operational improvement, and change enablement practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to establish structure, clarify ownership, manage dependencies, drive accountability, and advance work through completion.
  • Experience developing and using KPIs, project plans, dashboards, performance measures, status reports, and decision-support materials.
  • Experience with strategic business development and management related to technology projects.
  • Working knowledge of foundation giving, major and legacy gift development, and the infrastructure supporting this area of development operations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, facilitation, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and coordinate work across teams in a hierarchical culture without relying on formal authority.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work with limited supervision.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, GenAI, project management, and collaboration tools.
  • Experience supervising, coaching, or directing the work of a staff member.
  • Ability to travel up to 5%, including occasional overnight travel.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Training

  • Direct experience and/or working knowledge of lead generation marketing, prospect research, proposal development, and stewardship communications.
  • Experience or working knowledge of the financial and estate planning advisory industry.
  • Experience in a national nonprofit organization.
  • Hands-on experience supporting operational transformation, process automation, artificial intelligence, Copilot, agent-enabled workflows, CRM, data, or digital transformation initiatives.
  • Experience coordinating onboarding, offboarding, professional development, employee engagement, or workforce activation programs.

Compensation & Benefits

jobs.excerpt: OverviewBerryDunn is seeking an experienced Senior Consultant, Medicaid Funding and Acquisition to join our Medicaid Practice Group within our Consulting Team.
jobs.description:
Overview

BerryDunn is seeking an experienced Senior Consultant, Medicaid Funding and Acquisition to join our Medicaid Practice Group within our Consulting Team. This position is planned to serve state Medicaid agency clients across the country and support engagements (primarily Delaware and Puerto Rico) focused on Medicaid financing, planning, procurement, and implementation activities.

You will support engagement leads and project teams that assist state Medicaid agencies with Advanced Planning Document (APD) narrative and budget development, Outcomes-Based Procurement (OBP) planning and execution, stakeholder coordination, research, and related advisory services. In this role, you will take ownership of assigned tasks, work packages, and smaller workstreams; develop and review client-ready deliverables; coordinate with junior team members when needed; and help clients navigate Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) funding and procurement expectations under the direction of engagement/project leadership.

The ideal candidate brings strong Medicaid consulting, writing, analytical, and client-service skills, with the ability to operate independently within defined assignments while escalating questions, risks, and decisions appropriately. Successful candidates will be comfortable managing multiple tasks, facilitating portions of meetings, synthesizing complex information, identifying risks and dependencies, and producing high-quality deliverables that support Medicaid program modernization and related funding and acquisition efforts.

Travel Expectations: This role may require up to 25% travel to support client engagements, including on-site meetings, planning sessions, procurement activities, and key project milestones for assigned state or territorial Medicaid clients.

You Will

  • Support the development of APD narratives, Medicaid Detailed Budget Tables, budget documentation, and other CMS submission materials, taking ownership of assigned sections or work packages.
  • Support engagement/project leads by researching and applying APD processes, Medicaid funding strategies, cost allocation considerations, and federal compliance expectations.
  • Support OBP activities, including procurement planning, requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement, document development, vendor question responses, evaluation support, and related acquisition activities.
  • Develop, review, and refine client deliverables, presentations, reports, meeting materials, procurement documents, and supporting artifacts.
  • Facilitate client, vendor, and internal team meetings; communicate findings, recommendations, risks, and decisions clearly to project leadership and client stakeholders.
  • Manage assigned tasks, small workstreams, timelines, action items, risks, issues, decisions, deliverables, and milestones in coordination with the engagement lead or project manager.
  • Coordinate with project teams to research, analyze, and synthesize Medicaid policy, procurement, funding, operational, and technical information.
  • Coordinate with and provide task-level guidance to junior team members when appropriate, including reviewing assigned work products and providing feedback for quality and consistency.
  • Identify opportunities to improve APD, procurement, and project delivery methodologies and contribute to practice-wide knowledge sharing.
  • Participate in firm-wide initiatives, including internal process improvement, staff development, and business development efforts.

You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in a related field; five years of applicable experience may be substituted for degree requirements.
  • 5-10 years of experience supporting Medicaid agencies, health and human services programs, public sector consulting, procurement, project management, or related advisory services.
  • 3-5 years of experience developing or reviewing clear, concise, and professional written deliverables, including APDs, reports, proposals, procurement documents, policies, business documents, or similar materials.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience and a desire to step into a service and team-oriented leadership role.
  • Demonstrated understanding of CMS APD and procurement requirements, Medicaid funding mechanisms, budgeting, procurement and contracting life cycles, and federal compliance standards.
  • Strong task management, organizational, analytical, research, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently advance assigned responsibilities while coordinating with project leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, prioritize competing deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced client-service environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate meetings and communicate with clients, vendors, project teams, and executive-level stakeholders.
  • High degree of proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and SharePoint.
  • Demonstrated initiative, sound judgment, attention to detail, and commitment to quality.
  • Interest in mentoring junior staff and contributing to practice development, internal process improvement, and business development activities.

Compensation Details

The base salary range targeted for this role is $120,000-$140,000. This salary range represents BerryDunn’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation at the time of posting. If an applicant possesses experience, education, or other qualifications more than the minimum requirements for this posting, that applicant is encouraged to apply, and a final salary range may then be based on those additional qualifications; compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The salary of the finalist selected for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, years of experience, depth of experience, seniority, merit, education, training, amount of travel, and other relevant business considerations.

BerryDunn Benefits & Culture

Our people are what make BerryDunn special, and in return we strive to support our employees and help them thrive. Eligible employees have access to benefits that go beyond what’s expected to support their physical, mental, career, social, and financial well-being. Visit our website for a complete list of benefits and a look into our culture: Experience BerryDunn.

We will ensure that individuals are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process or perform essential job functions. Please contact to request an accommodation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

About BerryDunn

BerryDunn is the brand name under which Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC and BDMP Assurance, LLP, independently owned entities, provide services. Since 1974, BerryDunn has helped businesses, nonprofits, and government agencies throughout the US and its territories solve their greatest challenges. The firm’s tax, advisory, and consulting services are provided by Berry, Dunn, McNeil & Parker, LLC, and its attest services are provided by BDMP Assurance, LLP, a licensed CPA firm.

BerryDunn is a client-centered, people-first professional services firm with a mission to empower the meaningful growth of our people, clients, and communities. The firm has been recognized for its efforts in creating a diverse and inclusive workplace culture, and for its focus on learning, development, and well-being. Learn more at berrydunn.com.

jobs.description:
Overview

At Wipfli, people count.

At Wipfli, our people are core to everything we do—the catalyst behind our ability to create exceptional impact and extraordinary results.

We believe in flexibility. We focus on relationships. We encourage each individual to follow their own path.

People truly matter and they feel it. For those looking to make a difference and find a professional home, Wipfli offers a career-defining opportunity.

Job Summary: The Senior Project Manager is responsible for leading complex, multi‑workstream client engagements with a strong emphasis on delivery excellence, resource optimization, and engagement economics. This role partners closely with service leaders, consultants, and client leadership to ensure projects and programs are delivered on time, within budget, and with appropriate governance, while navigating ambiguity, evolving scope, and imperfect data.

Work Location

This role is open to remote candidates. Due to the geographic distribution of our team and client base, we are primarily focused on candidates located within the Central or Eastern time zones. Candidates should be comfortable working primarily within these time zones to support collaboration with team members and clients. Occasional travel is required (approximately 15%), primarily within the Midwest and East Coast regions.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

Project & Engagement Leadership

  • Lead large, complex projects and portfolios with multiple workstreams, actively managing scope, schedule, budget, risk, and interdependencies
  • Own budget‑to‑actual performance, including forecasting, reconciliation, burn analysis, ETC, utilization, and margin impact
  • Translate delivery risk into financial, operational, and audit‑relevant language; facilitate and lead executive steering committees and governance forums
  • Define, implement, and enforce stage gates, delivery standards, and governance models across engagements

Delivery Enablement

  • Use delivery data and operational metrics (burn, ETC, utilization, risk heatmaps) to drive informed decision‑making
  • Develop and enhance delivery methodologies, templates, and best practices to improve consistency and scalability
  • Build executive‑ready dashboards and narratives from incomplete or evolving data; present program status, risks, and recommendations to executive stakeholders

Tools, Data, and Process Optimization

  • Create and maintain project and program toolkits to enable time, budget, and risk management.
  • Lead or support the implementation and optimization of PSA / PPM tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Mavenlink, OpenAir, Adaptive, Planview)
  • Lead detailed resource planning, capacity planning, and portfolio prioritization across competing initiatives
  • Ensure alignment between SDLC, change management, access controls, and governance frameworks

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 7+ years of project management experience at a professional services firm or 10+ years of industry project management experience with 1+ year at a professional services firm
  • Proven experience leading multi‑workstream programs
  • Demonstrated ownership of engagement economics, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance
  • Experience leading resource management, including capacity planning and portfolio prioritization
  • Experience operating in environments with ambiguity, incomplete requirements, and shifting scope
  • Strong understanding of SDLC frameworks and ability to train and enable teams
  • About 15% of travel to client locations in the U.S.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PgMP or PMP certification
  • Experience aligning SDLC, change management, and access controls.
  • Working knowledge of ERP platforms and delivery of ERP or large technology programs
  • Familiarity with COBIT, ITIL, and GAAP concepts

Benjamin Dzanic, from our recruiting team, will be guiding you through this process. Visit his LinkedIn page to connect!

Additional Details

Additional Details:

Wipfli is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All candidates will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identify, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Wipfli is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, interview, or participate in our recruiting process, please send us an email at .

Wipfli values fair, transparent, and competitive compensation, considering each candidate's unique skills and experiences. The estimated base pay range for this role is $117,000-158,000, with offers typically not made at the maximum, allowing for future salary increases. The actual salary at the time of offer depends on business related factors like location, skills, experience, training/education, licensure, certifications, business needs, current associate pay, and relevant employment laws.

Individuals may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, subject to participation rules and based on a variety of factors including, but not limited to, individual and Firm performance.

Wipfli cares about our associates and offers a variety of benefits to support their well-being. Highlights include 8 health plan options (both HMO & PPO plans), dental and vision coverage, opportunity to enroll in HSA with potential Firm contribution and an Employee Assistance Program. Other benefits include firm-sponsored basic life and short and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) savings plan & profit share as well as Firm matching contribution, well-being incentive, education & certification assistance, flexible time off, family care leave, parental leave, family formation benefits, cell phone reimbursement, and travel rewards. Voluntary benefit offerings include critical illness & accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance, legal, long-term care, pet insurance, ID theft protection, and supplemental life/AD&D. Eligibility for all benefits programs is dependent on annual hours expectation, position status/level and location.

"Wipfli" is the brand name under which Wipfli LLP and Wipfli Advisory LLC and its respective subsidiary entities provide professional services. Wipfli LLP and Wipfli Advisory LLC (and its respective subsidiary entities) practice in an alternative practice structure in accordance with the AICPA Code of Professional Conduct and applicable law, regulations, and professional standards. Wipfli LLP is a licensed independent CPA firm that provides attest services to its clients, and Wipfli Advisory LLC provides tax and business consulting services to its clients. Wipfli Advisory LLC and its subsidiary entities are not licensed CPA firms.
