jobs.excerpt: OverviewHR Acuity’s Professional Services group is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Integration Specialist to join our team.
jobs.description:
Overview

HR Acuity’s Professional Services group is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Integration Specialist to join our team. This role is pivotal in working with our customers during and after implementation, ensuring seamless integration setup, technical expertise, and optimizing integration performance, all of which directly impacts customer satisfaction and HR Acuity’s success. You will collaborate closely with internal teams, including Product Management and Engineering, to influence the development of new tooling and raise/resolve technical issues. Additionally, you will provide training and support to our customer-facing teams, ensuring they are well-equipped to assist clients with integration-related matters.

What this job is
  • A customer-facing role working directly with external clients and owning the communication directly with customers and their IT teams.
  • A project management role, carrying a book of roughly 15 to 20 integration projects at once and driving each to resolution.
  • Hands-on technical work: responsible for data migrations, HRIS changes, and standard/custom integrations.
  • Enterprise API integration work (REST, SOAP, SFTP, webhooks) connecting HR Acuity to systems like HRIS, CRM, and ERP, including for the company's biggest customers.
  • A translator role, turning customer business requirements into technical configurations and troubleshooting issues as they arise.
What this job is not
  • Not an engineering role. The person will not write code.
  • Not a pure back-office or heads-down technical seat. Customer communication is more than half the job.
  • Not a support ticket queue. Support backgrounds can qualify, but only if the candidate has managed projects and done more advanced customer and backend work.

About HR Acuity®At HR Acuity®, we empower our team to #BeBold — embracing innovation and new challenges. We give you the tools to #WorkSmarter and foster the collaboration that makes us #BetterTogether. If you're excited to be part of our growth story, we'd love to chat.About Us: HR Acuity® is the leading provider of employee relations case management and investigation software. We help organizations standardize how workplace issues are reported, documented, and investigated, and our data-driven approach helps clients and partners build trusted, inclusive cultures where employees feel safe.This is an #All-In Zone. We're a fast-growing, innovative company led by a female founder and CEO, and being all-in is the norm here. From the top down, we bring our best every day — fueled by passion for our mission and culture — and we look for teammates who want to do the same.At the same time, we're deeply committed to an inclusive, diverse workplace where different perspectives are valued and respected. We believe in creating an environment where everyone can show up as their authentic self and thrive. If this sounds like you, keep reading.

Click here to learn more about our values and benefits

Please note that for this position, we are only accepting direct applications. Submissions from agencies will not be considered.

The Opportunity

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical setup and integrations configuration for new and existing HR Acuity customers, ensuring all technical requirements are met during the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure a world-class customer experience by providing clear communication, technical expertise, proactive project management.
  • Facilitate and manage the migration of customer data into the HR Acuity platform.
  • Assist Sales and Customer Success teams with technical scoping calls to ensure prospects and customers are properly supported.
  • Translate customer business requirements into technical solutions and configurations.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, providing input based on customer and technical experience to inform upcoming releases.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to identify and report recurring integration challenges.
  • Provide consultative guidance using established best practices to increase customer adoption and drive positive customer outcomes.
  • Scope and document new and existing technical processes/requirements in collaboration with customers and internal teams.
  • Manage and drive special projects and initiatives as assigned by Manager.

What We Offer:

  • A mission‑driven culture that prioritizes people, integrity, and continuous improvement.
  • The opportunity to help shape a growing integrations program in a high‑impact, high‑visibility role.
  • Collaboration with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success to influence strategy and product evolution.
  • A supportive, flexible work environment with a strong focus on work/life balance.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • Professional development opportunities, including access to certifications, training resources, and cross‑functional learning.

What Does Success Look Like?

  • Integrations and migrations are delivered accurately and on time, with exceptional customer satisfaction scores.
  • Professional Services, Sales and Customer Success teams rely on you as a trusted subject‑matter expert, resulting in smoother pre‑sales and onboarding cycles.
  • Recurring integration challenges decrease due to your collaboration with Product & Engineering.
  • Internal teams feel confident and enabled through the process documentation you deliver.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience working with integrations in a technical or implementation-focused role.
  • Track record of working directly with customers, ensuring a positive and effective integration experience.
  • Background in API integrations and enterprise system connections (e.g., REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, SFTP, webhooks).
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical issues and communicate solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong collaboration skills with cross-functional teams, including Product, Engineering, and Sales.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Experience in developing technical documentation and training.
  • Familiarity with CRM, ERP, HCM/HRIS, ATS, and other enterprise software ecosystems (e.g., Workday, ADP, UKG, SAP SuccessFactors, Salesforce).
  • Experience with integration/iPaaS platforms (e.g., Workato, MuleSoft, Dell Boomi) is a plus.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Perks and Benefits

Compensation: The pay range for this position is expected to be between $88,919 to $115,732 however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized, non-discriminatory factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary annual bonus. Additionally, full-time employees are eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefits program, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) retirement plan, life and disability insurance coverages, and other benefits the company may offer from time to time.

Benefits:

    • You can also choose from FSA or HSA options to suit your needs.
  • Save for your future with our 401K plan that matches your contributions.
  • Enjoy paid leave for various life events, such as sickness, disability, or parenthood.
  • Own a piece of the company with our #Allin Shares Program.
  • Company paid holidays, birthday day off, closed 4th of July week and December holiday week and 8 hours of volunteer time.
  • Half day summer Fridays* and half day first Fridays* to catch up on work, personal development, or an afternoon off.

Perks:

  • Take a break from work with our unlimited PTO policy to refresh and recharge.
  • Company paid holidays, birthday day off, closed 4th of July week and December holiday week, half day summer Fridays* and half day first Fridays*, and 8 hours of volunteer time.
  • Own a piece of the company with our #Allin Shares Program.
  • Earn extra cash by referring qualified candidates to join our team.
  • Access professional and personal support through our employee assistance program.
  • Work from anywhere with our remote work environment that fosters collaboration and creativity.*

  • Receive a competitive salary and meaningful opportunities for growth.

Learning and Development

jobs.excerpt: Job SummaryThe Program Manager I will provide program management, technical, and coordination support to EMPOWER partners in South America to strengthen El Niño preparedness and readiness for rapid, partner-led emergency response.
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Program Manager I will provide program management, technical, and coordination support to EMPOWER partners in South America to strengthen El Niño preparedness and readiness for rapid, partner-led emergency response. The position will support implementation of preparedness activities across priority countries and hotspots, helping translate hazard, vulnerability, market, operational, and partner-capacity information into practical readiness actions, quality program designs, and activation-ready response plans.

Working under the guidance of the Program Manager II and in coordination with technical, MEAL, supply chain, finance, safeguarding, and operations colleagues, the Program Manager I will accompany partners to complete priority preparedness deliverables, address program bottlenecks, test readiness arrangements, and maintain country-level materials that can be rapidly adapted when an EMPOWER/RAPID response is activated.

Roles and Key Responsibilities

  • Support implementation of the El Niño preparedness workplans across assigned South America countries or hotspots in coordination with EMPOWER partners, country teams, RAPID counterparts, and technical and operational colleagues.
  • Maintain detailed activity plans, deliverable trackers, meeting records, and follow-up actions that connect program, MEAL, partnership, cash and voucher assistance, supply chain, finance, safeguarding, and operational readiness tasks.
  • Compile and synthesize available hazard, vulnerability, exposure, seasonal, and scenario information to help identify priority locations, population groups, likely needs, access constraints, and preparedness triggers for drought, floods, food insecurity, wildfires, and related El Niño impacts.
  • Support stakeholder and service mapping with partners, including government authorities, Caritas structures, humanitarian coordination bodies, community actors, technical services, financial service providers, and other response stakeholders.
  • Facilitate partner working sessions to develop or update country- and hotspot-specific contingency plans, response strategies, sector and modality options, targeting approaches, geographic priorities, and scalable response scenarios.
  • Gather technical inputs and support documentation of minimum program quality standards, intervention packages, eligibility and prioritization criteria, referral pathways, assistance quantities or transfer values, and safe adaptation or substitution rules.
  • Coordinate routine follow-up with supply chain and operations colleagues so proposed relief kits, in-kind assistance, and cash or voucher options reflect assessed needs, market capacity, cultural appropriateness, protection considerations, delivery feasibility, lead times, and cost drivers.
  • Incorporate validated market and logistics findings into program drafts, implementation schedules, modality recommendations, delivery sequencing, contingency options, and procurement inputs.
  • Support partner readiness for cash and voucher assistance, including participant-data requirements, accountability and complaints mechanisms, protection and inclusion measures, reconciliation processes, monitoring, and failed-payment follow-up.
  • Prepare and update activation-ready program materials, including rapid assessment tools, response concept drafts, targeting and registration approaches, implementation plans, staffing assumptions, budget inputs, procurement requests, risk registers, and donor narrative inputs.
  • Monitor assigned preparedness activities and any activated response tasks, flag delays or quality concerns, and support timely corrective action in line with CRS program quality principles and standards, donor requirements, and humanitarian good practice.
  • Work with MEAL and information-management colleagues to adapt practical indicators, data-collection tools, monitoring plans, feedback and response mechanisms, and learning questions for partner use.
  • Support integration of safeguarding, protection mainstreaming, gender, age, disability inclusion, accountability to affected populations, conflict sensitivity, and disaster risk reduction across assessments, designs, partner tools, simulations, and readiness plans.
  • Assist with partner readiness assessments and partner-specific action plans, ensuring that agreed actions, responsibilities, deadlines, support needs, risks, contingencies, and escalation points are clearly documented and followed up.
  • Organize and co-facilitate coaching sessions, workshops, simulations, tabletop exercises, and readiness tests, and prepare agendas, materials, participant records, and follow-up notes.
  • Provide day-to-day accompaniment and practical technical support to partners, adapting tools and guidance to partner priorities and promoting sustainable local ownership of preparedness systems.
  • Contribute to proposal development and resource mobilization through research, technical inputs, drafting, budget inputs, staffing assumptions, and compilation of supporting documentation.
  • Document decisions, lessons, tested approaches, readiness gaps, good practices, and recommendations, and maintain orderly shared files for knowledge management and handover.
  • Compile the final El Niño preparedness package for assigned countries or workstreams, including analyses, plans, tools, MEAL materials, partner action plans, training resources, ownership arrangements, and maintenance recommendations.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager Hardware
jobs.excerpt: OverviewRachio is looking for a Senior Product Manager Hardware to own one of Rachio's hardware lines end to end: the roadmap for that line, the product definition behind each device in it, and the stage gates that take a concept from idea through EVT, DVT, and PVT to a product that ships on time, in full, and at the right cost.
jobs.description:
Overview

Rachio is looking for a Senior Product Manager Hardware to own one of Rachio's hardware lines end to end: the roadmap for that line, the product definition behind each device in it, and the stage gates that take a concept from idea through EVT, DVT, and PVT to a product that ships on time, in full, and at the right cost.

Our hardware portfolio spans smart sprinkler controllers, hose timers, outdoor lighting, and the partner and OEM products we build with and for others, along with the tethered software experiences (setup, control, and device features in the Rachio app) that make them work. You will own a subset of these hardware programs from its roadmap, its definition, requirements, and its results - and how it feeds it into the portfolio roadmap.

The role is inherently technical and inherently commercial. You are measured on shipping products customers love - on time, at cost, and at quality - and on how your line performs in market: activation, returns, CSAT, and attach to software and subscriptions. Not on the volume of specs written. You work daily with Engineering (firmware, electrical, mechanical, and industrial design), Supply Chain and Operations, Design, Support, Finance, and Sales. You will spend real time with customers - homeowners and professional installers - and real time at the factory. This enables our customer driven approach and how we solve customer pain points in our roadmap.

A note on how this role works. Rachio runs a flat organization that maintains high ownership and a fast-paced start-up culture. This is an individual contributor role. Your influence comes from the quality of your product judgment, the clarity of your writing, and your credibility with the engineers, designers, and operators who build what you define. If there is a gap in the organization or resourcing standing between your product and its launch, you are expected to step in and close it. When the same gap shows up a second time, you are expected to fix what produces it.

We also expect you to work AI-natively: using AI for the research synthesis, data analysis, and first drafts that used to take days, so your time goes to customers, evaluating trade-offs, and focusing on strategic debates.

Responsibilities

Own your line's roadmap and product definition

  • Own the roadmap for your hardware line across new products, line extensions, and lifecycle work on what has already shipped, kept led by data: customer research, product telemetry, support and returns data, channel input, and competitive intelligence.
  • Write the "working backwards" documents for each new product and major feature in your line: the customer problem, the value to customers, partners, and channels, the target price and cost, the success criteria, and the questions we have to answer before we commit.
  • Turn those into detailed, crisp business requirements and user stories that Engineering and Design can build to, spanning hardware, firmware, and the tethered app experience.
  • Manage the trade-offs among customer experience, performance, cost, schedule, and operational support load - and make the call, with a written rationale, when they conflict.
  • Feed the portfolio roadmap: bring the Director of Product the evidence, the sequencing constraints, and the bets you think are worth making in your category.

Run the product development process for your line

  • Run your line's stage gates as a mechanism, not a meeting: concept through EVT, DVT, PVT, and ramp, with clear owners and exit criteria at each, and an honest review of what we learned at the end.
  • Contribute to engineering decisions on technology and architecture - radios and protocols, sensors, power, enclosures - with enough fluency to be useful in the room and to recognize when a decision is a one-way door.
  • Know when a problem belongs to Design, hand it over cleanly, and facilitate their design development process rather than direct it.

Integrate with Supply Chain and Operations

  • Work with Supply Chain from concept forward on cost targets, supplier and contract manufacturer selection, tooling, and certification timelines, so initial inventory availability and delivery SLAs are set before we sell the product, not after.
  • Own the product inputs to supply and demand planning for your line: launch quantities, ramp assumptions, and transition and end-of-life plans.
  • Surface component shortages, cost overruns, schedule slips, and quality escapes early enough that we can still do something about them.

Launch your line, and close the loop

  • Partner with Product Marketing on your line's launches: crisp definition of the product experience (hardware and software) and its value to the customer, plus the technical inputs that positioning, packaging, and channel enablement depend on.
  • Own launch readiness on the product side: certification, firmware and app readiness, in-box content, support documentation, and the go/no-go criteria for build and ship.
  • Own and close the post-launch feedback loop: what is confusing customers, what is driving returns and support contacts, and what we fix in the next firmware or hardware revision.
  • Work closely with Engineering and project management to deliver on schedule.
  • Instrument your line so success is measurable: activation, engagement, return rate, defect and warranty rates, CSAT/NPS, and attach to software and subscription offerings.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • You have been the lead PM on at least two consumer hardware products through a complete cycle - concept, definition, development, certification, launch - and stayed with it in the market long enough to live with your own decisions. One product you can discuss in real depth beats five you touched.
  • You have been in the builds. You have sat through EVT and DVT reviews, read failure analysis, and been part of a decision to re-tool or to ship as-is.
  • Hands-on fluency across mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial design, and firmware. You do not need to be able to do all four. You do need to have worked closely enough with all four to hold your own: read a schematic and a mechanical drawing, know roughly what a tolerance change or an antenna placement costs, and tell when an estimate is soft.
  • You have shipped through contract manufacturers and know what DFM, tooling timelines, and certification (FCC, UL, CE) actually require.
  • Working knowledge of embedded firmware, mobile technology, web services, and back-end application infrastructure - enough to reason about what a feature actually requires.
  • You have taken a hardware concept from raw product intuition through fast, measurable tests to a decision - including the tests that killed the idea.
  • You direct AI to do work that used to take days - research synthesis, data analysis, first drafts - and you are clear about where its judgment ends and yours begins.
  • Exceptional written communication. You can distill a complex set of trade-offs into a written narrative a leadership team can act on.
  • Comfort operating as a hands-on individual contributor. You write the working backwards doc, build the requirements, run the gates, and sit in the DVT review yourself rather than assigning it.
  • Bachelor's degree.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with smart home platforms and protocols - Matter, Thread, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth - and the platform partners that certify them.
  • Experience in two-step distribution or professional trade channels (irrigation, landscape, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, building products) alongside retail and D2C.
  • Experience with outdoor products, lighting, water management, or the sustainability categories.
  • Experience with partner, OEM, or white-label hardware programs.
  • Experience running a product line through an NPI or stage-gate process you did not design - and improving it from the inside.
  • Hands-on experience maintaining a residential yard and irrigation system (or willing and able to).
  • Engineering degree or advanced degree.

Salary range for candidates based in California: $201,000 - $302,000

Salary range for candidates based in Colorado - New York- New York City or Maryland : $188,000 - $282,000

Salary ranges include base salary and annual incentive bonus if applicable.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityRS&H is seeking an experienced Data Solutions Architect to design and deliver secure, scalable, and client-focused data and artificial intelligence solutions across our aviation, federal, transportation, aerospace, health and science, and corporate market sectors.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

RS&H is seeking an experienced Data Solutions Architect to design and deliver secure, scalable, and client-focused data and artificial intelligence solutions across our aviation, federal, transportation, aerospace, health and science, and corporate market sectors.

In this highly influential technical role, you will transform complex and inconsistent data into trusted pipelines, analytical models, predictive solutions, and visualizations that support critical client decisions. You will also identify recurring market needs and help turn early-stage concepts into configurable, production-ready digital offerings. The majority of this role focuses on advancing data and AI solutions from concept through requirements, architecture, development, testing, validation, and deployment. You will establish technical standards, strengthen data governance and model lifecycle practices, and lead a community of practice that builds data capabilities across the organization. This position has no direct reports but provides authoritative technical direction, guidance, and mentorship to project teams, architects, engineers, and junior staff.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Design and Deliver Data and AI Solutions
    • Lead the development of data, analytics, artificial intelligence, and visualization offerings, supporting solution scoping, client pursuits, production-grade delivery, governance, and data-practice enablement.
    • Translate challenges in buildings, infrastructure, and construction management into reusable data and AI products with clearly defined interfaces and service levels.
    • Design reusable solutions using application programming interfaces (APIs), event streams, curated datasets, feature stores, and visualization layers.
    • Prepare system diagrams, architecture decision records, data contracts, reference implementations, and build-versus-buy recommendations.
    • Architect geospatial intelligence solutions that integrate geographic information system (GIS) data, two-dimensional drawings, three-dimensional models, operational information, and sensor data.
    • Develop and deploy analytical and predictive models using time-series forecasting, causal inference, ensemble methods, and other machine learning techniques.
    • Create and operationalize interactive dashboards, analytical interfaces, and visualizations using Power BI and related tools.
    • Translate model outputs and statistical findings into actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Advance associate-developed generative AI prototypes into secure, reliable, production-ready solutions.
    • Establish data quality requirements, validation processes, and remediation approaches as solutions move from development into production.
    • Incorporate data ownership, stewardship, lineage, quality, access controls, and model lifecycle management throughout solution development.
    • Design solutions that address architecture, engineering, construction, and public-sector requirements, including Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), NIST 800-171, Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC), client data isolation, operational technology and information technology separation, and Microsoft Government Community Cloud High (GCC High) environments.
    • Develop reusable accelerators, including templates, schemas, connectors, evaluation frameworks, automated validation processes, authorization workflows, and infrastructure provisioning components.
    • Evaluate new ideas against defined advancement criteria and help teams shape concepts into viable data and AI offerings.
    • Collaborate with legal, finance, business subject matter experts, developers, and multidisciplinary product teams throughout the solution lifecycle.
  • Scope End-to-End Solutions
    • Lead and participate in client and stakeholder discovery sessions.
    • Translate business needs and analytical questions into complete digital solution definitions.
    • Develop statements of work, concepts of operations, requirements, technical approaches, levels of effort, resource plans, and delivery schedules.
    • Facilitate meetings and workshops that advance concepts into products or services.
    • Define the analytical, geospatial intelligence, digital twin data, and visualization approaches used within each solution.
    • Develop technical content for proposals, presentations, and pursuit teams.
    • Support client-facing consulting engagements from initial concept and scoping through implementation and delivery.
  • Technical Leadership and Enablement
    • Lead the Data Community of Practice to support knowledge sharing, technical discussions, capability development, data product practices, data quality, and medallion architecture principles.
    • Establish analytical standards, validation methods, governance practices, and model lifecycle processes.
    • Communicate technical architectures, data structures, solution benefits, limitations, and recommendations in clear business terms.
    • Present digital solution concepts and technical strategies to executive leadership and client stakeholders.
    • Mentor architects and engineers in applied data science, model deployment, geospatial analysis, time-series forecasting, digital twin data workflows, and production-grade data practices.
    • Provide technical leadership across multidisciplinary project teams without direct supervisory responsibility.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Geography, or a related quantitative or technical discipline.
  • Fifteen (15) or more years of experience in applied data science, analytics engineering, data architecture, or a related discipline.
  • Full lifecycle experience developing data products, including concept development, requirements, architecture, model development, validation, deployment, and production support.
  • At least five (5) years of experience in client-facing consulting or professional services, including proposing, scoping, and delivering analytical solutions.
  • Current certification in a relevant technology domain or equivalent demonstrated expertise.
  • Mastery of the Python data science ecosystem, including pandas, Polars, NumPy, and SciPy.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and R.
  • Expert knowledge of statistical modeling and machine learning frameworks, including scikit-learn, statsmodels, PyTorch, and TensorFlow.
  • Demonstrated expertise in time-series forecasting, causal inference, feature engineering, and sampling or resampling techniques for imbalanced or sparse data.
  • Strong experience with geospatial analytics and LiDAR processing using tools such as ArcGIS, PostGIS, GeoPandas, GDAL/OGR, and PDAL.
  • Experience working with vector, raster, point-cloud, sensor, and operational data.
  • Deep experience with MLOps and model lifecycle management, including containerization, orchestration, continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD), experiment tracking, model monitoring, drift detection, and production deployment.
  • Experience deploying cloud-based solutions using Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Advanced proficiency in interactive data visualization and dashboard development using Power BI, Tableau, Plotly/Dash, or geospatial visualization tools.
  • Advanced knowledge of responsible AI, data governance, bias detection and mitigation, model explainability, uncertainty quantification, and statistical reliability in regulated environments.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical methods, results, limitations, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
**Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States permanently. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship or visa transfer.**

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Geography, or a related field.
  • Experience productizing prototypes, including software-as-a-service (SaaS) delivery and lean product incubation processes.
  • Domain experience in transportation, aviation, buildings, or construction operations.
  • Experience with traffic sensors, tolling systems, building automation systems, building information modeling (BIM), virtual design and construction (VDC), or facility telemetry.
  • Background in digital simulation environments, operational technology integration, or AI applications for infrastructure systems.
  • Familiarity with foundation model fine-tuning or multimodal modeling involving imagery, geospatial data, text, and sensor data.

Why Join Us

  • Apply your work to problems that matter. The solutions you build support critical infrastructure, facilities, transportation systems, and public programs that communities depend on every day.
  • Bring your own ideas forward. This is a venture environment within an established employee-owned firm where you can identify opportunities, build business cases, and help transform concepts into scalable market-ready solutions
  • Influence enterprise technology strategy. Help establish a trusted data foundation that enables innovation, operational excellence, and informed decision-making across the organization.
  • Lead through technical expertise. Set standards, guide solution architecture, mentor colleagues, and strengthen data and AI capabilities across the firm.
  • Share in what you help build. RS&H is employee-owned, and associates share in the success of the firm they create.

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

Please view Equal Employment Opportunity Posters provided by OFCCP here.

Please note: no agency representation or submissions will be recognized for this vacancy. Candidates should apply directly to this role to be considered. It is the responsibility of all third-party recruiting and employment agencies to know and adhere to our recruiting policy.

The Company

Employee-owned, RS&H is one of the nation’s leading architecture, engineering, and consulting firms, with associates who work hard every day to create tomorrow together. We offer an exceptional journey from start to future. Our integrated teams translate experience into insight, turn challenges into opportunities, and build relationships that are as strong as the buildings and infrastructure we deliver together. We attribute our success to our unwavering commitment to our core values: integrity, accountability, curiosity, and teamwork.

jobs.title: Manager, Talent Account Management
jobs.excerpt: OverviewTogether, We Enhance Innovation and Growth The Manager, Talent Account Management leads the team of Talent Account Managers (TAMs) who run i2G's hiring process from intake to close.
jobs.description:
Overview

Together, We Enhance Innovation and Growth

The Manager, Talent Account Management leads the team of Talent Account Managers (TAMs) who run i2G's hiring process from intake to close. The TAMs own the hiring manager relationship and the candidate experience once a candidate enters an active process. This Manager makes sure that work is focused on the right roles, delivered to a consistent standard, and measured in a way the business can trust.

The role is accountable for delivery outcomes, reporting, customer satisfaction and escalations. It works from the priority order set jointly with the Capacity Planning Manager, so that TAM time goes to the roles that matter most to i2G's contracts and markets. It operates on Kastle Systems' talent platforms (iCIMS, LinkedIn and Indeed) and draws its candidate supply from Kastle's Sourcing team.

This is a leadership and delivery role, not a sourcing role and not a demand-planning role. It does not own the demand forecast, which sits with the Capacity Planning Manager. It does not own top-of-funnel sourcing, which sits with Kastle's Sourcing team. It owns what happens between those two: turning qualified leads into hires, and doing it well.

Reporting and working relationships

  • Chief Operating Officer, i2G (direct). Sets business priorities for the team, evaluates performance and is the escalation point for delivery and resourcing issues.
  • Senior Director, Talent Acquisition, Kastle Systems (indirect). Sets recruiting process standards, platform usage and compliance expectations, and partners on team practices and reporting.
  • Capacity Planning Manager, i2G (peer). Owns the labor demand forecast and the rolling requisition priority order. The two roles agree together where TAM effort goes each month.
  • Kastle Sourcing team (upstream partner). Supplies sourced and inbound candidates to the TAMs. This Manager owns the quality feedback loop back to Sourcing.
  • i2G hiring managers and branch leadership (customers). The people the TAMs serve. This Manager is the senior point of contact for their satisfaction and their escalations.

Responsibilities

Key responsibilities

1. Team leadership and coaching

  • Lead, coach and develop three Talent Account Managers. Set clear expectations, run regular one-to-ones and case reviews, and give direct performance feedback.
  • Assign requisition portfolios to TAMs based on priority, complexity, market and workload, and rebalance as demand shifts.
  • Set and audit the standard for the TAM role: intake quality, screening rigor, submittal quality, interview coordination, feedback turnaround, offer preparation and close.
  • Coach TAMs on running difficult conversations with hiring managers, including pushing back on unrealistic requirements or slow decisions.
  • Hire, onboard and backfill TAMs as needed, and maintain a development path for the team.

2. Prioritization and alignment with capacity planning

  • Work with the Capacity Planning Manager as the single point of alignment between operations demand and TAM delivery.
  • Run the team from the rolling 90-day requisition forecast and its agreed priority order. Confirm each month which roles get TAM focus first.
  • Make sure TAM effort follows priority, not volume of requests or the loudest hiring manager. Flag when priorities conflict or when demand exceeds what the team can deliver.
  • Take part in the monthly talent acquisition and operations review with data, recommendations and follow-through on decisions.
  • Raise early warning when a priority role is at risk, including the revenue or delivery consequence, so trade-offs are made with full information.

3. Hiring manager partnership and customer satisfaction

  • Own the operating relationship with i2G hiring managers and branch leadership at the leadership level, and hold the TAMs to a consistent service standard.
  • Set and enforce an intake standard so every requisition has a clear profile, priority, compensation range and interview plan before work begins.
  • Coach managers on selection, speed of decision, compensation and the realities of the candidate market. Hold managers accountable to agreed feedback and decision timelines.
  • Measure hiring manager satisfaction on a regular cadence and act on what it shows.
  • Own escalations: receive them, resolve them or route them, and close the loop with the manager and the COO.

4. Candidate experience and delivery quality

  • Set the standard for candidate communication, momentum and trust from first screen through offer and close, and audit against it.
  • Review pipeline health and requisition aging weekly. Intervene on stalled roles, slow feedback, weak submittals and offers at risk.
  • Protect TAM time for moving qualified talent to hire rather than searching from scratch. Send back leads that do not meet the bar, with specific feedback.
  • Measure candidate satisfaction and offer acceptance, and address the causes when either slips.
  • Advise on offer construction and close strategy for critical or hard-to-fill roles.

5. Reporting, metrics and data integrity

  • Publish weekly and monthly reporting to the COO, the Capacity Planning Manager and the Senior Director, Talent Acquisition at Kastle.
  • Report on the measures that show whether the team is converting demand into hires: time to submit, time to fill, submittal-to-interview and interview-to-offer ratios, offer acceptance rate, requisition aging, pipeline coverage by priority role, and hires against the 90-day plan.
  • Report on the experience measures as well: hiring manager satisfaction, candidate satisfaction and escalation volume and resolution time.
  • Keep requisition, candidate and disposition data in iCIMS accurate and current so reporting can be trusted. Audit TAM compliance with data standards.
  • Explain what the numbers mean and recommend action, rather than only publishing them.

6. Partnership with Kastle Sourcing and platform governance

  • Partner with Kastle's Sourcing team on the handoff of sourced and inbound candidates to the TAMs, including lead quality standards and turnaround expectations.
  • Give Sourcing structured feedback on which channels, profiles and searches are producing hires and which are not.
  • Operate within Kastle's talent acquisition process and its platforms (iCIMS, LinkedIn and Indeed). Raise access, configuration and workflow issues with the Senior Director, Talent Acquisition.
  • Make sure TAM practice meets equal opportunity, structured interviewing, offer approval and recordkeeping requirements.
  • Identify process and tooling improvements and bring them forward with data behind them.

Qualifications

Required

  • Five or more years in full-cycle recruiting, talent acquisition or recruiting delivery, including at least two years leading recruiters or a comparable delivery team.
  • Demonstrated experience running a hiring manager-facing recruiting model: intake, prioritization, screening, interview management, offers and close.
  • Experience recruiting for field-based, technical or skilled-trades roles at volume. Relevant sectors include field services, systems integration, construction and specialty trades, engineering services, security, and staffing or recruitment process outsourcing.
  • A record of setting delivery standards, managing to service levels and reporting recruiting metrics to senior leaders.
  • Working knowledge of an enterprise applicant tracking system and its reporting. iCIMS experience is strongly preferred. Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter and Indeed.
  • The credibility and directness to coach senior hiring managers on decision speed, compensation and candidate-market realities, and to hold them to account.
  • Working knowledge of equal opportunity, structured interviewing and recruiting compliance requirements.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including handling escalations calmly and professionally.

Preferred

  • Experience in low-voltage, electronic security, fire, life safety or building systems.
  • Experience managing recruiting for a client or business unit under an account-management or RPO delivery model.
  • Experience recruiting for roles gated by licensing, certification, clearance or badging.
  • Experience working in a matrixed or multi-entity structure, with a direct reporting line in one organization and shared processes and platforms in another.
  • Comfort building dashboards or reports in iCIMS, Excel or a visualization tool.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, human resources or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Competencies

  • Delivery accountability. Owns the outcome, not only the process.
  • Raises the performance of a small team through specific, timely feedback.
  • Influence across two organizations. Works effectively across i2G operations and Kastle talent acquisition without relying on formal authority over either.
  • Prioritization discipline. Holds the team to the agreed priority order and says no to work outside it.
  • Delivers difficult messages to managers, candidates and leaders clearly and constructively.
  • Service orientation. Treats hiring managers and candidates as customers whose experience matters.
  • Data fluency. Uses metrics to find the problem and to make the case for change.

Other Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be able to meet and maintain various certifications, licenses and/or registrations, in accordance with applicable state laws and as required by the electronic security regulations in the state (s) worked.
  • Must be willing to participate in and pass the company’s pre-employment screening process including a background investigation and drug screening.
  • If applicable, must continue to maintain a safe driving record and valid driver’s license to fulfill the travel requirements of this position.

Company Overview

  • 401(k) with Company Match
  • Healthcare Coverage: Medical, Dental, and Vision plans, with most premiums employer-paid
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Mental health and wellness support
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Exempt Positions: Flexible Time Off (FTO)

Detail orientation over speed. This role is judged on whether the build is correct, not how fast it shipped.

Director of Sales (EU)

About Doodle Labs

Doodle Labs builds the connectivity backbone of the autonomous systems revolution — resilient wireless mesh networks that let drones, robots, and unmanned platforms operate reliably in the world's most demanding environments. We sit at the intersection of defense, robotics, and next-generation autonomy, powering the machines that are changing how militaries, first responders, and industries operate in the field. Our core purpose is simple: connect anyone and anything, at any time, in any place.

For over 25 years, our team has been at the forefront of mesh networking, partnering with leading defense programs, robotics manufacturers, and system integrators worldwide. The work here doesn't sit in a slide deck — it ends up in the field, in the hands of people for whom failure isn't an option.

About the Role

The Director of Sales (EU) is a senior, EU-based remote individual contributor responsible for driving revenue growth across key drone and robotics OEM accounts throughout Europe, extending and promoting the Doodle Labs brand as we build out our presence in the region.

In this role, you will pursue new strategic opportunities, develop high-value customer relationships, and guide accounts through the full sales lifecycle—from initial engagement and system integration through production scale. You will work closely with sales engineering and product teams to ensure successful technical adoption of Doodle Labs’ wireless networking technologies.

This position requires a highly driven sales professional who excels at navigating complex technical sales cycles, building executive relationships, and closing multi-stakeholder deals across the unmanned systems ecosystem.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify and win priority drone OEM accounts across the European market
    • Own strategic accounts across the full customer lifecycle from initial engagement through production scale
    • Lead account strategy, executive relationship development, and commercial negotiations
    • Drive complex opportunities from early engagement through integration, qualification, and production deployment
    • Partner closely with Sales Engineering to support technical evaluations and system design-ins
    • Build and maintain a high-quality, forecastable sales pipeline
    • Act as the commercial lead for complex, multi-stakeholder deals across engineering, procurement, and executive leadership

What Success Looks Like

  • Successful acquisition of new drone OEM customers and platform integrations
    • Meaningful revenue growth from priority strategic accounts
    • Expansion of Doodle Labs technology across multiple programs and platforms within key customers
    • Strong relationships with both engineering teams and executive stakeholders
    • Predictable, well-managed pipeline supporting sustained regional growth
    • Qualified pipeline built quickly, with initial customer meetings secured within the first 30 days

Who You Are

  • 5–10 years of B2B hardware sales experience within the drone or unmanned systems industry
    • Proven sales hunter with a track record of closing complex OEM deals
    • Experience selling directly to drone manufacturers or robotics OEMs
    • Ability to lead complex technical sales cycles from first engagement through commercial close
    • Comfortable managing strategic accounts and multi-stakeholder buying processes
    • Strong communication and relationship-building skills
    • Technical or engineering-related educational background
    • Existing right to work within the EU or UK

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with RF or wireless communications technology
    • Experience in tactical communications or the broader unmanned systems industry

• Military background

Why Join Doodle Labs

  • Work on cutting-edge technology powering the future of autonomous systems
    • Collaborate with engineers and innovators building industry-leading connectivity solutions
    • Make a meaningful impact in a fast-growing company shaping the next generation of robotics and wireless networking

Job Title - Senior Manager, Phishing-Takedown

About the Role

We are seeking a seasoned and strategic Senior Manager to lead the phishing takedown function within a cybersecurity or trust & safety organisation. This role will be responsible for overseeing the full lifecycle of phishing incident detection, partner-relationship management (registrars, hosting providers, platforms), rapid takedowns, process refinement and team leadership. The successful candidate will ensure that threats to the organisations brand, customers and digital ecosystem are mitigated swiftly, effectively and globally.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the global strategy for phishing takedown operations: define SLAs (e.g., domain/URL takedown within hours), workflows, escalation paths and performance metrics.

Lead and manage the team responsible for phishing takedown and abuse remediation: set objectives, mentor staff, manage budgets and drive continuous improvement.

Establish and maintain strong relationships with external stakeholders: domain registrars, TLD/ccTLD registries, hosting/CDN providers, law-enforcement liaisons, platform abuse desks and technology partners.

Negotiate outlines of understanding (MOUs), priority takedown agreements, data-sharing or API access with external partners to ensure rapid response capabilities.

Oversee the end-to-end takedown process: from detection/triage of phishing sites, verification, partner engagement, takedown execution, confirmation and reporting.

Collaborate with threat intelligence, SOC, product, legal/compliance and security operations teams to align takedown efforts with broader incident response and brand-protection programmes.

Monitor phishing and digital-abuse trends (domains, impersonation sites, malicious apps, social-media abuse) and use insights to refine strategy, tooling and workflows.

Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of KPIs: takedown time, success rates, volumes, partner performance, cost per case, escalations and residual risk.

Drive automation, tooling and process optimisation: build or refine internal platforms, integrate detection feeds, develop dashboards and enable scaling of operations.

Ensure compliance with relevant laws, internet governance frameworks (ICANN, registrars policies), data-protection, evidence-handling and audit readiness.

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelors degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field. Masters or relevant certification (CISSP, CEH) is a plus.

Minimum 710 years professional experience in phishing takedown, abuse response, brand-protection, trust & safety or cybersecurity operations with proven leadership experience.

Demonstrable experience working with domain registrars/TLDs, hosting/CDN providers, abuse desks, WHOIS/DNS processes, registrar/registry policy, and takedown workflows.

Proven success in managing high-volume takedowns, setting and meeting SLAs, partner management and contract negotiation.

Strong stakeholders/partner-management skills and ability to influence external organisations (registrars, platforms, governments).

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable interpreting detection/incident-data and driving action.

Outstanding communication skills (verbal & written) with ability to engage senior leaders, partners and cross-functional teams.

Familiarity with automation tooling, CI/CD of takedown workflows, dashboards/metrics and threat-intelligence integration.

Key Competencies & Behaviours

Strategic mindset: able to design and implement takedown strategy aligned with business objectives.

Results-oriented: focused on measurable outcomes rapid takedown, reduced risk exposure, partner performance improvements.

Leadership & team building: able to mentor the team, drive high performance and create a culture of continuous improvement.

Influential partner manager: builds trust and credibility with external and internal stakeholders.

Adaptable and resilient: comfortable handling high-pressure incidents, evolving threat landscapes and global operations.

Ethical and trustworthy: ensures high standards of confidentiality, integrity and compliance in all operations.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and performance-based incentives aligned with experience and outcomes.

Opportunity to play a critical leadership role in protecting brand, customers and digital assets from phishing and online abuse.

Exposure to cutting-edge cybersecurity operations, global partner networks and high-impact programmes.

A collaborative, growth-oriented environment with opportunity to shape our takedown strategy and operational architecture.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Senior Interoperability Architect, Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP)

Job Summary:

Aptive seeks a Senior Interoperability Architect to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Office of Clinical Informatics (OCI) on the Operational Informatics Pipeline (OIP) contract. You will develop, refine, and maintain the interoperability specifications, including standards, data models, and profiles, that define how Veteran health information moves between VistA/CPRS, the Federal Electronic Health Record (EHR), the Department of Defense, and community providers. The role supports the Interoperability specialty area, including the Veterans Health Information Exchange (VHIE), FHIR standards innovation, standards-based interfaces, and national exchange frameworks. You will work within Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) Agile Release Trains alongside interoperability specialists, terminologists, and VA Business Owners.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Interoperability Specifications. Develop, refine, and maintain interoperability specifications, including standards, data models, profiles, and implementation guides, for VA exchange use cases.
  • Standards Analysis. Analyze industry standards, VHA business requirements, and relevant technological innovation to recommend specification approaches.
  • HL7 and FHIR Design. Design solutions using HL7 V2, C-CDA, and FHIR, including FHIR profiles and API specifications that extend VA’s use of standards-based APIs.
  • Community Care and Partner Exchange. Define specifications that support exchange with community care providers, the Department of Defense, and other partners, aligned to national exchange frameworks.
  • Device and System Interfaces. Develop standards-based specifications for device and system interfaces that support the Federal EHR.
  • Discovery Projects. Lead discovery and prototyping for new standards needs, such as consent management and time zone interoperability.
  • Conformance and Adoption. Define conformance criteria and testing approaches, and track adoption of standards across VA systems and exchange partners.
  • Federal Policy Alignment. Align specifications with the ONC Standards & Interoperability (S&I) Framework, USCDI, and applicable federal interoperability policy.
  • Architecture Runway Collaboration. Contribute interoperability architecture inputs to OCI’s Architecture Runway Collaborative and to cross-team dependency reviews.
  • Agile Team Participation. Participate in Planning Interval (PI) Planning, backlog refinement, iteration ceremonies, and system demos; help decompose Epics into Features with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Technical Guidance and Briefings. Provide technical guidance to analysts and informaticists, and present architecture recommendations to OCI leadership and VA Business Owners.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in standards development, adoption, and conformance.
  • Experience developing, refining, or maintaining interoperability specifications, such as standards, data models, profiles, or implementation guides.
  • Familiarity with HL7 specifications, including V2, C-CDA, and FHIR.
  • Familiarity with the ONC Standards & Interoperability (S&I) Framework and related federal interoperability policies.
  • Experience analyzing industry standards and business requirements to design interoperability solutions.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a VA background investigation at the level assigned to the position; must reside and work in the United States with U.S. work authorization.

Desired Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in health informatics, computer science, or a related field.
  • HL7 FHIR Proficiency or another HL7 certification.
  • Experience authoring FHIR implementation guides, participating in HL7 workgroups, or sponsoring ballots.
  • Experience with national exchange frameworks, such as eHealth Exchange, Carequality, CommonWell, or TEFCA.
  • Experience with FHIR conformance testing tools, such as Inferno, Touchstone, or the HL7 FHIR Validator.
  • Experience with VA systems, such as VistA/CPRS, VHIE, JLV, or VA Lighthouse APIs, or with the Federal EHR (Oracle Health).
  • Experience on SAFe or Scrum teams.

About Aptive

About Aptive. Aptive partners with federal agencies to achieve their missions through improved performance, streamlined operations and enhanced service delivery. Based in Alexandria, Virginia, we support more than a dozen agencies including Veterans Affairs, Transportation, Defense, Homeland Security and the National Science Foundation. We specialize in applying technology, creativity and human-centered services to optimize mission delivery and improve experiences for millions of people who count on government services every day. Founded: 2012. Employees: 300+ nationwide.

The Engineer will administer and maintain Cribl and Splunk environments, troubleshoot technical issues, perform upgrades, and collaborate with SOC and cross-functional teams on tool integration, tuning, and incident response. The ideal candidate brings strong Splunk engineering experience, hands-on Cribl expertise, and the ability to optimize high-volume security data environments for performance, security, and cost.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Required Experience

  • 4 years of Information Technology Experience
  • Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, Engineering, related degree or an additional two (2) years of experience.
  • 3+ years of Splunk administration or engineering experience.
  • Proficiency in configuring and managing Splunk inputs, setting up data ingestion pipelines, and establishing system connections.
  • Knowledge of Splunk's Search Processing Language (SPL), data parsing techniques, and the use of regular expressions for data extraction and transformation.
  • Skilled in optimizing data pipelines for performance and efficiency, handling large data volumes, and implementing best practices for data integrity and consistency.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Create and manage flows, subflows, and automation using Flow Designer and ServiceNow best practices.
  • Customize and develop Service Catalog items, record producers, workflows, and request fulfillment processes.

  • Maintain platform documentation, including technical specifications, configuration records, and architectural diagrams.

Qualifications

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Security clearance.
  • Bachelors degree and 5 years of relevant experience or equivalent education and experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on ServiceNow development experience, including scripting (JavaScript), integrations, and module configuration.
  • Strong understanding of core ServiceNow applications: Incident, Problem, Change, Request, CMDB, and Knowledge.
  • Experience developing scripts and components such as business rules, client scripts, script includes, UI policies, UI actions, and scheduled jobs.

Preferred:

  • One or more additional ServiceNow certifications, such as:
    • Certified Application Developer (CAD)
    • ITSM, ITOM, CSM micro-certifications
    • Discovery or Service Mapping certifications
  • Experience supporting environments in federal or regulated settings.

Responsibilities

The VP, Finance ERP Implementation & Systems provides senior leadership for EagleBank's Finance ERP transformation, with primary accountability for the successful design, implementation, adoption, and stabilization of Workday Financials. The role leads the Finance workstream across accounting design, chart of accounts, data migration, process redesign, controls, integrations, testing, reporting, training, cutover, and go-live readiness. Following implementation, the position transitions into Finance and Accounting as the enterprise systems owner for the ERP, accountable for platform governance, optimization, financial systems strategy, reporting enablement, and the ongoing alignment of technology with controllership and business priorities. The successful candidate combines executive-level program leadership, strong accounting and controllership knowledge, and hands-on ERP implementation experience. The role serves as the primary connection among Finance, Accounting, Technology, EPMO, Risk, Internal Audit, business stakeholders, Workday, and the implementation partner, and provides clear decision support and escalation to executive governance.

Major Duties & Responsibilities:

Executive ERP Program Leadership

Own the Finance ERP implementation from mobilization through stabilization, including scope, roadmap, milestones, resource planning, budget coordination, dependencies, risks, issues, and business outcomes.

Lead the Finance and Accounting workstream and coordinate day-to-day execution across Workday, the implementation partner, Technology, EPMO, Risk, Internal Audit, and business stakeholders.

Establish program governance, decision rights, design authority, escalation protocols, and executive reporting for the Finance ERP transformation.

Provide clear recommendations to executive sponsors and governance committees on scope, design, risk, readiness, and key implementation decisions.

Hold internal and external workstream leaders accountable for deliverables, quality, timelines, and resolution of cross-functional dependencies.

Finance and Accounting Design

Lead the cleanup, rationalization, and redesign of the chart of accounts, financial dimensions, reporting hierarchies, accounting rules, and supporting data structures.

Partner with Finance leadership to translate accounting, controllership, management reporting, and regulatory requirements into scalable system and process designs.

Ensure the future-state design embeds appropriate internal controls, segregation of duties, auditability, approval authorities, and policy requirements.

Data, Integrations, Reporting, and Controls

Own the Finance data conversion strategy, including extraction, cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and archival of legacy financial data.

Provide business leadership for integrations between Workday Financials and banking, treasury, payroll, procurement, data, reporting, and other enterprise platforms.

Lead the Finance reporting inventory and future-state reporting architecture, including statutory, regulatory, management, operational, and ad hoc reporting needs.

Ensure data integrity, lineage, reconciliation, security, retention, privacy, and audit support throughout implementation and ongoing operations.

Testing, Change, Cutover, and Adoption

Own the end-to-end Finance testing strategy, including unit, system integration, user acceptance, parallel, regression, reporting, security, cutover, and post-production validation.

Lead Finance readiness for deployment, including procedures, training, communications, role definition, support models, cutover planning, and command-center coordination.

Define measurable readiness and acceptance criteria and provide an executive recommendation on go-live preparedness. Lead stabilization and adoption following launch, ensuring issues are prioritized, resolved, documented, and transitioned into sustainable operating processes.

Post-Implementation Finance Systems Ownership

Transition into Finance and Accounting as the enterprise product and systems owner for Workday Financials and related Finance platforms following implementation.

Own ERP governance, configuration standards, release management, enhancement intake and prioritization, access governance, issue resolution, vendor management, and platform controls in partnership with Technology.

Develop and maintain the Finance systems strategy and multi-year roadmap, aligned with accounting, controllership, business, data, risk, and enterprise technology priorities.

Lead continuous optimization of Finance processes, controls, reporting, automation, and user experience while protecting platform stability and data integrity.

Establish service levels, operating procedures, documentation, support responsibilities, performance measures, and governance routines for sustainable platform ownership.

Build and lead Finance systems capabilities and resources as the operating model develops and organizational needs are approved.

Leadership and Stakeholder Management

jobs.description:
Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
Full-time contractor · Fully remote · Latin America only

Cloudnonic is an international, fully remote cloud and software company. We build customized cloud-native systems for clients in Europe and North America, and we're looking for a Semi-Senior QA engineer to join the team.

Who we are

Cloudnonic Corp. is a digitally native software and cloud startup based in the Kitchener/Waterloo area, Ontario, Canada. We're fully remote, with developers in Canada and South America and clients across Europe, North America, and South America. We work across healthcare, finance, construction, and manufacturing, and we take the time to understand each client's industry so we can serve it well with technology.

We're big on AI and the cloud. Our services range from app and web development to AI and cloud integration, plus technology consulting: designing feasible, secure, cost-effective architectures for non-technical clients and advising them on their tech stack.

The role

You'll test across multiple client projects, each with its own platform, users, and quirks. You'll need to understand a new platform quickly and see it the way its end users do: what they expect, where they get confused, and what breaks when they do something nobody planned for.

We ship weekly, from development to staging to production. You'll be the quality gate in between. That includes regression testing: running the same core flows release after release, carefully, every time. If repetition bores you, this isn't the right fit. If you see it as the job that protects users, it is.

We deliver AI-first. AI generates our tickets and acceptance criteria, we pair with AI while developing, and every pull request goes through AI review before a senior engineer reviews it. That makes us fast, and it makes QA more important, not less. We expect you to use AI to generate test cases, draft scripts, and speed up automation, and to know where it falls short: an AI-written test can pass while missing the bug a real user would hit. You need to judge whether a test actually proves something. If you can only run the tests an AI wrote for you, this isn't the role for you.

You'll work closely with developers and project managers, and you'll keep moving our testing forward by adopting new automation tools as they appear. Expect to be challenged constantly, and to enjoy the work along the way.

What you'll do

  • Test new features and bug fixes across multiple client projects before they reach production
  • Run regression testing on core user flows for every release
  • Write clear test cases and test scripts based on acceptance criteria
  • Build and maintain automated tests using modern tools, including AI-powered testing tools
  • Report bugs with precise reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and evidence
  • Evaluate features from the end user's perspective and flag usability issues, not only functional ones
  • Work independently while keeping the team informed

We're looking for a self-starter who organizes their own day. We trust you to prioritize your week and keep everyone updated as you go.

Requirements

Language

  • Fluent Spanish
  • Advanced English (able to discuss issues with the team and clients)

Technical

  • 2+ years of full-time QA experience
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to learn new platforms quickly
  • Experience writing test cases and test scripts
  • Basic technical background: browser developer tools, API testing (e.g., Postman), and basic scripting in JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright or Cypress
  • Experience using AI tools in daily work, including for QA (test generation, test case design, automation)
  • Experience with issue trackers (we use Linear)
  • Experience with Agile methodologies

Bonus

  • Experience testing healthcare or other regulated software
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Fluent English (B2+)
  • Strong written and oral communication

What we offer

  • Fully remote: work from home or anywhere you choose
  • Competitive pay: rates that compete with the best in the Latin American market, tailored to your seniority and skills, paid in the currency you prefer
  • Crypto payment available on request
  • Full-time contractor: you manage your own finances
  • Flexible hours: we work across time zones and trust you to get your work done on your schedule
  • Company culture: no rigid hierarchy; hard work and enjoying the journey are not in conflict
  • Gaming: online games with colleagues over Discord is a regular thing here
  • Broad technical exposure: many platforms and challenges in a short time; you won't get bored in the same project
  • International clients: US, Canada, Germany, and beyond, with the languages and cultures that come with them
  • Professional development: sponsored online courses and certifications on demand
  • Career development: build expertise across industries, not only in testing

Interested?

If this sounds like you and you meet the minimum requirements, apply.

Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a Knowledge Center Team Lead to supervise a team of Tier I Knowledge Center (KC) agents supporting the external industry partners and users of a Department of War agency on its portfolio of mission applications (e.g., DISS, NISS, NBIS). External users reach the KC through a dedicated toll-free number, support email, public web form, and public chatbot, and the KC agent creates and manages the ticket on their behalf. The Team Lead owns real-time team performance against SLAs and XLAs, coaches agents on external-user handling and manual ticket creation, enforces the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and coordinates escalations to application resolver groups. The Team Lead also owns the handoff between the external-facing KC and the internal application resolver groups that support the mission. External users cannot see internal systems, so when a Tier I KC agent cannot resolve an issue, the Team Lead determines the correct resolver group, ensures the ticket is complete and correctly prioritized, tracks it to resolution, and manages communication back to the external user through the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process. This role analyzes escalation patterns to reduce future escalations and is the KC's senior technical resource for complex application issues. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:

  • Supervise a team of Tier I service desk and Knowledge Center analysts across core hours (6:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. ET) and extended-hours shifts, including scheduling, coverage planning, attendance, performance management, coaching, and professional development.
  • Own real-time and daily operational performance: monitor contact volumes, queue health, ticket aging, First Contact Resolution, Tier 0 deflection, and PL1-PL4 SLA adherence, and take corrective action to keep open tickets exceeding resolution SLA within the acceptable quality level.
  • Enforce the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process and ticket documentation standards through a structured quality assurance program, including ticket audits, call and chat reviews, and calibrated feedback.
  • Lead the service desk's response to PL1/PL2 critical incidents, including communications, situational awareness alerts, and coordination with Tier II, endpoint, communications, and application resolver groups.
  • Analyze escalated external-user tickets to determine the correct application resolver group, required information, and Priority Level, and manage seamless, documented handoffs while retaining ownership of the customer outcome.
  • Track escalated tickets against PL1-PL4 resolution SLAs, drive follow-up with resolver groups, and manage external-user communication and the email-based Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process.
  • Serve as the KC's senior technical resource for complex application issues (account, access, role, workflow, and data issues on DISS, NISS, NBIS, and other designated applications), resolving what can be resolved within KC authority.
  • Analyze escalation drivers by application, recommend knowledge articles, chatbot content, and process changes that reduce escalations, and contribute to Problem Resolution Action Plans and the CX Roadmap.
  • Serve as the senior technical decision-maker within Tier I, analyzing the most complex incidents and service requests to determine root cause and business impact, and deciding resolution strategy, priority, and escalation across Tier II, Tier III, and specialized resolver groups.
  • Own team-level queue management decisions: assess real-time contact volumes and ticket aging, rebalance work across analysts, and direct actions to protect PL1-PL4 SLAs, First Contact Resolution targets, and the acceptable quality level for aged tickets.
  • Design and administer the Tier I quality assurance review process, evaluating tickets and customer interactions against standards, enforcing the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process, and determining coaching and corrective actions for analysts.
  • Lead analysis of Tier 0/I trend and escalation data to identify recurring and high-impact problems, and prepare After-Action Reviews, Root Cause Analyses, and Problem Resolution Action Plans with recommended permanent solutions.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (a Master's degree with 1 year of related experience, or an additional 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted). 7 total years (education/experience) required.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  • Must have an Active Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T3/T3R) to start.
