Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to support the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) Volcano Hazards Program (VHP). In this role, you will serve as an embedded technical contributor within the VHP government team, designing, developing, documenting, and deploying a modern, cloud-ready database and associated data visualization tools that support the program’s monitoring and evaluation (M&E) workflows. Your work will directly enable scientists, program managers, and stakeholders across the five U.S. volcano observatories and the Volcano Disaster Assistance Program (VDAP) to track performance, visualize geospatial hazard data, and produce evidence-based reports.

Work Location: Remote

Day to Day Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Database Design & Development — Analyze government-furnished M&E plans and existing VDAP M&E database code; design and implement a relational database (PostgreSQL/PostGIS) supporting VHP monitoring and evaluation data; develop stored procedures, views, data validation logic, and comprehensive data dictionaries; architect the database for mobile device accessibility.
  • API & Backend Development — Design and implement RESTful APIs in Python (FastAPI or Flask) to expose database functionality; develop data ingestion tools and ETL workflows to load M&E data from existing sources; implement metadata management aligned with USGS standards; conduct unit and integration testing of all backend components.
  • Front-End & Visualization Development — Develop a web-based and mobile-friendly data entry and reporting interface using JavaScript/TypeScript and React; create an easily editable content management tool allowing VHP staff to update the M&E framework without developer intervention; build interactive dashboards and visualization modules for M&E analysis and reporting with filtering, drill-down, and export capabilities.
  • GIS & Geospatial Visualization — Develop GIS-enabled tools for spatial visualization of volcano data tied to M&E evaluation criteria; implement interactive web mapping using ESRI JavaScript API, Leaflet, or Mapbox; integrate geospatial layers with the database backend via RESTful APIs; leverage ArcGIS, ArcPy, GDAL/OGR, and PostGIS spatial functions.
  • Cloud Readiness & Architecture — Architect all systems to be cloud-ready, portable, and maintainable, aligned with USGS approved architecture and security baselines; document deployment configurations for future migration to CHS-supported cloud and hybrid environments.
  • Documentation — Produce and maintain all required documentation including user guides, data dictionaries, API references, system schemas, and deployment guides; follow USGS coding and documentation standards throughout.
  • Security & Compliance — Complete required DOI security awareness training; adhere to FISMA, NIST, and DOI security requirements; support Certification and Accreditation (C&A) activities; confirm all web-based applications include USGS-approved logon banners; report any computer security incidents per DOI procedures.
  • Section 508 Accessibility — Validate all web-based interfaces against WCAG 2.0 Level A and Level AA success criteria; apply universal design principles including semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, color contrast, and screen reader compatibility; remediate any non-conforming features.
  • Collaboration & Communication — Attend and actively participate in weekly check-in meetings with VHP staff and the volcano-hazards software development team; provide written progress updates (work completed, planned, issues, risks); integrate feedback from the VHP Coordinator and COR; coordinate with teams across the five U.S. volcano observatories to maintain system interoperability.
  • Travel — Travel to Natural Hazards Mission Area offices for up to three (3) on-site visits during the 12-month period of performance (3–5 business days each) for onboarding, system integration meetings, or collaborative working sessions.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 8 years professional experience, or a Masters degree and 6 years professional experience, or an Associates degree and 10 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 12 years’ professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.
  • PostgreSQL / PostGIS — Demonstrated experience designing, implementing, and optimizing relational databases with spatial data types, indexing strategies, and complex query development.
  • Python Backend Development — Proficiency building RESTful APIs using FastAPI or Flask; experience with data ingestion, ETL workflows, and scripting for automation.
  • JavaScript / TypeScript & React — Strong front-end development skills using modern JavaScript frameworks; ability to build responsive, accessible, interactive web applications.
  • GIS / Geospatial Development — Hands-on experience with ArcGIS, ArcPy, GDAL/OGR, PostGIS, and at least one web mapping library (ESRI JavaScript API, Leaflet, or Mapbox).
  • API Design & Integration — Experience designing, documenting, and consuming RESTful APIs; understanding of API security, versioning, and documentation best practices.
  • Data Modeling & Metadata Management — Ability to design logical and physical data models, entity-relationship diagrams, and comprehensive data dictionaries aligned with federal metadata standards.
  • Cloud-Ready Architecture — Experience designing portable, maintainable systems for cloud or hybrid deployment; familiarity with containerization and cloud-native design patterns.
  • Git / GitLab Version Control — Proficiency with Git-based workflows including branching, merging, code review, and repository management.
  • Section 508 / WCAG 2.0 Accessibility — Working knowledge of web accessibility standards (Level A and Level AA); experience implementing semantic HTML, ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, and color contrast compliance.
  • Federal IT Security Compliance — Familiarity with FISMA, NIST SP 800-53, and federal Certification & Accreditation (C&A) processes.
  • Technical Documentation — Demonstrated ability to produce clear, complete technical documentation including user guides, API references, system schemas, and deployment guides.
  • Communication & Collaboration — Strong written and verbal communication skills; experience working in cross-functional teams with government stakeholders; ability to provide clear status updates and integrate iterative feedback.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • USGS or DOI Experience — Prior experience supporting USGS, Department of the Interior, or other federal science agencies.
  • Volcano or Natural Hazards Data — Familiarity with volcano monitoring data, natural hazards datasets, or environmental science data systems.
  • R Programming — Experience using R for statistical analysis, data visualization, or geospatial data processing.
  • ESRI / ArcGIS Web Services — Experience consuming or publishing geospatial web services in enterprise environments.
  • Mobile-Responsive Development — Experience building mobile-friendly, responsive web interfaces for field or remote use.
  • Content Management System (CMS) Development — Experience designing editable frameworks that allow non-technical users to manage content and workflows.
  • NIST Security Frameworks — Deep familiarity with NIST SP 800-37, 800-18, 800-30, 800-64, 800-34, FIPS 199, and FIPS 200.
  • DOI System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) — Experience working within the DOI SDLC and Security Integration Guide.
  • Agile / Iterative Development — Experience in milestone-driven or sprint-based iterative development methodologies with government review cycles.

jobs.excerpt: ResponsibilitiesPeraton is seeking an experienced System Administrator – Subject Matter Expert (SME) specializing in cloud and hybrid computing environments to support the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) at the U.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced System Administrator – Subject Matter Expert (SME) specializing in cloud and hybrid computing environments to support the Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) at the U.S. Geological Survey (USGS). In this senior-level role, you will serve as a key technical advisor and hands-on administrator across a complex hybrid infrastructure spanning on-premises data center environments and multi-cloud platforms including Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.

Work location: Remote

What You Will Do:

  • Hybrid Systems Administration: Administer and maintain Windows Server and Linux/UNIX-based operating systems (Red Hat, Ubuntu, macOS, and comparable distributions) running on enterprise hardware including Dell, HP x86, and Oracle SPARC platforms across multiple physical data centers.
  • Virtualization Management: Administer VMware vCloud, vSphere, vCenter, and Enterprise Plus virtualization environments; manage VMware Operations (vROPS) and Log Insight for performance monitoring, optimization, and troubleshooting; support System Center Virtual Machine Manager (SCVMM) as needed.
  • Cloud Administration & Optimization: Administer and optimize AWS environments (EC2, S3, CloudFormation, Application Migration Service, and related services); provide expert guidance on cloud and cluster computing architectures; research, evaluate, and deploy advanced cloud computing capabilities and large-data analytics solutions for the program.
  • Migration & Modernization: Lead and support data integration and workload migration efforts from on-premises infrastructure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP); document migration paths, develop runbooks, and execute cutovers with minimal-to-no customer downtime.
  • Storage & Backup/DR Administration: Administer NAS and SAN storage devices; manage enterprise backup software; implement and maintain Backup-to-Cloud replication and disaster recovery (DR) solutions to meet program continuity requirements.
  • Architecture Advisory: Advise OCIO leadership and program stakeholders on cloud and hybrid computing architectures, system and memory management optimization across distributed platforms, and best practices for workload placement and resource utilization.
  • Security & Patch Management: Apply OS, hypervisor, and application-level security patches to resolve vulnerabilities; maintain compliance with DOI/USGS security standards and Information Assurance Vulnerability Alert (IAVA) remediation timelines.
  • Monitoring, Observability & Incident Response: Design and maintain operational monitoring dashboards (vROPS, Datadog, CloudWatch, or comparable tools) for CPU, memory, and storage utilization; troubleshoot and resolve performance and availability incidents across physical, virtual, and cloud infrastructure.
  • DevOps & Automation Support: Leverage container and automation tooling (Kubernetes, Jenkins, Ansible, or comparable platforms) to support workload modernization, CI/CD pipeline operations, and infrastructure-as-code deployments.
  • Documentation & Collaboration: Maintain accurate technical documentation including architecture diagrams, configuration records, migration plans, and runbooks; collaborate using Government-provided tools (Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams).

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 10 years professional experience, or a Masters degree and 8 years professional experience, or an Associates degree and 12 years professional experience; or a high school diploma/equivalent and 14 years’ professional experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States
  • Extensive experience in systems administration across hybrid IT environments (on-premises + cloud).
  • VMware Virtualization: Demonstrated expertise administering vCenter, ESXi/vSphere (6.x/7.x/8.x), vROPS, and VMware Log Insight in large-scale enterprise environments.
  • AWS Cloud Services: Hands-on experience with EC2, S3, CloudFormation, and workload migration tooling (e.g., Application Migration Service); ability to design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure supporting production workloads.
  • Windows & Linux/UNIX: Proficiency administering Windows Server (2016/2019/2022) and Linux/UNIX environments (Red Hat Enterprise Linux, CentOS, Ubuntu) in enterprise or Federal settings.
  • Enterprise Storage: Experience managing NAS, SAN, and enterprise hardware platforms from Dell, HP, NetApp, or comparable vendors.
  • Backup & Disaster Recovery: Working knowledge of enterprise backup and replication solutions; experience designing or implementing Backup-to-Cloud and DR strategies.
  • Multi-Cloud Environments: Familiarity with AWS, Azure, and GCP; ability to advise on workload placement, cost optimization, and architecture trade-offs.
  • Identity & Access Management: Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, PKI, and enterprise IAM.
  • Zero-Downtime Operations: Demonstrated ability to perform zero-downtime upgrades, migrations, and hardware decommissions in production environments.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills; ability to produce technical documentation and present to technical peers and senior leadership.

Preferred Skills:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Enterprise Architecture or a related technical field is strongly preferred
  • AWS Certification: AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional) or equivalent AWS certification.
  • VMware Certification: VMware Certified Professional (VCP-DCV or VCP-VCF) or equivalent VMware certification.
  • Kubernetes & Containers: Experience with Kubernetes (on-premises, AWS, or bare metal) and container orchestration for production workloads.
  • DevOps Tooling: Jenkins (CI/CD), Ansible (configuration management/automation), or comparable pipeline tools.
  • Monitoring Platforms: Datadog, Splunk, Elasticsearch, or VMware Log Insight for enterprise observability.
  • PaaS Platforms: Exposure to Pivotal Cloud Foundry or comparable PaaS platforms in enterprise or multi-cloud environments.
  • Federal/USGS Experience: Prior support of USGS, DOI, or other Federal OCIO environments; familiarity with CHS (Cloud Hosting Solutions) infrastructure.
  • Agile/Scrum: Professional Scrum Master (PSM) or comparable Agile certification; experience working in sprint-based delivery models.
  • AI/Cloud-Native Capabilities: AWS Certified AI Practitioner, Google Generative AI credentials, or hands-on experience with cloud-native AI/ML services.
  • Oracle on Linux: Experience with Oracle databases on KVM/Red Hat Linux or comparable enterprise database infrastructure.
  • Team Leadership: Experience leading or mentoring junior technical staff in a professional IT environment.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Target Salary Range

$112,000 - $179,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

EEO

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.description:
Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.

The Opportunity

Praxis is seeking a field-based Senior Medical Science Liaison (Senior MSL) to support Medical Affairs activities for ulixacaltimide during prelaunch and potential launch. This role is focused on building trusted scientific partnerships, delivering high-quality scientific exchange, and generating actionable insights to inform medical strategy and ensure clinical readiness. You will provide coaching, guidance, and peer leadership to other MSLs while also maintaining strategic engagement with key investigators, movement disorder specialists, and other neurology stakeholders.

This individual will play a critical role in translating medical strategy into field execution, ensuring high-quality scientific exchange, and driving clinical and account readiness in advance of and following potential approval. The role requires strategic thinking and field engagement, serving as a field-based scientific leader and trusted resource to the broader MSL team.

Given the significant unmet need in essential tremor and the opportunity to introduce a novel therapeutic option, this role will help shape disease education, stakeholder engagement, and the evolving treatment paradigm across both academic and community neurology settings.

Success in this role requires strong clinical credibility, excellent communication skills, strategic thinking, and comfort operating autonomously in a fast-paced environment.

Primary Responsibilities

Field Strategy & Execution

  • Translate medical strategy into a clear, executable field plan aligned with pre-launch and launch priorities
  • Contribute to territory planning, KOL identification, and stakeholder engagement strategies across regions
  • Ensure consistent, high-quality scientific exchange across the team, including disease state education and product data communication
  • Support clinical and account readiness efforts, including site preparedness, patient identification, and integration into clinical practice
  • Monitor field activity and adapt strategy based on evolving insights and market dynamics
  • Support territory alignment and resource deployment strategies to ensure optimal coverage of key accounts and stakeholders
  • Support the evolution of field medical strategy across the product lifecycle, from pre-launch readiness through post-launch adoption and expansion

KOL Engagement & Scientific Leadership

  • Maintain direct relationships with key national and regional KOLs, investigators, and thought leaders
  • Lead high-impact scientific engagements, including advisory boards, congress interactions, and complex clinical discussions
  • Serve as a scientific leader within the organization, ensuring credibility and consistency in external interactions
  • Support the identification and development of emerging influencers and strategic partnerships

Insight Generation & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Oversee the collection, synthesis, and communication of field insights to inform medical and cross-functional strategy
  • Partner closely with Clinical Development, Commercial, and Market Access to ensure alignment and effective execution
  • Translate field insights into actionable recommendations that shape launch strategy, evidence generation, and stakeholder engagement
  • Contribute to the development of medical materials, training, and strategic initiatives as needed
  • Represent the voice of the external medical community by translating field insights into strategic recommendations that inform medical and cross-functional decision-making

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • Advanced clinical or scientific degree (PharmD, PhD, MD, NP, PA, or RN)
  • Experience in medical affairs, clinical research, clinical care, or field-based roles within biotech/pharma
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret, communicate, and translate complex scientific and clinical data into clear, actionable insights for diverse stakeholders
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, and drive impact in a dynamic pre-launch/launch environment
  • Proven ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with healthcare professionals, including investigators and key opinion leaders
  • Experience gathering, synthesizing, and translating field insights into actionable recommendations for cross-functional teams
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively (60–80%) in a field-based role
  • Demonstrated experience leading, coaching field-based teams
  • Proven ability to translate medical strategy into effective field execution and operational plans
  • Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and aligning teams in a matrixed environment
  • Experience in neurology, CNS disorders or movement disorders is preferred
  • Experience within market access/payor landscape is preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to rapidly develop expertise in new therapeutic areas and apply insights to field strategy
  • Candidates with prior field-based experience and a demonstrated track record of independently driving scientific engagement, shaping clinical perspectives, and contributing to successful pre-launch and launch activities will be considered at a higher level

The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

Compensation & Benefits

At Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

To round out our world-class total rewards package, we provide annualized base salary compensation in the range listed below. This range reflects the base salary the Company reasonably expects to pay for the position at the time of posting. Placement within the range will be based on job-related factors, including experience, qualifications, scope of responsibilities, and demonstrated track record of delivering results in similar roles.

Annualized Base Salary
$190,000—$220,000 USD

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Job Title: In-Home Health - Physician (Part Time)- Hartford, CT

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Part Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states, as needed

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health

“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

“The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Part-time employees qualify for:

  • Select benefits (see benefits guide for details)

  • Malpractice insurance coverage (during Signify Health-related activities)

  • Supplies and other perks

Required & Preferred Qualifications (MDs and DOs)

  • Active, unrestricted license(s) in coverage area(s)

  • Multi-state licenses (preferred)

  • Able to cover the following primary locations: Hartford and surrounding area.

About the team

As an SDR, you’ll partner closely with Account Executives to design and execute strategic outbound prospecting campaigns that create meaningful, qualified conversations with HR, Learning, and Talent leaders across the globe. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

The Director of GTM, Partnerships is a mid to senior-level role at the center of Power Digital's Partnerships team, responsible for translating the partner ecosystem (Tech, PE and Advisors) into measurable commercial value. This person owns the full commercial lifecycle across our partner go-to-market. This is a highly cross-functional, enterprise-facing role that requires equal parts relationship builder, strategic operator, and financial thinker. You will manage complex fundraising motions, own commercial revenue streams from ideation to negotiation, and serve as the bridge between partners and Power Digital's internal product, sales, CX, and marketing teams.

This role reports directly to the VP of Partnerships.

Responsibilities:

Joint GTM with the Partner Ecosystem

  • Lead new partner vetting and due diligence—evaluating whether technology solutions are the right fit for Power Digital clients based on performance data, ICP alignment, and commercial potential.
  • Develop and manage joint business plans (JBPs) with priority technology and channel partners, translating shared goals into defined initiatives, timelines, and revenue targets.
  • Own and structure commercial agreements, including co-selling arrangements, resell and white-label opportunities, and bonus media incentive programs.
  • Source and activate alpha and beta opportunities with platform partners to give Power Digital a competitive first-mover advantage for clients.
  • Design, launch, and manage partner pilot programs in coordination with internal activation and CX teams.
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize GTM processes and partner engagement workflows.
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to the Partnerships function.

Fusepoint Partnerships

  • Develop and grow a portfolio of technology partnerships specifically designed to support fusepoint, Power Digital's measurement and strategic consulting practice.
  • Identify and structure partnerships that unlock exclusive testing opportunities, platform performance consulting engagements, referral programs, and client-facing competitive advantages.
  • Source credentialing and certification opportunities with platform partners that elevate FusePoint's credibility and market position.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for FusePoint's partner ecosystem, ensuring alignment between partner capabilities and FusePoint priorities.

Joint Technical Innovation (nova)

  • Develop and manage partnerships with technology companies aimed at co-developing nova capabilities, offsetting the product roadmap, or providing exclusive access to AI/data insights and tooling.
  • Own the full sales cycle for joint technical planning (JTP) initiatives—from opportunity identification and stakeholder alignment through proposal development, negotiation, and signed agreement.
  • Partner closely with Power Digital's product and engineering teams to ensure external partnership opportunities are aligned to the Nova roadmap and technically viable.
  • Execute a highly complex, enterprise fundraising motion—including financial modeling and reverse M&A-style structures—to secure technical funding and resource offsets from platform partners.
  • Manage executive stakeholder relationships at partner organizations, building long-term alliances that generate recurring technical investment.
  • Conduct technical demonstrations and present compelling business cases to secure JTP commitments from partner organizations.
  • Monitor emerging trends in AI, AdTech, and data infrastructure to surface new opportunities that align partner priorities with Nova's roadmap.

Reporting, Pacing & Commercial Operations

  • Own end-to-end commercial deal management: sourcing, structuring, executing, and reporting on all commercial partner agreements.
  • Track and communicate pacing toward commercial revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis, flagging risks and opportunities in real time.
  • Manage the distribution and re-investment of commercial deal value back to the appropriate business units (product, activation, sales/marketing, partnerships, etc.).
  • Define and maintain measurable OKRs and KPIs for all active commercial partnerships, ensuring alignment with broader organizational goals.

Program Management & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Serve as the sole internal champion for partner pilots, incentive programs, and commercial initiatives—owning the full program lifecycle from kickoff to post-delivery reporting.
  • Work cross-functionally with marketing, sales, product, and CX to ensure partner programs are fully resourced and successfully executed.
  • Act as the primary bridge between external partners and Power Digital's internal teams, managing timelines, escalations, and stakeholder communication throughout.
  • Build feedback loops from the delivery team back to partners to demonstrate performance, reinforce trust, and identify expansion opportunities.

About SemiAnalysis

SemiAnalysis is an independent research and analysis firm specializing in the Semiconductor and AI industries. Our in-depth coverage spans the entire supply chain, from semiconductor fabrication processes to cutting-edge AI Models, software, and infrastructure. We are recognized as the leading authority on the semiconductor supply chain, with the highest concentration of industry experts within one team, and a deep-rooted passion for delving into the intricacies.

We are a global team of analysts, each with extensive networks across the semiconductor supply chain and AI ecosystem, publishing industry shaping articles while participating in numerous conferences annually.

Our newsletters reach more than 200,000 subscribers worldwide, including senior management and c-suite leaders at the leading semiconductor and AI companies.

We also offer three core products:

  • Industry Models – we develop and publish industry models on accelerator shipments, datacentre demand and supply, GPU total cost of ownership, and more. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, many of the world’s largest hedge funds, and government agencies.

  • Core Research – our public equity markets product, geared towards financial investors, distils our deep technical research and knowledge into key insights on technology and product trends.

  • Consulting and Technical Due Diligence – We conduct custom research and project work to guide key strategic and investment decisions for the largest private equity funds, leading venture capital firms, companies across the AI ecosystem, and government agencies.

Position Overview

SemiAnalysis is seeking an AI Infrastructure Credit Research Analyst to lead our coverage of how the global AI infrastructure buildout is financed.

This role will examine who is providing capital, how financing arrangements are structured, the terms attached to that capital, and where the underlying financial risk ultimately sits. The analysis will combine SemiAnalysis’s proprietary datacenter and semiconductor supply chain data with detailed balance-sheet, credit, and financial intermediation research.

The successful candidate will build the firm’s coverage of AI infrastructure credit from the ground up, producing definitive research for credit investors, limited partners, financial institutions, regulators, and other market participants.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze the full financing stack supporting the AI infrastructure buildout, including:

    • Hyperscalers balance sheets

    • Neoclouds and AI cloud debt

    • GPU-backed lending

    • Datacenter asset-backed securities

    • Project finance

    • Private credit funds

    • Business development companies

    • Special-purpose vehicles

    • Vendor financing arrangements

  • Map financing relationships across the AI ecosystem, identifying:

    • Who is lending to whom

    • The terms and maturity profiles of the financing

    • The structures through which capital is provided

    • The parties ultimately holding the credit and asset risk

  • Build quantitative models to assess credit risk across AI infrastructure investments.

  • Evaluate counterparty exposure, concentration risk, and dependencies across borrowers, lenders, investors, equipment vendors, and infrastructure providers.

  • Model the value and resilience of collateral, including:

    • GPU depreciation and residual value

    • Power purchase agreements

    • Datacenter leases

    • Capacity contracts

    • Equipment financing arrangements

  • Analyze interest-rate sensitivity, refinancing requirements, maturity walls, covenant structures, and liquidity risks.

  • Develop downside and stress scenarios to assess how weaker demand, declining hardware values, delayed construction, power constraints, or tighter financial conditions could affect borrowers and lenders.

  • Track the migration of lending activity from regulated banks to nonbank financial institutions.

  • Assess how the growth of private credit and nonbank lending changes where financial risk is concentrated and how losses could spread during a downturn.

  • Produce flagship research reports and recurring coverage on AI infrastructure financing and credit markets.

  • Build proprietary datasets from bank reports, fund filings, corporate disclosures, securitization documents, loan agreements, and other financial sources.

  • Work closely with SemiAnalysis’s datacenter, semiconductor, energy, and supply chain teams to ensure financial analysis is grounded in what is physically being built, contracted, delivered, and energized.

  • Present research findings to clients and represent SemiAnalysis’s credit views through public writing, meetings, podcasts, conferences, and other industry discussions.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in credit markets, banking, financial intermediation, structured finance, or related areas.

  • Relevant background may include:

    • Bachelors' Degree in financial economics or a related discipline

    • Sell-side credit or macroeconomic research

    • Buy-side credit research

    • Central bank or financial stability research

    • Private credit or structured finance experience

    • Equivalent professional research experience

  • Strong understanding of corporate, bank, and investment fund balance sheets.

  • Ability to independently interpret complex financial documents, including:

    • Bank call reports

    • Corporate filings

    • Fund and BDC disclosures

    • Asset-backed securities documentation

    • Credit agreements

    • Project finance structures

    • Special-purpose vehicle documentation

  • Strong credit judgement and the ability to identify hidden leverage, off-balance-sheet exposure, weak collateral, refinancing risk, and structural subordination.

  • Strong empirical and quantitative skills, including the ability to build original datasets and analytical models.

  • Ability to validate assumptions, defend methodologies, and clearly explain the limitations of available data.

  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to produce clear, rigorous research for a demanding professional audience.

  • Ability to work accurately and efficiently under publication deadlines.

  • High level of intellectual independence and willingness to publish conclusions that may differ from prevailing market views.

Preferred Skills

  • Research or investment experience covering:

    • Private credit

    • Nonbank financial institutions

    • Leveraged finance

    • Structured credit

    • Asset-backed securities

    • Project finance

    • Financial stability

    • Bank and nonbank intermediation

  • Understanding of how financial intermediation has evolved since the 2008 global financial crisis.

  • Named authorship on published research from a:

    • Sell-side research team

    • Central bank

    • Bank economics team

    • International Monetary Fund

    • Bank for International Settlements

    • Policy or financial research institution

  • Experience analyzing interest rates and the transmission of monetary policy into lending standards, credit availability, asset values, and refinancing conditions.

  • Familiarity with datacenters, semiconductor economics, AI infrastructure, or power markets.

  • Experience analyzing infrastructure financing structures or capital-intensive technology investment cycles.

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, Excel, or other tools used for financial modelling and data analysis.

  • Experience working with large, fragmented, or difficult-to-structure financial datasets.

  • Strong presentation and client communication skills.

Growth Areas

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Define SemiAnalysis’s AI infrastructure credit and financing coverage from the ground up.

  • Become a leading industry voice on how the AI buildout is financed and where the associated financial risks are concentrated.

  • Build proprietary credit datasets using SemiAnalysis’s unique information on datacenter construction, power availability, accelerator shipments, hardware deployments, and supply chain activity.

  • Develop original risk frameworks for emerging financing structures such as GPU-backed lending, neoclouds debt, private credit facilities, and AI infrastructure securitizations.

  • Expand coverage into adjacent areas such as:

    • Datacenter project finance

    • Energy infrastructure financing

    • Structured credit

    • Financial stability

    • Private market leverage

    • Vendor and equipment financing

    • Monetary policy and credit transmission

  • Work directly with credit investors, private credit firms, banks, asset managers, limited partners, regulators, and companies involved in financing AI infrastructure.

  • Publish research that becomes reference material for the industry and contributes to policy and regulatory discussions.

  • Grow into a leadership role overseeing broader credit, financial markets, and capital structure research within SemiAnalysis.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.
jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.

As the Senior Operations Manager, you are the company's logistics engine — owning and driving end-to-end execution across suppliers, freight, inventory, and fulfillment. You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools, automations, or workflows is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Growth mindset): continuously seeks to learn, improve, and grow.
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): operates with transparency and high ethical standards.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Efficiency: builds systems that maximize output and eliminate wasted effort.
  • Analytical skills: applies financial thinking to every operational decision.
  • Organization & Planning: manages multiple complex workflows without failure.
  • Calm under pressure: maintains performance and clarity in high-stress situations.
  • High standards: operates with a zero-error mindset on execution and reporting.
  • Enthusiasm: brings energy and passion for logistics, AI, and operational excellence.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of critical operations and supply chain performance.
  • High impact role with significant autonomy and decision-making power.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an operations leader who thrives in high-performance environments, combines analytical thinking with execution excellence, and is driven by ownership, accountability, and continuous optimization.

We are seeking a Billing & Collections Manager to own and lead the billing and collections function for our growing litigation practice, including the monthly billing cycle, collections, retainers, and the processes and reporting behind them. Our clients are often navigating one of the most stressful financial periods of their lives, and how we bill and collect is part of how we care for them. This role calls for someone who combines rigorous billing management with genuine empathy, a person who keeps receivables healthy through relationships, clear communication, and follow-through rather than pressure.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the firm's end-to-end monthly billing cycle, from pre-bill preparation and review through invoice delivery.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for client billing inquiries, payment arrangements, and account follow-up.
  • Manage accounts receivable and lead collections through respectful, empathetic client conversations.
  • Oversee retainer replenishments and trust-to-general transfers in coordination with the firm's lawyers and clerks.
  • Design, improve, and document the firm's billing processes as the practice grows.
  • Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive client and financial information in compliance with all ethical and professional standards.
  • 100% remote work arrangement.
  • Flexible work schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • Collaborative, supportive, and people-first work environment.
  • Work alongside exceptional leaders who value mentorship, autonomy, and professional growth.
  • Direct exposure to and collaboration with executives, lawyers, and business leaders.
  • Opportunity to own and shape the firm's billing and collections function as the organization grows.
  • Continuous learning and development in a highly specialized tax litigation practice.
  • Be part of a close-knit team where your contributions have a direct impact on the firm's success.

Key Responsibilities

1. Billing Operations & Monthly Cycle

  • Own the monthly billing calendar; prepare, review, and finalize pre-bills in coordination with lawyers and law clerks.
  • Review draft bills for accuracy, consistency, and correct allocation of time across related matters before release.
  • Generate and deliver accurate, clearly presented invoices on a consistent monthly schedule.
  • Track unbilled work-in-progress and follow up internally to ensure time is recorded and billed promptly.

2. Collections & Accounts Receivable Management

  • Monitor accounts receivable and conduct timely, structured follow-up on outstanding invoices.
  • Approach every collections conversation with patience, empathy, and professionalism, recognizing that many clients are under significant financial and emotional stress.
  • Work with clients to establish realistic payment arrangements and see them through to completion.
  • Know when to listen, when to problem-solve, and when to escalate an account to a lawyer.

3. Retainers & Trust Coordination

  • Monitor retainer balances and coordinate replenishment requests before balances are exhausted.
  • Support trust-to-general transfers and account reconciliations in coordination with the firm's bookkeeping function and in accordance with Law Society of Ontario trust accounting requirements.

4. Reporting, Process Ownership & Improvement

  • Maintain accurate billing and receivables records in the firm's practice management systems.
  • Prepare monthly reporting for firm leadership on billings, collections, realization, aged receivables, and unbilled time.
  • Administer the firm's billing review and approval processes, including discount and write-down approvals.
  • Identify and implement improvements to billing workflows, templates, and client payment options as the firm grows.
  • Train and support timekeepers on billing practices, and help onboard and guide future billing staff as the team expands.

5. Compliance & Confidentiality

  • Adhere to professional guidelines and legal requirements regarding confidentiality and client financial information.
  • Ensure billing records are maintained, stored, and disposed of in accordance with legal and professional standards.

Experience

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Pricing and Deal Desk
jobs.excerpt: KLDiscovery is a global leader in eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery, helping law firms, corporations, and government agencies solve complex data challenges.
jobs.description:
KLDiscovery is a global leader in eDiscovery, information governance, and data recovery, helping law firms, corporations, and government agencies solve complex data challenges. We partner with clients across the full data lifecycle — from forensic collection through legal review, production, and managed hosting — spanning services, managed services/SaaS (Nebula), and support.

The Role

KLDiscovery is seeking a Senior Manager, Pricing & Deal Desk to own how we price, structure, and govern every complex deal across services, SaaS, and hybrid offerings. This is a gatekeeper role, not a modeling-support role: this person sits at the intersection of FP&A, Revenue Operations, Sales, and the Executive Leadership Team, and is accountable for deal integrity from quote to close.

Pricing strategy at KLDiscovery is set collectively — through a Pricing Council/Steerco this role runs and staffs with input from FP&A, Rev Ops, Sales, and Marketing leadership. This role owns the mechanics, governance, data, and AI-driven tooling that make that strategy executable and enforceable — they are the operator and analytical backbone of the council, not a sole decision-maker on strategy.

This is an AI-native role. The expectation is not manual spreadsheet-building — it is designing and running AI-assisted pricing models, scenario/Monte Carlo simulations, and automated review workflows (in the vein of AI-assisted Excel work already in use elsewhere in the business, e.g. Nebula ECA), so the team's analytical capacity scales without scaling headcount. This role comes with an expected annual basic salary of $160,000 - 170,000.

What You'll Do

Own the Deal Desk & Approval Governance

  • Serve as the single gatekeeper for non-standard pricing, discounting, and complex deal structures before they go to Legal/Finance sign-off.

  • Design and enforce approval workflows and escalation tiers (standard terms vs. exception vs. ELT-level approval), modeled on the same discipline already applied to sales-split and closed-deal controls.

  • Ensure no deal closes with unpriced or unlogged concessions — including waived/free services (e.g., training credits) — so every giveaway is captured as a $0 promotional credit rather than invisible margin leakage.

Run Pricing Governance & the Pricing Council

  • Own the operating cadence of the cross-functional Pricing Council (FP&A, Rev Ops, Sales, Marketing, ELT stakeholders), including agenda, data package, and follow-through on action items.

  • Translate Council direction into documented pricing policy, discounting guardrails, and approval matrices — this role executes and enforces strategy set collectively, not in isolation.

  • Maintain one consistent view of pricing across the full portfolio — services, managed services/SaaS, and support — so no offering is priced in a silo.

AI-Native Pricing Analytics & Modeling

  • Build AI-assisted pricing tools, not manual models: scenario tools, calculators, and Monte Carlo-style simulations run through AI-assisted platforms, with the analyst validating and interpreting output rather than hand-building every calculation.

  • Automate recurring analyses (margin/discount trend tracking, deal-outcome pattern detection) so cycle time drops and consistency improves.

  • Bring enough modeling fluency to build, validate, and challenge AI-generated outputs — the bar is analytical judgment and structuring, not manual Excel throughput.

Protect Margin on Complex Deal Structures

  • Partner with Sales and Delivery on strategic and structurally complex deals (e.g., platform transitions, dual-hosting/dual-cost scenarios, Second Request work) to catch cost exposure before contracts sign — not after.

  • Flag and quantify hidden cost overlap (e.g., concurrent third-party licensing and proprietary platform hosting during a client transition) as part of deal review, not as a post-close finance discovery.

  • Distinguish revenue-driven pricing actions from structural/cost-side changes for downstream QoE and credit-agreement addback purposes, in partnership with FP&A.

Systems, Data & Reporting Integrity

  • Own pricing/quote data hygiene in SFDC/CPQ — no deal desk decision should run on a hardcoded or unvalidated number.

  • Ensure every priced deal is tagged correctly to the segment/SKU structure (L1/L2/L3 revenue reporting framework) so pricing outcomes roll up cleanly to board and lender reporting.

  • Build and maintain KPI reporting on margin, discounting variability, deal velocity, and Council-adopted tooling.

What You Bring

  • 8–10+ years in pricing, deal desk, revenue operations, or commercial finance — ideally with direct P&L or margin accountability, not purely support/analyst experience.

  • Demonstrated ability to run governance: designing approval workflows, chairing cross-functional forums, and holding Sales accountable to process.

  • Comfort using AI-assisted analytics tools to build and scale pricing models (Excel fluency is expected as a baseline for validating outputs, not the primary skill being hired for).

  • Experience supporting complex B2B deals — services, SaaS, or legal tech preferred — including multi-platform or transition-period pricing.

  • Executive presence: this role will present to ELT and needs to hold their own in that room, not just produce the analysis behind it.

  • Strong cross-functional influence — this role has no direct reports over Sales or Delivery but must drive discipline across both.

Preferred

  • Experience in eDiscovery, legal tech, or managed/usage-based services pricing.

  • Direct experience with AI-assisted modeling tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) for scenario or simulation work, not just traditional BI tools.

  • Experience with Salesforce, CPQ, or deal-desk workflow tooling.

  • Familiarity with QoE/credit-agreement addback treatment and covenant-relevant reporting.

Success Metrics

  • Reduction in unpriced/unlogged concessions and margin leakage on complex or transitional deals.

  • Deal desk cycle time and reduction in discounting variability.

  • Adoption and effectiveness of AI-assisted pricing tools (measured reduction in manual model-build time).

  • Clean, audit-ready pricing data flowing into segment/SKU and lender-facing reporting with no manual bridges.

  • Pricing Council cadence held consistently, with documented decisions and follow-through.

Equal Opportunity Statement

KLDiscovery is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.

About the role

Aptive Resources is hiring remote professional fee coders to support Veterans Affairs medical centers in Georgia and Alabama. You'll code physician and provider services for hospitalized Veterans, plus surgical cases. The VA expects about 4,500 inpatient professional encounters and 500 surgical encounters a year, mainly at the Atlanta and Birmingham facilities.

Primary Responsibilities

What you'll do

  • Code inpatient professional services, and nursing home professional services, using CPT, ICD-10-CM, and HCPCS.
  • Code surgical cases, applying global surgical package rules and required add-on codes.
  • Assign E/M categories and levels for inpatient and consult services, according to current E/M guidelines.
  • Apply NCCI bundling edits and assign modifiers correctly (for example 24, 25, 26, 51, 57, 59, and 79).
  • Apply VHA rules on billing for supervising practitioners and residents (VHA Directive 1400.01 and 1401), including teaching physician documentation.
  • Review documentation in CPRS, update provider names in PCE or the surgery package as needed, and enter codes in VistA through the VA-approved encoder.
  • Flag records whose documentation is missing, unsigned, or not enough to support the service billed.
  • Re-review your coded records when the VA questions them before billing or after a claim is denied.
  • Maintain at least 95% accuracy and meet each facility's turnaround times.

Minimum Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • An active CPC, CCS-P, CCS, RHIT, or RHIA credential.
  • At least 2 years of recent professional fee coding experience, including inpatient E/M and surgical procedures.
  • Completion of an accredited coding, HIM, or health information technician program.
  • Formal training in anatomy and physiology, medical terminology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, and reimbursement methods.
  • Strong knowledge of CPT surgery guidelines, global periods, modifiers, and NCCI edits.
  • Proficiency with an industry-standard encoder.
  • US citizenship, and the ability to pass a federal background investigation (NACI) and fingerprinting.
  • A private, secure home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience coding for an academic medical center or a teaching hospital with residents.
  • Experience with multi-specialty surgical coding, such as general, orthopedic, or vascular surgery.
  • Experience with VA systems, including VistA, CPRS, and the surgery package.

Additional requirements

  • Complete the VA's annual Privacy and Information Security Awareness and HIPAA training (TMS 10176 and 10203) before starting, and once a year after that.
  • Follow AHIMA's Standards of Ethical Coding and VA confidentiality rules. Don't use "incident to" billing rules.
  • Aptive provides the laptop, encoder, and reference materials.

Arrow ARC supports Veterans Health Administration facilities and offices across the U.S. with health care staffing and program support via the 10-year Integrated Critical Staffing Program (ICSP). Position Overview

The Senior Manager Communications & Community Engagement is responsible for developing and executing strategic communications and community engagement programs that strengthen employee connection, advance our Purpose, enhance organizational culture, and build meaningful relationships with the communities in which the company operates.

This role serves as a strategic communications partner to the Fujifilm Americas Corporate Communications Leadership Team, business leaders, Tokyo-Corporate Communications, Human Resources, and other key stakeholders. The manager translates business priorities into clear, compelling communications that inform, engage, and motivate employees while also supporting the company’s community engagement and social impact objectives.

The successful candidate is an experienced strategic communications professional with a demonstrated track record for developing strategic Communications & Engagement Plans/Strategies who can deliver in speedy, succinct, and real-time communications. The incumbent combines strong writing and storytelling skills with strategic thinking, demonstrated ability to meet deadlines, project management, stakeholder management, and an understanding of employee and community audiences.

Company Overview

At FUJIFILM Holdings America Corporation, we’re redefining innovation across the industries we touch—from healthcare and photography to semiconductors and data storage. With roots in photosensitive materials and a legacy of groundbreaking technology, we now lead 23 diverse affiliate businesses across the Americas.

We’re looking for mission-driven talents eager to join us to help create, market, and support a vast portfolio of products. At Fujifilm you’ll have the opportunity to explore and grow your skills in new, exciting ways. Whether you’re shaping tomorrow’s tech or redefining today’s processes, we’ll provide a flexible work environment and dynamic culture where innovation thrives.

Our Americas HQ is nestled in Valhalla, New York, a charming town known for its excellent schools, beautiful parks, and easy access to the vibrancy of New York City.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit:

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Employee Communications

  • Develop and execute integrated employee communication strategies aligned with business objectives, Corporate Communications Strategy, company culture, and organizational priorities.
  • Partner with senior leaders and functional teams to develop clear, timely, and engaging communications for employees.
  • Create and manage communications across multiple channels, including email, intranet, digital platforms, employee meetings, town halls, videos, newsletters, presentations, and leadership communications.
  • Develop select executive communications, including talking points, leadership messages, presentations, town hall materials, and employee announcements.
  • Translate complex business information into concise, accessible, and compelling employee communications.
  • Support communications related to organizational change, business transformation, culture, employee engagement, and significant company initiatives.
  • Establish communication plans, timelines, audiences, messages, and channels for major initiatives.
  • Monitor employee feedback and engagement trends and recommend communications strategies based on employee needs and business priorities.

Community Engagement

  • Develop and implement community engagement strategies that support the company’s corporate citizenship and community investment priorities.
  • Partner with business leaders, employees, nonprofit organizations, and community partners to identify meaningful engagement opportunities.
  • Lead communications supporting volunteerism, charitable giving, employee-led community initiatives, and corporate social responsibility programs.
  • Develop stories and content that demonstrate the company’s impact in local communities.
  • Coordinate community events, employee volunteer activities, and engagement campaigns.
  • Build relationships with internal and external stakeholders to increase employee participation in community initiatives.
  • Measure and communicate the impact of community engagement programs.

Content & Storytelling

  • Develop compelling employee and community stories that reinforce company values, culture, Purpose, and business priorities.
  • Write and edit articles, newsletters, executive messages, presentations, social content, videos, and other communications materials.
  • Identify employee and community stories that can be leveraged across internal and external channels within FUJIFILM Americas, as well as amplified globally.
  • Ensure communications are consistent with the company’s brand, voice, tone, and communication standards.
  • Collaborate with social media, digital, HR, and external agency partners as appropriate.

Strategic Partnership & Leadership Support

  • Serve as a trusted, strategic communications advisor to leaders and cross-functional partners.
  • Counsel stakeholders on communication strategy, audience considerations, timing, messaging, and delivery.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization and understand business priorities and employee needs.
  • Provide communications support during organizational changes, business milestones, and other high-priority initiatives.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality, accuracy, and deadlines.

Required Skills/Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, or a related field.
  • 10-12+ years of progressive experience in corporate communications, employee communications, public relations, community engagement, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing employee communication strategies.
  • Excellent writing, editing, presentation, and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working directly with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Experience developing communications for multiple audiences and communication channels.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a global or large corporate environment.
  • Experience supporting organizational change and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Experience with community relations, corporate social responsibility, employee volunteerism, or charitable giving programs.
  • Experience with executive communications.
  • Experience with internal digital communications platforms, intranets, employee apps, or collaboration tools.
  • Experience using employee engagement data, surveys, analytics, or other measures to inform communications strategy.
  • Communications agency experience is a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic Communications - Understands business objectives and translates them into effective communications strategies.
  • Executive Partnership - Builds credibility and trusted relationships with senior leaders and provides thoughtful communications counsel.
  • Writing & Storytelling - Creates clear, concise, compelling communications that connect with employees and community audiences.
  • Stakeholder Management - Effectively collaborates with leaders and partners across functions, geographies, and levels of the organization.
  • Employee Engagement - Understands employee audiences and develops communications that build connection, trust, understanding, and participation.
  • Community Engagement - Builds meaningful partnerships and creates opportunities for employees and the company to positively engage with communities.
  • Project Management - Effectively manages multiple priorities, deadlines, stakeholders, and deliverables.
  • Judgment & Discretion - Demonstrates sound judgment when managing sensitive information, complex issues, and high-visibility communications.

Success Measures

Success in this role may be measured through:

  • Employee engagement and participation in communications and community initiatives.
  • Quality, reach, and effectiveness of employee communications.
  • Stakeholder and leadership satisfaction.
  • Successful execution of communications strategies and major initiatives.
  • Employee understanding of key business priorities and organizational changes.
  • Growth in employee participation in volunteerism and community engagement.
  • Quality and consistency of communications across channels.
  • Demonstrated community impact and stakeholder relationships.

Role Characteristics

The Employee Communications & Community Engagement Manager is a strategic individual contributor and communications partner who operates with a high degree of independence. The position requires the ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on execution and to work effectively with senior leaders, Fujifilm Americas Corporate Communications Leadership, employees, HR, and community partners.

The role is particularly important in helping the organization connect employees to the company’s purpose, strategy, culture, and communities through credible, timely, and engaging communications.

Fujifilm is committed to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotion and advancement, compensation, benefits, and training regardless of nationality, age, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity, race, ethnicity, religion, political creed, ideology, national, or social origin, disability, veteran status, etc.
