jobs.description:
Overview

Rachio is looking for a Director of Product Marketing to own how Rachio decides what to build, how we position it, and how we bring it to market across hardware, software, and subscriptions. This is a senior leader role at Rachio and the owner of our go-to-market (GTM) processes: the mechanism that takes an idea from concept through business case, launch, and post-launch iteration, and helps to surface key debates and to align cross functional teams (across Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales, Support, and Marketing) to a shared set of goals.

The scope spans smart lighting, smart sprinkler and hose controllers, partner and OEM products, and the software and subscription experiences that sit on top of them. It's inherently cross-functional and inherently commercial: you are measured on adoption, revenue, and channel performance, not on the volume of collateral produced. The right person is equally comfortable running a customer research plan, writing a pricing and positioning narrative for the exec team, and sitting in a firmware trade-off conversation with engineering to understand what a feature actually does before deciding how to sell it.

A note on how this role works. Rachio runs a flat organization that maintains a high ownership and fast paced start-up culture. As such, this is a senior individual contributor role. Your influence comes from the quality of your thinking, the clarity of your writing, and your credibility with the people who own the functions you depend on - not from headcount. It has large ownership and depends on your ability to form clear, concise data-driven strategies that earn trust on the team and drive decisions. If you're looking for a role where you set direction and a team executes it, this isn't that role. If you want the leverage of shaping a category-leading portfolio without the overhead of a large org, it is.

Responsibilities

Own the GTM process

  • Build and run the end-to-end GTM process that moves opportunities from ideation to in-market execution, including setting the strategy, collecting feedback, sizing of opportunities, determining key debates and decisions with clear business cases, stage gates, launch readiness, and post-launch review.
  • Set the strategic goals and success criteria for each initiative up front, and drive alignment on them across Product, Engineering, Finance, Operations, Sales, Support, Marketing, and others.
  • Own launch readiness as a mechanism, not a meeting: clear owners, clear dates, clear go/no-go criteria, and an honest retro afterward.
  • Identify where the process itself is the bottleneck and fix it. This role is expected to build repeatable GTM motions and systems that can scale your work across teams.

Be the senior product marketing voice in roadmap and product development

  • Partner with Product Management to shape the roadmap that’s led with data: market sizing, customer research, competitive intelligence, channel input, and knowledgeable ways to leverage AI to organize the data into tangible next steps.
  • Maintain a working understanding of the market: competitive lineups, adjacent smart home platforms and protocols, pro channel dynamics, and where the category is heading.

Positioning, messaging, and pricing

  • Define positioning and messaging architecture for hardware, software, and subscription offerings, and translate technical capability into language customers and pros actually use.
  • Own the single source of truth for each product: positioning, claims, feature availability, competitive comparisons, FAQs, and objection handling.
  • Develop pricing and packaging recommendations in partnership with Product, Sales, and Marketing: good/better/best structures, subscription tiers, channel-specific SKUs, promotional strategy. Each should include financial modeling to support the recommendations.

Launch and channel execution

  • Lead integrated launches across the professional channel, retail, and D2C.
  • Build the enablement that makes the channel effective: support of pro training, distributor and rep materials, retail line reviews, packaging and shelf messaging, product spec and comparison tools.
  • Partner with the Brand Studio and Marketing team to translate positioning into campaigns and measure what they return.
  • Action and close the post-launch feedback loops: what's confusing customers, what's driving returns, what priorities we need to improve CSAT.
  • Lead international expansion opportunities with agency and contractor support where it makes sense.
  • How to size new country expansion and how to build brand awareness in these regions with targeted customer segments.

Voice of the customer and measurement

  • Own the customer research agenda across homeowners and professional installers: qualitative and quantitative, primary and syndicated.
  • Instrument launches so success is measurable: adoption, attach and activation rates, sell-through, ASP, retention, NPS.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of product marketing, GTM, or closely related commercial experience, including significant time owning initiatives end-to-end.
  • Comfort operating as a hands-on individual contributor. You write the narrative and docs, build the model, and run the launch yourself rather than assigning it.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a full product lifecycle from concept through launch and iteration, with results you can speak to specifically.
  • Experience marketing connected hardware, consumer electronics, IoT, or technical products, including the realities of long hardware lead times, supply constraints, certification, and channel timing.
  • Experience marketing software or subscription offerings: adoption, attach, retention, and monetization.
  • Track record of driving direction and alignment across product, engineering, finance, operations, and sales without owning those functions.
  • Strong analytical foundation: comfortable building the model, working in spreadsheets and BI tools, and defending the assumptions.
  • Exceptional written communication. Distill a complex set of decisions into a written narrative a leadership team can act on.
  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience building GTM or NPI processes from scratch, or materially rebuilding one that wasn't working.
  • Experience in two-step distribution or professional trade channels (irrigation, landscape, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, building products) alongside retail and D2C.
  • Experience with smart home platforms and protocols: Matter, Thread, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and have enough technical fluency to be useful in engineering conversations.
  • Experience with outdoor products, lighting, water management, or the sustainability categories.
  • Experience with partner, OEM, or co-marketing programs.
  • MBA or advanced degree.

jobs.description:
Overview

Consilio builds eDiscovery and legal technology solutions used by legal teams at major organizations. Our users make consequential decisions inside our products — often under deadline, always under scrutiny. The work is high-stakes by nature: decisions made inside our products carry legal weight.

We're looking for a Lead UX Designer to own design for critical areas of our product suite and to serve as a steward of our design system. Two things make this role unusual. First, you'll be working out how AI shows up inside these workflows. Second, you'll be setting the standards that hold the experience together across a multi-product portfolio, and governing how those standards get used.

This is an individual contributor role. You will set direction, and you'll have real influence over what gets built.

How this role operates

You'll partner with Product and Engineering early — shaping the problem, not styling a decision that's already been made. You'll prototype fast to explore and align, and work with Engineering to keep design and code in sync.

Our internal design team is small and growing. You'll have more ownership than you'd get at a mature design org, and less existing infrastructure to lean on.

Responsibilities

· Own end-to-end design for one or more product areas, from problem framing through delivery and post-launch iteration

· Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early, not just execute on requirements

· Translate in-flight product strategy into journeys, information architecture, and interaction patterns

· Define the interaction models for AI-assisted workflows: how users understand what the system did, why it did it, and how far to trust it

· Evolve and maintain Consilio's design system — defining components and patterns, and setting the standards for how they're used

· Build accessibility standards into the system rather than retrofitting it

· Prototype rapidly to explore, align, and de-risk decisions using modern AI tools

· Lead or partner on user research, and turn findings into decisions other people can act on

· Make the case for design decisions and system standards to senior stakeholders through evidence and clear storytelling

Qualifications

· 8+ years designing complex enterprise or B2B software, with shipped work you can walk us through

· Hands-on experience building and maintaining a design system in a multi-product environment — not just consuming one

· Experience designing end-to-end journeys for multi product ecosystems

· Experience with Figma Make, or other similar prompt-based prototyping tools.

· Depth in interaction design, with visual craft strong enough to make the work persuasive

· Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering from problem definition forward

· Bachelor’s degree in Design (e.g., Interaction, Visual, Industrial Design), HCI, or equivalent practical experience.

Qualities we're looking for

· Systems thinking. You design for scale and consistency by default, not as a cleanup pass.

· Standards judgment. You know when to generalize a pattern and when a one-off is the right answer — and you can say no to a component request without damaging the relationship.

· Comfort with ambiguity. You can make a defensible tradeoff without perfect information, and revisit it when better information arrives.

· Influence without authority. You change what gets built by being persuasive and well-reasoned, not by escalating.

· Clarity under complexity. You can take a genuinely complicated workflow and make it feel obvious.

Portfolio

· Strong portfolio demonstrating complex workflow design across multiple web-based enterprise products.

· Work samples that showcase prototyping ability.

Nice to have

· Experience with AI driven products or designing AI powered interactions

· Formal or self-directed learning in AI/ML concepts

· Prior experience designing for legal, compliance, healthcare, financial services, or another high-consequence regulated domain.

Consilio’s True North Values

  • Client Experience | Listen for the “why”. Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  • Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect. Welcome diverse views. Partner across geography, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  • Innovation | Always be curious (ABC). Challenge the status quo. Experiment and fail forward. Build for the future.
  • Grit | Focus on what matters. Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner. Deliver results you’re proud of.

Omega Technical Services is seeking an experienced Designer to support Idaho National Laboratory’s Materials and Fuels Complex. jobs.excerpt: ABOUT THE ROLEArgano's Business Consulting practice partners with organizations to design, optimize, and transform how work gets done — connecting strategy to execution by ensuring the people side of change is never an afterthought.
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Argano's Business Consulting practice partners with organizations to design, optimize, and transform how work gets done — connecting strategy to execution by ensuring the people side of change is never an afterthought. As a Lead OCM Consultant, you will own the change management workstream on complex client engagements, leading the strategies, plans, and interventions that drive real adoption and help people move through change successfully.

This is a senior practitioner role — not a project coordinator. You will work directly with executives and senior leaders, coaching them to play their sponsorship roles effectively. You will design and execute stakeholder engagement plans, impact assessments, communications strategies, and training frameworks. You will also serve as a subject matter authority within Argano's community of practice, developing colleagues and contributing to the methodologies that define how we deliver OCM.

Typical engagements include ERP and enterprise technology implementations, operating model redesigns, organizational restructuring, process transformation programs, and post-merger integration — across a range of industries and client environments. You will work across one or more concurrent engagements at any given time.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Engagement Planning & Delivery

▸ Partner with Engagement and Project Managers to translate high-level plans into detailed OCM workplans and inventories of required deliverables — ensuring the change management workstream is integrated, sequenced, and resourced from day one

▸ Apply Argano's LIFT delivery methodology and incorporate key learnings from prior engagements to build change strategies uniquely fitted to each client situation

▸ Establish strong working relationships with client business leaders, project sponsors, and functional stakeholders — building trust that makes OCM work possible

▸ Work across one or more concurrent projects at one or more clients — maintaining quality, pace, and stakeholder confidence throughout

Change Strategy & Stakeholder Engagement

▸ Lead the design and execution of change management strategies and plans that maximize employee adoption, minimize resistance, and accelerate time to proficiency

▸ Conduct change impact assessments across affected roles, processes, systems, and organizational structures — translating findings into targeted intervention plans

▸ Develop and maintain stakeholder analysis and engagement plans — identifying change champions, resistance risks, and influence strategies by group

▸ Help clients understand and articulate the value of investing in the people side of change, including changes to business processes, systems and technology, job roles, and organizational structures

▸ Identify and assess organizational readiness for change throughout the engagement — surfacing risks early and adjusting the plan accordingly

Executive Coaching & Sponsorship

▸ Act as a trusted advisor and coach for senior leaders and executives, helping them understand and fulfill their role as active, visible change sponsors

▸ Prepare leaders to communicate change effectively — providing messaging frameworks, talking points, and facilitation support for key leadership moments

▸ Build leadership alignment and engagement around the change — helping executives model the behaviors the organization needs to see

▸ Navigate organizational politics and resistance at the leadership level with maturity and credibility

Communications

▸ Design and execute end-to-end communications strategies that reach the right audiences with the right message at the right time

▸ Develop communications plans, calendars, and content — from executive announcements to front-line manager briefings to system-user notifications

▸ Write, review, and refine communications across multiple channels — email, town halls, intranet, video, and manager talking points

▸ Measure communication effectiveness and adjust approach based on audience feedback and engagement signals

Training & Enablement

▸ Provide input to the design and development of training strategies, approaches, and programs aligned to the change and the affected audience groups

▸ Define training needs by role and persona — ensuring training content addresses both the 'how' of the new system or process and the 'why' of the change

▸ Support the design, development, and delivery of training programs in collaboration with instructional designers, subject matter experts, and technology teams

▸ Develop or support the development of job aids, quick reference guides, and sustainment tools that support adoption beyond the initial training event

Practice Development & Capability Building

▸ Actively contribute to the development and continuous refinement of Argano's OCM methodologies, tools, templates, and accelerators

▸ Lead and champion a defined set of OCM leading-practice capabilities within the community of practice — teaching and enabling colleagues to deploy them effectively on client engagements

▸ Mentor junior OCM practitioners and analysts through direct project collaboration and structured coaching

Business Development

▸ Build trusted relationships with client leaders that generate expansion opportunities and long-term partnerships

▸ Contribute to proposals and business development pursuits by bringing OCM expertise, scope definition capability, and a track record of measurable adoption outcomes

▸ Participate in thought leadership and knowledge-sharing activities that strengthen Argano's market position in OCM

Travel
Up to 50% travel to client sites, depending on project phase and engagement requirements — typically higher during assessment, design workshops, and go-live support phases

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

▸ Bachelor’s degree preferred; psychology, organizational behavior, communications, business, or HR disciplines are strong fits

▸ Advanced degree (MBA, MS in Organizational Development, I/O Psychology, or related field) is an advantage

▸ Prosci ADKAR certification or equivalent change management certification is strongly preferred

▸ Additional relevant credentials — CCMP, Kotter, LaMarsh, or similar — are valued

Required Experience

▸ 5+ years of hands-on organizational change management experience on complex, enterprise-scale transformation programs

▸ Demonstrated end-to-end OCM delivery capability — from change strategy through stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and sustainment

▸ Proven experience working directly with senior executives as an OCM coach and advisor — not just as a communications or training executor

▸ Solid understanding of how people go through change — the psychology, the resistance patterns, the adoption curve, and what actually moves people from awareness to commitment

▸ Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong relationships across all levels of an organization, from front-line employees to C-suite executives

▸ Experience on large-scale organizational change efforts — enterprise technology implementations, process transformation, restructuring, or post-merger integration

▸ Strong written and verbal communication skills — ability to craft clear, compelling, audience-appropriate messaging and to present confidently to senior stakeholders

▸ Ability to influence without formal authority, navigate ambiguity, and move diverse groups of stakeholders toward a common goal.

Preferred Experience

▸ Experience delivering OCM on enterprise technology implementations — system agnostic (ERP, HCM, CRM, SCM, or other platforms)

▸ Familiarity with instructional design principles and adult learning theory — ability to contribute meaningfully to training design conversations

▸ Experience with stakeholder analysis and engagement tools, change readiness assessments, and resistance management frameworks

▸ Background working across multiple industries — manufacturing, consumer goods, financial services, life sciences, retail, or public sector preferred

▸ Experience managing or leading a small OCM team or workstream (4+ people)

▸ Comfort working in environments where the OCM methodology needs to be built, not just applied — able to design the approach, not just follow a playbook


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Beyond the qualifications, we are looking for someone who:

▸ Leads with empathy — genuinely understands what it feels like to be on the receiving end of change, and designs interventions with real human experience in mind

▸ Earns credibility fast — can walk into a room of skeptical executives and quickly establish the trust and authority needed to coach effectively

▸ Communicates with precision — knows that the right message, to the right audience, at the right moment is what moves people, and designs every communication with that in mind

▸ Operates as a strategic partner, not a support function — understands the business objectives driving the change and connects OCM activities directly to those outcomes

▸ Is comfortable with ambiguity and resistance — doesn't need perfect conditions to do good work, and doesn't take resistance personally

▸ Develops others — genuinely invested in making junior practitioners better, and in building a stronger OCM practice at Argano

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking a UX Analyst to support the DFAS environment by delivering modern, user-centered digital experiences across web and mobile applications.

This is a hands-on UX role focused on moving rapidly from requirements and user needs to high-fidelity, interactive experiences. The UX Analyst will use Figma, AI-assisted design and research tools, design systems, rapid prototyping, usability validation, and accessibility practices to transform complex requirements into intuitive, development-ready solutions.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly within Agile product teams and can use AI to accelerate—not replace—UX thinking, research synthesis, design exploration, documentation, accessibility evaluation, and prototyping.

The role requires someone who can take an experience from concept to high-fidelity prototype to development handoff, while collaborating closely with product owners, stakeholders, developers, and end users.

This position is 100% remote.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the full UX lifecycle from discovery, requirements analysis, and user research through high-fidelity design, interactive prototyping, validation, development handoff, and implementation review.
  • Translate business, mission, technical, and user requirements into clear user journeys, task flows, experience maps, information architecture, and interface solutions.
  • Create high-fidelity Figma screens and interactive prototypes that accurately demonstrate intended workflows, interactions, responsive behavior, states, and user outcomes.
  • Use AI-assisted UX workflows to accelerate research synthesis, requirements analysis, concept exploration, content development, accessibility review, prototyping, and design iteration.
  • Apply strong UX judgment to validate and refine AI-generated concepts rather than relying on AI-generated output without human review.
  • Develop and maintain Figma component libraries, variables, reusable patterns, templates, and design-system components that promote consistency and accelerate delivery.
  • Create UX artifacts as appropriate, including user journeys, personas, workflows, information architecture, experience maps, wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, prototypes, storyboards, and design specifications.
  • Conduct and synthesize user research and stakeholder discovery through interviews, surveys, observation, contextual inquiry, usability testing, heuristic evaluations, and other appropriate research methods.
  • Plan, facilitate, and analyze usability testing using interactive prototypes and working applications; translate findings into actionable design recommendations.
  • Rapidly iterate concepts using high-fidelity prototypes and AI-enabled prototyping techniques to allow stakeholders and users to experience proposed solutions before development investment.
  • Design responsive experiences for desktop, tablet, and mobile environments, considering device capabilities, user context, interaction methods, and platform conventions.
  • Ensure designs meet applicable Section 508 and WCAG accessibility requirements, incorporating accessibility into the design process rather than treating compliance as a final review activity.
  • Design accessible interaction patterns including keyboard navigation, focus behavior, semantic structure, form interactions, error handling, color contrast, responsive behavior, and assistive-technology considerations.
  • Apply established organizational design systems and standards, including U.S. Web Design System (USWDS) patterns when applicable.
  • Collaborate directly with product managers, business analysts, developers, architects, accessibility specialists, and stakeholders to ensure proposed experiences are both desirable and technically feasible.
  • Provide development-ready Figma specifications and assets, including responsive behavior, component states, interaction logic, icons/SVGs, spacing, sizing, and design-system references.
  • Work closely with front-end developers during implementation to ensure the delivered experience accurately reflects the approved UX direction.
  • Conduct UX implementation reviews and identify discrepancies between approved designs and developed interfaces.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including planning, refinement, reviews, demonstrations, retrospectives, and UX/design critiques.
  • Clearly communicate and present design rationale, research findings, prototype concepts, tradeoffs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

The UX Analyst should demonstrate the ability to responsibly incorporate modern AI capabilities into the UX workflow.

This may include using AI to:

  • Analyze and synthesize research, stakeholder feedback, and requirements.
  • Identify themes, usability issues, gaps, and potential experience opportunities.
  • Explore multiple interaction and experience concepts rapidly.
  • Generate initial content, interface concepts, or design alternatives for human evaluation.
  • Accelerate creation of prototypes and proof-of-concept experiences.
  • Assist with accessibility analysis and design-system compliance.
  • Support UX documentation, user stories, acceptance criteria, and development handoff.
  • Translate design intent into prototype code or front-end concepts when appropriate.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human-Computer Interaction, UX Design, Interaction Design, Information Technology, Computer Science, Digital Design, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience with a minimum of 4 years of progressive professional UX, product design, interaction design, usability, or related digital experience demonstrating the required capabilities.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.
  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Professional UX certification such as Nielsen Norman Group (NN/g), Human Factors International (HFI), or equivalent is preferred where required by the program.
  • Demonstrated portfolio of professional work showing high-fidelity interface design, interactive prototypes, user flows, design systems, responsive experiences, and implemented digital products.
  • Strong experience creating high-fidelity UI designs and interactive prototypes in Figma.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous or complex requirements into intuitive digital experiences.
  • Strong understanding of user-centered design, interaction design, information architecture, usability, and human-computer interaction principles.
  • Experience conducting or supporting user research and usability testing.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools within UX, research, design, or prototyping workflows.
  • Ability to create responsive web and mobile experiences using modern design patterns and component-based design systems.
  • Working knowledge of Section 508 and current WCAG accessibility practices.
  • Experience working with design systems and reusable component libraries.
  • Ability to clearly articulate design decisions and present UX concepts to customers, leadership, developers, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong collaboration skills within multidisciplinary Agile product teams.
  • Ability to balance user needs, mission objectives, technical constraints, accessibility requirements, and delivery timelines.
  • Understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern front-end development concepts sufficient to effectively collaborate with engineering teams and evaluate implementation feasibility.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with Figma variables, component properties, Auto Layout, responsive design, interactive components, Dev Mode, and advanced prototyping.
  • Experience with AI-enabled prototyping, design-to-code, or rapid application development tools.
  • Experience designing within USWDS or other enterprise/government design systems.
  • Experience supporting federal government digital products or other complex enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with accessibility evaluation tools and automated accessibility testing.
  • Experience designing applications that support complex workflows, data entry, dashboards, case management, or transactional processes.
  • Familiarity with front-end frameworks and component-based development approaches.
  • Ability to facilitate collaborative workshops, design reviews, stakeholder sessions, and UX discovery activities.

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. your mission

The Role
You are the top of the funnel. Your job is to get the founder into 8–12 qualified conversations per month with supply chain and procurement leaders at target manufacturers.

These are two types of meetings:

  • Product meetings — structured conversations with supply chain operators to validate features, get input on roadmap, and build relationships that convert into pipeline over time
  • Sales meetings — qualified conversations with decision-makers at ICP accounts who understand what Epoch does and want to see it.
You own everything up to the meeting. The founder closes.

What Early-Stage Outbound Looks Like
This is not a volume game. You will not blast 500 emails and wait for replies. At an unknown brand, every touchpoint needs to earn attention

How to apply
  1. A short note on why this role fits you
  2. One real example of how you got a meeting at a company where nobody knew your brand — name the company, the person, the angle you used, and how many touches it took
  3. Your LinkedIn profile
We will know if you wrote this with LLMs. We screen every application for AI-generated content. Be specific, be detailed, be you.

your profile

What You'll Actually Do

  • Research target accounts — understand their supply chain, recent news, pain points, org structure
  • Identify the right buyer (VP Supply Chain, Head of Procurement, COO, Plant Director)
  • Write hyper-personalized outbound that earns a reply from someone who's never heard of us
  • Build and run multi-touch sequences across email, LinkedIn, and warm intro paths
  • Mine existing networks
  • Frame meetings as value exchanges, not sales pitches
  • Manage HubSpot pipeline, track outreach, report on conversion at every step
  • Coordinate event follow-ups, podcast/webinar appearances, and content seeding that generates inbound
  • Work directly with the founder daily

You're a Fit If
  1. You've done outbound at a B2B startup where nobody knew the brand — and got meetings anyway
  2. You can research a company and write a message that makes a VP stop scrolling
  3. You're comfortable working in manufacturing / supply chain / industrial context (or learn fast)

Brooks Insurance is the wholesale brokerage of Venbrook. At Venbrook, we envision a world where our clients can confidently pursue their boldest ambitions.   • 401k + employee match
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid Holidays
  • Paid Parental leave
  • Paid Sick leave
  • Professional development programs
  • Work-life quality and flexibility

Visit us at

JOB SUMMARY:

The Excess Liability Insurance Underwriter evaluates, selects, and prices excess and surplus (E&S) casualty risks within delegated underwriting authority. This is a technical carrier underwriting role focused on sound risk selection, disciplined pricing, portfolio profitability, and documentation quality across a broad range of target classes including contracting/wrap-up/project-specific risks, product liability, service classes, real estate, and institutional exposures. The underwriter works within the carrier’s underwriting guidelines and appetite to make binding decisions on new business, renewals, and endorsements.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

Sound Judgment & Underwriting Authority: Exercises disciplined analytical thinking to evaluate complex excess casualty risk exposures and make binding underwriting decisions within delegated authority limits. Balances risk quality with portfolio profitability.

Technical Underwriting Depth: Demonstrates strong command of excess and surplus lines casualty underwriting principles, coverage structures, attachment points, and pricing methodology across multiple target classes.

Portfolio & Market Awareness: Monitors loss trends, emerging risks, and E&S market conditions to proactively adjust underwriting strategies and maintain a profitable, disciplined book of business.

Broker & Carrier Collaboration: Builds and maintains effective working relationships with wholesale brokers and internal carrier teams. Communicates underwriting decisions clearly, including rationale for pricing, coverage structure, or declinations.

Attention to Detail & Documentation: Thoroughly reviews applications, loss history, and exposure data. Produces clear, accurate underwriting files that reflect sound decision-making and comply with carrier guidelines, surplus lines regulations, and audit standards.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Risk Assessment & Underwriting Authority

  • Analyze complex excess casualty risk submissions, including underlying primary programs, loss history, and exposure data
  • Evaluate risks across target classes including contracting/wrap-up/project-specific, product liability, service classes, real estate, and institutional exposures
  • Underwrite excess and surplus (E&S) lines submissions that fall outside standard market appetite
  • Make binding decisions on new business, renewals, and endorsements within delegated underwriting authority
  • Determine appropriate coverage structures, attachment points, limits, terms, conditions, and endorsements in accordance with underwriting guidelines
  • Refer risks outside delegated authority to senior underwriting leadership with a clear, documented recommendation
  • Apply surplus lines regulatory knowledge in structuring and transacting placements appropriately

Portfolio & Profitability Management

  • Maintain a profitable book of business through disciplined risk selection and consistent application of underwriting guidelines
  • Monitor loss trends, emerging risks, and E&S market conditions to adjust underwriting strategies
  • Collaborate with carrier actuarial teams to refine pricing models and ensure rate adequacy
  • Identify and escalate portfolio-level concerns, deteriorating segments, or appetite shifts to leadership
  • Participate in audits and internal reviews to ensure compliance with underwriting standards

Broker Engagement

  • Maintain effective working relationships with wholesale brokers within the carrier’s distribution model
  • Communicate underwriting decisions clearly and professionally, including rationale for pricing, structure, or coverage changes
  • Provide guidance to brokers on risk characteristics, carrier appetite, and submission requirements
  • Represent the carrier at industry events, broker meetings, and training sessions as appropriate

Documentation & Compliance

  • Prepare clear, accurate underwriting files that document the basis for each binding decision
  • Ensure all transactions adhere to surplus lines regulatory requirements, internal policies, and delegated authority limits
  • Maintain thorough knowledge of underwriting guidelines, carrier appetite, and state-specific insurance laws
  • Stay current on legal developments and emerging excess casualty liability trends

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES:

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in excess casualty or surplus lines underwriting
  • Experience making binding underwriting decisions within a delegated authority framework
  • Strong technical knowledge of E&S casualty coverage structures, attachment points, and pricing methodology
  • Ability to analyze complex risk submissions, loss data, and exposure information to reach sound underwriting conclusions
  • Solid understanding of surplus lines regulations and E&S market placement
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clearly document and defend underwriting decisions
  • Proficiency with underwriting platforms, rating tools, and productivity software

Preferred

  • Professional designations such as CPCU, ARM, or AU
  • Experience underwriting across multiple casualty classes including contracting, product liability, real estate, and institutional risks
  • Familiarity with actuarial pricing models and loss development concepts

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, risk management, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in excess casualty or surplus lines underwriting
  • Professional designations such as CPCU, ARM, or AU preferred

Job Description

We’re on a journey to transform our eCommerce Marketing organization using data, partnerships, agility, technology, and best-in-class talent to achieve our long-term growth ambitions. Retail Media is a core function to enable this transformation. As the digital landscape continues to evolve, we’re looking for data driven, entrepreneurial-minded, and consumer-obsessed media experts to help us on this journey.

The Sr. Manager, Retail Media Measurement role serves as the central owner of streamlining & enhancing the Kraft Heinz approach to Retail Media Measurement through Technology, Data, Reporting, & Analytics. The position requires a candidate that is a strong influencer, strategic thinker, self-starter, and change maker. The individual is hungry to learn, redefine, and is comfortable with change, ambiguity, and rapid industry growth.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities:

  • Commercial mix analytics (MMM); quarterly insight generation/advisory, modeling partner, data input management & scaling, management of additional supplemental deep dive analysis
  • Retail media measurement capabilities, analytics & incrementality; partnering with Retail Media Networks & Media Agency to advance capabilities and measurement methodologies, governing internal selection of key KPIs, analyzing returns, etc.
  • Retail media agency reporting & benchmark development; partnering with retail media agency to determine learning agenda, key measurement principles & identifying benchmarks tied to business KPIs
  • Annual learning agenda aligned to business KPIs; running analysis and determining key optimizations/actions for the business, storytelling and sharing with stakeholders (e.g., BUs)
  • Consult/advisor to key customer accounts; performance reviews, testing plans, measurement roadmaps, etc. across key retailers like Target, Kroger, Walmart, Amazon, etc.
  • Identifying and owning capability partnerships for media measurement (e.g., SOV for RMN display partner, vetting incremental measurement solutions)
  • Ownership of evolving retailer media measurement solutions (e.g., clean room strategy and execution)
  • Partner with internal teams to connect Retail Media Measurement, Performance, & Insights to broader business (i.e. Data & Analytics, Data Science, Marketing Analytics)

Expected Experience & Required Skills:

  • 7+ years experience utilizing any combination of advanced and predictive analytics, marketing analytics, and analytic techniques for marketing, media, customer and business application
  • 7+ years experience with large datasets to deliver marketing and business strategy; marketing mix modeling experience preferred
  • 5-7 years experience with performance media data (retail media data experience preferred)
  • 5-7 years experience collaborating and project managing across functions and varied levels of leadership to capture perspectives and leverage internal knowledge and deliver insights/action oriented solutions
  • Demonstrates ability to innovate and enhance processes or strategies through the utilization of technology and knowledge advancement; aware of industry best practices and capability enhancement
  • Ability to apply marketing and commercial intelligence concepts for business success
  • Ability to tie retailer analytics to retailer media analytics (i.e. understanding of Amazon Marketing Cloud, Scintilla and how they can be used to link sales and media performance)

Our Total Rewards philosophy is to provide a meaningful and flexible spectrum of programs that equitably support our diverse workforce and their families and complement Kraft Heinz’ strategy and values.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description: We’re KSM, one of the top 50 largest independent advisory, tax, and audit firms in the United States.
jobs.description:
Job Description:

We’re KSM, one of the top 50 largest independent advisory, tax, and audit firms in the United States. But more than our size, it’s our people and culture that set us apart. We believe great things happen when people are supported, challenged, and given the freedom to do their very best work. That’s why we’ve built a workplace where your career and personal life can thrive together – where you have the flexibility to manage your time, the resources to grow, and a team that genuinely cares about your success.

We’ve been employee-owned since 2001, giving every team member a stake in our collective success. This ownership mentality fosters a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and excellence – where new ideas are welcomed, different perspectives are valued, and you’re encouraged to explore what excites you most. Whether you’re expanding your skills, tackling new challenges, or making an impact beyond the office, we provide the resources and support to help you grow in the direction that’s right for you.

At KSM, your contributions matter – not just to the firm, but to your colleagues, clients, and the communities we serve across the U.S. If you’re looking for a place where you can do meaningful work, build lasting relationships, and grow in ways that align with what’s most important to you, we’d love to meet you.

Position Summary:

Katz, Sapper & Miller (KSM) is seeking an accomplished Sales & Use Tax Senior Manager to help lead and expand our growing State and Local Tax (SALT) practice. This is an opportunity for an experienced sales tax professional to make a meaningful impact by combining advanced multistate technical expertise with practice leadership, business development, and team development.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, independently leading complex multistate sales and use tax engagements and delivering practical, high-quality solutions to sophisticated technical issues. Equally important, this individual will help shape the future of the practice by strengthening client relationships, mentoring and developing professionals, enhancing processes, championing innovation, and supporting strategic growth initiatives.

We are looking for a collaborative, forward-thinking leader who demonstrates sound professional judgment, intellectual curiosity, and an ownership mindset. The ideal candidate is passionate about building high-performing teams, identifying opportunities to improve how we serve clients, and contributing to the continued evolution and long-term success of KSM's Sales & Use Tax practice.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead and manage sales and use engagements performed within the SALT Group, and ensure accurate and timely deliverables while providing strategic oversight
  • Exercise sound judgment in managing day-to-day client matters independently while appropriately escalating strategic or high-risk issues.
  • Create an environment where managers, seniors, and staff are challenged, coached, and developed into future leaders through meaningful feedback, delegation, and mentoring
  • Develop and enhance their own technical understanding of SALT specialty areas
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive culture within the SALT practice while strengthening relationships across service lines to increase awareness of SALT capabilities and enhance client service.
  • Serve as Firm technical resource for multistate sales and use tax issues
  • Lead sales and use tax practice initiatives, process improvements, and service offerings.
  • Collaborate across service lines to identify integrated client solutions and expand existing client relationships
  • Champion continuous improvement by evaluating emerging technologies, AI tools, and workflow enhancements that improve quality, efficiency, and the client experience
  • Represent the firm through speaking, publications, and professional organizations.

Requirements/Qualifications:

  • Keep abreast of SALT developments nationwide; communicate to Firm.
  • Develop and enhance excellent technical knowledge, writing skills and verbal communication skills; interpret, complete and review opinion papers, protest documents, internal technical communications, etc.
  • Perform complex tax research; manage tax research projects; utilize managers, seniors and staff when appropriate.
  • Develop deep understanding of client business and industries to provide solutions to SALT related issues
  • Develop and advise on strategies to minimize sales and use tax burden of clients
  • Assist with business restructuring projects with a significant SALT component.
  • Manage state and local tax audits; demonstrate ability to advocate client positions in audit and other potentially adversarial settings with state and local government officials while maintaining positive relationships with government personnel and directing client communications to set expectations.
  • Build and maintain relationships with peer government officials for assistance with various client issues; develop and maintain relationships with professional colleagues within the tax community.
  • Demonstrate the ability to generate high-quality work under deadlines and within budgets; outstanding ability to multi-task within and outside of the firm and across multiple clients, assignments and staff to meet often tight deadlines
  • Manage the economics and profitability of projects.
  • Become an integral part of the technical and professional development of staff; serve as a formal and informal mentor to managers, seniors and staff.
  • Participate in public speaking on technical topics to internal and external audiences.
  • Embrace and promote technology-enabled service delivery, including AI tools and automation, to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability across the practice.
  • Collaborate with Partners and Directors to expand existing client relationships, identify new business opportunities, develop referral networks, participate in community and industry activities, and contribute to the long-term strategic growth of the practice.

Leadership Competencies:

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

  • Strong professional judgment and accountability
  • A positive, collaborative leadership style
  • An ownership mindset with a bias toward action
  • Intellectual curiosity and continuous learning
  • Comfort operating in an evolving, growth-oriented environment
  • Ability to develop future leaders through coaching and mentoring
  • Strong interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence
  • Entrepreneurial thinking balanced with practical execution and risk management

Required Experience:

  • A minimum of 10 calendar years of state and local tax experience, demonstrating a proven progression in complexity of tax issues addressed.
  • CPA or CMI preferred.
  • Proficiency in complex state and local tax research.
  • Bachelor's or master's degree in accounting and/or taxation, or advanced degree (e.g., law degree) and related work experience.
  • Minimum of forty hours of continuing professional education is required each year to maintain and develop technical and business skills.
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring and developing high-performing teams
  • Proficiency in use of tax compliance software, legal research software, and suite of Microsoft Office programs.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, veteran status, or any other protected category.

KSM only accepts resumes directly submitted by a candidate and referrals submitted by current KSM employees. Unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles sent by staffing agencies and fee-based referral services will not be considered outside of a signed KSM vendor contract. KSM will not pay a fee to recruiters or agencies that do not have a signed KSM vendor contract.

jobs.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

Job Description

Working on the Platinum Support Team, the Support Account Manager is the main technical support contact serving Sprinklr’s largest and most complex customers. We work with program managers and executive level decision makers at large enterprise brands to deliver excellent customer support experience.

Platinum Support Account Manager also acts as an internal escalation point, collaborating with Sales, Customer Success, Engineering & Services to resolve issues.

The PSAM also acts as the day-to-day internal escalation point, and point of contact for clients, ensuring optimal client service as it relates to platform performance, functionality, enhancements, and optimization while supporting line management and operational excellence.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the technical voice of the customer and advocate for your clients’ needs when escalating product issues.

  • Closely monitor total time to resolve for your assigned customer support cases and always ensure adherence to SLAs.

  • Be an expert on the Client’s custom implementation and be able to resolve issues pertaining to their setup that doesn’t require engineering intervention.

  • Meet regularly with your customer contacts for case reviews. You’ll cover trends you see in support tickets, look for opportunities to reduce pain points in product use, and deliver updates on outstanding issues.

  • Work on databases (MongoDB, SQL, Elastic search) for campaign data analysis and troubleshooting.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve Java servlet exceptions, verify stack traces, and utilize logging tools (GrayLog, Kibana, Grafana) for monitoring and debugging.

  • Attend bridge calls for escalated issues and work directly with the customer and engineering for expedited resolution.

  • Plan and execute important events for customers in collaboration with Success/MS team.

  • Prepare regular reports for internal stakeholders for all your accounts to highlight customer health index and plan of action to improve.

  • Share regular insights into new product features with your customers ensuring highest standard of service delivery.

  • Discuss and plan release readiness to meet customer expectations and ensure faster resolution on release related issues.

  • Expertise in business analysis, functional specification, system design, platform configuration, testing, and training while assisting in operational housekeeping.

This Includes:

  • Provide social, advertising, marketing insights and recommendations to support clients’ business practices.

  • Provide consulting advice to clients on the appropriate Sprinklr solution to meet all requirements based on best practices and client’s custom needs, adhering to primary business use cases and platform functionalities.

What makes you qualified?

  • Understanding of development, implementation, and management of advertising campaigns, creative contents, channel dynamics, audience insights, KPIs/benchmarks across multiple social media platforms.

  • Strong knowledge of the latest trends and best practices in digital marketing and advertising technologies including channel API documentation and API development.

  • Proficiency in digital marketing, advertising, creative strategies and tools.

  • Experience with databases (MongoDB, SQL, Elasticsearch).

  • Experience with third-party integrations (Adobe, DCM, DV360, Google Adwords, GA4, etc.) for data onboarding.

  • Understanding of Java, JavaScript, and ability to troubleshoot Java servlet exceptions.

  • Experience with logging tools (GrayLog, Kibana, Grafana).

  • Experience in API development, handling campaigns on social media platforms, mobile apps, and devices. Familiarity with channel API documentation around integration and optimization of campaigns.

  • At least three years' experience with global enterprise social media strategy development, management and execution• 3+ years demonstrated experience supporting software and services and/or account management focusing on nurturing long-term relationships and maintaining high client satisfaction

  • Experience in Web technologies, CRM or SaaS platforms and digital marketing experience in social platforms.

  • Understand & excel in deciphering technical aspects like – Graylogs, Kibana, API Browser, Query Executor, Restricted Curls, Runner Logs

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Data analysis skills to interpret customer usage patterns and identify opportunities

  • Customer service orientation with a focus on exceeding expectations

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Desire and ability to rapidly learn a wide variety of new technical skills

  • Self-motivated, takes initiative, assumes ownership

  • Ability to work in a highly collaborative and fast-paced environment

  • Bachelor's degree required or equivalent combination of experience and training

We focus on our mission: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

  • Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

  • Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.

  • Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

We believe in our product: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

We invest in our people: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

EEO - Our philosophy: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful. 

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

JOB REQ COMPENSATION RANGE

$74,000 - $124,000

The base salary range for this role is shown above. At Sprinklr, base pay depends on multiple individualized factors, including experience, qualifications, job-related knowledge and skills, and geographic location. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package: the successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in Sprinklr’s discretionary bonus plan, commission plan, and/or equity plan, depending on role.

US-based Sprinklr employees are eligible for a highly competitive benefits package as well, which demonstrates our commitment to our employees’ health, well-being, and financial protection. The US-based benefits include a 401k plan with 100% vested company contributions, flexible paid time off, holidays, generous caregiver and parental leaves, life and disability insurance, and health benefits including medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage.

Warning about Recruiting Scams: Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD99177

L'affichage de poste en français suivra / The French job posting follows

26WD99177, Principal Software Developer - Databases

About Autodesk Construction Solutions @ Autodesk

Autodesk has fully reimagined the construction business for the digital age, enabling companies to address the most important challenges they face today while preparing for new ways of working in the future. The Autodesk Construction Solutions (ACS) portfolio connects the office, trailer, and field, enabling customers to move seamlessly through each phase of the construction lifecycle from design and preconstruction to construction, turnover, and operations. General contractors, subcontractors, and owners around the world rely on ACS to win more work, enhance collaboration, speed up decision-making, reduce risk, and improve overall project outcomes.

The Structured Record Storage group owns the shared data persistence layer for AEC: automated database fleet management, streaming to warehousing for analytics and ML, and the developer abstractions that decouple service logic from storage technology. We manage the entire database fleet (Postgres and DynamoDB, all production regions), own schema lifecycle from migration through regional deployment, and emit semantic events into Kafka so downstream teams never build raw reconstruction apps. SRS is a platform-grade function. We define the storage standards, enforce them, and build the tooling that makes compliance automatic instead of manual.

Position Overview

Autodesk Construction Solutions is looking for a senior technical contributor who brings deep expertise in cloud data infrastructure and uses it to shape how the division manages structured storage. This role sets technical direction across the SRS platform, from database fleet operations to the API abstractions and event contracts that sit on top, and leads high-impact initiatives end-to-end. You'll operate with significant autonomy, influence architecture decisions across teams, and raise the technical bar for how engineering teams build on shared storage infrastructure.

Responsibilities

  • Lead design and implementation of high-impact SRS platform capabilities: event platform CDC integration (Kafka), schema automation, Structured Record Access API, fleet management tooling

  • Set technical direction for one or more SRS sub-areas: architecture standards, design reviews, raising the bar on how the team builds

  • Continuously assess SRS cloud platform needs at scale, identify significant risks and gaps, and drive the roadmap to close them

  • Own and improve fleet-wide operations: capacity management, monitoring and alerting, query tuning, load optimization, and data replication for reporting workloads

  • Create and institutionalize best practices and health models for the database fleet; use observability tooling and AWS automation to enforce standards consistently across hundreds of managed databases

  • Build a high-impact network of storage champions across engineering groups, consult directly with product teams and group leads on storage readiness and risk, and select training opportunities that raise engineering capability division-wide

  • Own reliability for what you build: monitoring, runbooks, on-call response, post-incident learning

  • Partner with SRS area leadership across managed database platform, DevEx, and data warehousing to sequence work and make cross-team tradeoffs

  • Drive migration and schema lifecycle initiatives across the fleet, coordinating with product teams, managing rollout risk, validating rollback coverage

  • Mentor P2/P3 engineers; conduct design and code reviews with real feedback

  • Represent SRS technical requirements in cross-org forums: architecture review, group leadership

  • Provide tactical leadership during production emergencies

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of software engineering in a platform, infrastructure, or data engineering context

  • 5+ years of Kubernetes architecture at scale

  • 7+ years of Terraform experience

  • 7+ years of experience with cloud data technologies

  • Deep Postgres or DynamoDB experience at scale: fleet-level operations, not application-level use

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects end-to-end: design through production

  • Hands-on Kafka or event streaming experience in production; bonus if you've built CDC pipelines (Postgres binlog, DynamoDB Streams, Debezium)

  • ORM experience at the framework or platform layer: you've built or extended ORM tooling to drive semantic eventing, not just consumed it

  • Kubernetes CRD hands-on experience: designing or operating controllers/operators that manage platform resources

  • Strong AWS background: IAM, RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, ECS/EKS, multi-region

  • Able to drive technical alignment across opinionated teams; you've gotten three engineers with different opinions to agree on an approach

  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and GitOps deployment experience

  • Strong communication and organizational skills; you can influence outcomes across teams, groups, and leadership

Preferred Qualifications

  • You're a self-starter, comfortable driving work across a distributed group of service owners on different teams

  • You're a fearless problem-solver and model-driven thinker

  • You embrace big challenges and apply rigorous yet efficient methods to your solutions

  • You're results-driven, with a strong bias for action and a solid sense of accountability

The Ideal Candidate

  • Experience building or operating a managed Postgres platform

  • Customer Managed Keys (CMK): AWS KMS key policy design, envelope encryption, or CMK rotation in a regulated environment

  • Schema catalog, data governance, or data contract experience

  • Liquibase or equivalent schema migration tooling experience

  • Helm, ArgoCD, or Harness deployment pipeline experience

  • Apigee, LLM proxy, or API gateway platform experience

  • FedRAMP/IL4 compliance context in a cloud environment

26WD99177, Développeur logiciel principal - Bases de données

À propos d’Autodesk Construction Solutions chez Autodesk

Autodesk a entièrement repensé le secteur de la construction à l’ère du numérique, permettant ainsi aux entreprises de relever les défis les plus importants auxquels elles sont confrontées aujourd’hui tout en se préparant aux nouvelles méthodes de travail de demain. Le portefeuille Autodesk Construction Solutions (ACS) relie le bureau, le chantier et le terrain, permettant ainsi aux clients de passer en toute fluidité d’une phase à l’autre du cycle de vie de la construction, de la conception et de la pré-construction à la construction, à la livraison et à l’exploitation. Partout dans le monde, les maîtres d’œuvre, les sous-traitants et les maîtres d’ouvrage s’appuient sur ACS pour remporter davantage de marchés, renforcer la collaboration, accélérer la prise de décision, réduire les risques et améliorer les résultats globaux des projets.

Le groupe Structured Record Storage gère la couche de persistance des données partagées pour le secteur AEC : gestion automatisée du parc de bases de données, transmission en continu vers le stockage centralisé à des fins d’analyse et d’apprentissage automatique, ainsi que les abstractions de développement qui dissocient la logique des services de la technologie de stockage. Nous gérons l’ensemble du parc de bases de données (Postgres et DynamoDB, toutes les régions de production), prenons en charge le cycle de vie des schémas, de la migration au déploiement régional, et diffusons des événements sémantiques vers Kafka afin que les équipes en aval n’aient jamais à développer d’applications de reconstruction à partir de données brutes. SRS est une fonction au niveau de la plateforme. Nous définissons les normes de stockage, veillons à leur respect et développons les outils qui automatisent la conformité au lieu de la laisser manuelle.

Présentation du poste

Autodesk Construction Solutions recherche un collaborateur technique senior apportant une expertise approfondie en infrastructure de données cloud et capable de l’utiliser pour façonner la manière dont la division gère le stockage structuré. Ce poste définit l’orientation technique de l’ensemble de la plateforme SRS, depuis l’exploitation du parc de bases de données jusqu’aux abstractions d’API et aux contrats d’événements qui s’y superposent, et dirige de bout en bout des initiatives à fort impact. Pacific Coast Producers| Full-Time | Remote | Exempt

Pacific Coast Producers (PCP) is a growing agricultural cooperative with food production facilities across the West Coast. PCP is seeking a talented and innovative Director of Branded Sales to join its team. PCP is dedicated to investing in its people and fostering a culture of service, creating an environment where each employee can do their best work to provide affordable, high-quality food for customers across North America.

Join a legacy of talented people working together to innovate and feed families around the world! As a PCP employee, you will have access to a comprehensive benefits package that includes generous benefit plans and paid time off, with an excellent retirement savings plan to help secure your future.

The Director of Branded Saleswill be responsible for the strategic leadership of the Del Monte fruit product line and the supervision of the Branded Sales Manager team. This role requires a proven track record in consumer-packaged goods (CPG) branded sales, a focus on brand equity, national pricing architecture, and market share growth. The successful candidate will lead the team in executing sales objectives, managing broker performance at a national level, and ensuring the newly acquired Del Monte brand thrives under PCP stewardship.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Supervise, mentor, and develop a team of Branded Sales Managers, ensuring they meet volume and revenue targets in their respective territories.
  • Develop and execute the national sales strategy for the Del Monte brand, defining channel priorities and go-to-market plans in the Core Retail Grocery space.
  • Oversee the national pricing structure and trade spending budget. Ensure trade dollars are deployed efficiently across specific geographic regions and markets to drive profitable growth.
  • Manage the high-level relationship with national broker agencies, holding them accountable to Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and ensuring the Del Monte brand is prioritized.
  • Collaborate with the Supply Chain and Operations teams to translate sales data into accurate production forecasts and pack plans.
  • Participate in “top-to-top” meetings with major national accounts to close high-stakes deals and annual contracts.
  • Serve as the primary voice of the Del Monte brand within Pacific Coast Producers, coordinating with Marketing, Finance, and Logistics departments to resolve challenges.
  • Manage the department budget, including travel and promotional spending.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of sales experience within the Consumer Packaged Goods sector with a Branded food products background preferred.
  • Proven experience managing branded food products.
  • 3+ years of direct supervisory experience leading a sales team.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration or management, marketing, or related field; MBA preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 (e.g., Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.)
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Exceptional presentation skills, with the ability to speak confidently to executive leadership and large groups.
  • Attention to detail and excellent follow-through.
  • Humility, punctuality, responsiveness, everyday professionalism, and quality work
  • Ability to travel significantly (30-50%) to work with field teams and attend key industry events.

Compensation

$175,000 to $250,000 per year (DOE); profit-sharing bonus-eligible. This is a full-time,exempt, remoterole with up to 50% travel.

Note - The base salary range reflects the reasonable expectation for what Pacific Coast Producers anticipates paying for this role at the time of posting. The actual salary offered will depend on factors including, but not limited to:

  • Relevant skills, education, and experience;
  • Job-related qualifications and certifications;
  • Internal pay equity; and
  • Market conditions and business needs.

PCP takes care of its people. Here are just a few of the benefits available to a successful candidate:

  • Competitive pay with opportunities for continued learning and advancement;
  • This position is eligible for our annualprofit-sharing bonus program;
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance plan coverage for you and your family;
  • Retirementplans to support your long-term security;
  • Paid time off including vacation, holidays, parental leave, sick leave, and bereavement;
  • Life and disabilityinsurance plus an Employee Assistance Program;
  • The stability of a farmer-owned cooperative with more than 55 years of success.
  • A mission-driven culture focused on feeding families across North America.

Sponsorship: This role is not eligible for current or future visa sponsorship.

About PCP

Pacific Coast Producers is an agricultural cooperative owned by more than 150 California family farmers who cultivate and transport diverse produce like tomatoes, peaches, and pears. PCP was founded in 1971 and operates production and distribution facilities in California and Oregon, with a workforce of over 3,500 employees. PCP is committed to delivering quality products to customers in all channels of trade, such as foodservice distributors and grocery retailers throughout the United States and Canada.
