jobs.excerpt: Who we are At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes.
jobs.description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

A quick heads-up about hiring and how we work :

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Software Architect, (L6).

About the job

This position is needed to define and drive architectural vision, strategy, and alignment across multiple products and domains at company scale.

As a senior-most technical leader, you’ll set long-term technical vision, establish architectural guardrails, and ensure coherence across distributed systems and platforms. You will drive cross-organizational initiatives, solve complex and ambiguous technical challenges, and elevate the technical standard for Twilio company-wide.

Responsibilities

In this role, you'll:

  • Set and communicate long-term architectural vision, aligning teams and leadership across Twilio.
  • Lead cross-product architecture reviews, standardize engineering practices, and drive foundational technical investments.
  • Solve the most complex, ambiguous technical challenges at platform and company-wide scale.
  • Mentor and guide principal and staff engineers, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Partner closely with product, engineering, and executive leaders to shape strategic direction and technical investments.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 15+ years of experience designing and scaling distributed systems and platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to set technical vision and strategy at an enterprise or company-wide level.
  • Expertise in system design, reliability, scalability, security, and cost optimization for large-scale architectures.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and resolving highly complex, ambiguous technical problems.
  • Proven record of mentoring senior engineering talent and elevating organizational standards.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, influence, and leadership skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

Desired:

  • Experience in cloud-native, multi-region systems and architecture patterns.
  • History of driving adoption of engineering standards across multiple business units or product lines.
  • Experience with observability, platform capabilities, and data architecture at scale.
  • Open-source project leadership or significant external technical impact.
  • Prior experience in high-growth SaaS, communications, or platform companies

Location

This role will be remote, and based in India (Karnataka, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi, Tamilnadu).

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @ email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.description:
Position: Copy Editor

Location: US (remote)

Role Overview:

Jerusalem News Syndicate (JNS), the fastest-growing news agency covering Israel and the Jewish world, is seeking a full-time Copy Editor to join our editorial team. This is a fully remote role open to anyone in the United States.

The ideal candidate will have experience in copy editing for English news publication, a strong understanding of the US/Israel political landscape, and a commitment to our mission. This role requires sharp attention to detail, excellent writing and editing skills, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced news environment. Responsibilities include proofreading, copyediting, and publishing content via WordPress, covering opinion pieces, news articles, and press releases. The Copy Editor will also participate in editorial meetings and collaborate with supervisors to ensure the highest editorial standards.

What You’ll Do:

  • Proofread and copyedit a continuous stream of opinion pieces, briefs, news and feature articles, press releases, and aggregated content about Israel and the Jewish world to a consistent high quality in a timely manner.
  • Flag and correct factual errors and inconsistencies, including verifying names, dates, statistics, quotes, and links, including following up with writers when information is unclear or unverifiable
  • Check for plagiarism as needed for each story
  • Edit headlines, subheads, and photo captions to improve clarity and accuracy
  • Ensure that all texts conform to JNS editorial standards and abide by the highest quality
  • Publishing finished articles to the CMS
  • Update the website as needed (i.e. uploading breaking news items)

What You Bring:

  • 2+ years of copyediting experience at news/media publications, with expertise in US/Israel political issues, Jewish topics, and online publishing
  • Native English speaker
  • Solid understanding of the Israel/US political landscape and Global/American Jewish communities
  • Proficiency in WordPress and related content-management tools
  • Strong editorial background with excellent proofreading, communication, and adherence to style guides.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Experience in fact-checking and plagiarism detection is a plus.
  • Must reside and be eligible to legally work in the US

Why JNS

  • Be part of a mission-driven organization dedicated to journalistic integrity.
  • Work in an innovative and collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth.
  • Join a passionate team committed to delivering high-quality news coverage.

About Us:

Jerusalem News Syndicate (JNS) is the fastest-growing news agency covering Israel and the Jewish world. We provide news, briefs, features, opinions, and analysis to 100 print newspapers and digital publications on a daily basis.

We are dedicated to upholding the highest standards of journalism, ensuring accuracy and honesty in all our communications regarding Jewish concerns. Our team is committed to uncovering and refuting false narratives while delivering fully reported and credible material.

With 50.000 users and 120.000 devices under management, we’re solving hybrid work challenges like laptop deliveries, returns and equipment tracking, allowing IT teams to focus less on manual hassles and more on strategic initiatives.

Join our team to help shape the future of global collaboration. At Workwize, your work will make a real impact in building smarter, more connected workplaces worldwide.

LinkedIn has also recognized Workwize as one of the Top 10 Startups for 2025 in the Netherlands!

If you’re a QA Engineer with a passion for optimizing systems, working with cutting-edge integrations, and enhancing user experiences, Workwize could be the perfect fit for you!

About the Role

We’re looking for a skilled QA Engineer to enhance the quality of our established Workwize platform. Your mission will be to elevate system functionality, work closely with developers, and ensure robust integration testing. This role is perfect for someone eager to contribute to a high-quality, streamlined user experience.

In this role, you'll also be responsible for writing automated end-to-end tests using Cypress and Playwright, supporting the team in maintaining existing features, and actively contributing to the development of new ones. You’ll help drive a "shift-left" approach, ensuring that quality is embedded early in the development process and championing best practices that foster a culture of testing and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Develop a Comprehensive QA Strategy:

  • Create, document, and maintain a clear QA strategy that aligns with our operational goals and product roadmap.
  • Promote a shift-left testing culture, ensuring quality considerations are embedded from the early stages of design and development.
  • Collaborate with developers and product owners to ensure the strategy is well understood and consistently applied across all teams and codebases.

Collaboration and Continuous Improvement:

  • Work closely with developers throughout the SDLC to provide feedback on testability, code quality, and potential edge cases.
  • Support the team in both maintaining existing features and ensuring high quality in the development of new features.
  • Manage bugs, incidents, and root cause analysis efforts, while continuously improving quality practices and testing standards.

Testing and Automation:

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated end-to-end and integration tests for our Laravel and React applications.
  • Develop and manage API test suites to validate backend functionality, performance, and reliability.
  • Leverage Cypress and Playwright to automate high-value test scenarios that reflect real-world user behavior.
  • Continuously improve and scale our test automation infrastructure to accelerate development workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience as a QA Engineer or Software Tester.
  • Experience with Automation Testing is non negotiable.
  • Strong knowledge of testing methodologies and tools
  • Experience with Postman API testing suite and Cypress & Playwright.
  • Familiarity with Javascript and PHP.
  • Familiarity with Github Actions and CI/CD.
  • Familiarity with AWS services is a plus.

The Right Mindset

  • Analytical mind with great attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Working location

About SemiAnalysis

SemiAnalysis is an independent research and analysis firm specializing in the Semiconductor and AI industries. Our in-depth coverage spans the entire supply chain, from semiconductor fabrication processes to cutting-edge AI Models, software, and infrastructure. We are recognized as the leading authority on the semiconductor supply chain, with the highest concentration of industry experts within one team, and a deep-rooted passion for delving into the intricacies.

We are a global team of analysts, each with extensive networks across the semiconductor supply chain and AI ecosystem, publishing industry shaping articles while participating in numerous conferences annually.

Our newsletters reach more than 200,000 subscribers worldwide, including senior management and c-suite leaders at the leading semiconductor and AI companies.

We also offer three core products:

  • Industry Models – we develop and publish industry models on accelerator shipments, datacentre demand and supply, GPU total cost of ownership, and more. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, many of the world’s largest hedge funds, and government agencies.

  • Core Research – our public equity markets product, geared towards financial investors, distils our deep technical research and knowledge into key insights on technology and product trends.

  • Consulting and Technical Due Diligence – We conduct custom research and project work to guide key strategic and investment decisions for the largest private equity funds, leading venture capital firms, companies across the AI ecosystem, and government agencies.


Position Overview

SemiAnalysis is seeking an Economist to connect our proprietary semiconductor, supply chain, and datacenter datasets with the broader macroeconomic picture.

This role will lead the firm’s research on the economics of artificial intelligence, including AI infrastructure investment, productivity growth, labor market effects, economic diffusion, and the contribution of datacenter development to GDP.

The Economist will produce flagship research that informs investors, policymakers, technology companies, and other decision-makers. The ideal candidate combines rigorous economic research, strong quantitative capabilities, and the ability to communicate complex ideas to a broad and sophisticated audience.

Responsibilities

  • Author flagship, long-form research on the macroeconomics of AI, including:

    • AI and datacenter capital expenditure cycles

    • Productivity and economic growth effects

    • GDP contribution from AI infrastructure development

    • Labor market and employment impacts

    • The economics and pace of AI adoption and diffusion

  • Build quantitative models and forecasting infrastructure that translate complex data into actionable economic insights.

  • Develop LLM-driven research and estimation pipelines that convert unstructured information—such as company filings, earnings transcripts, news reports, and planning permits—into structured economic datasets and time series.

  • Translate SemiAnalysis’s bottom-up datasets, including accelerator shipments, datacenter capacity, electricity demand, networking infrastructure, and related supply chain data, into top-down macroeconomic estimates.

  • Conduct econometric analysis and develop forecasts that can be used by investors, corporations, policymakers, and research institutions.

  • Engage with leading academic and policy debates involving:

    • Transformative AI and long-term economic growth

    • AI-driven productivity measurement

    • Explosive growth scenarios

    • Technological diffusion and innovation economics

  • Develop and communicate clear, informed views on where prevailing AI economic frameworks are accurate, incomplete, or incorrect.

  • Represent SemiAnalysis’s economic research and perspectives through client discussions, podcasts, conferences, interviews, and public writing.

  • Work closely with analysts covering semiconductors, datacenters, energy, networking, and AI systems to produce integrated research.

Requirements

  • Bachelors' Degree in Economics or equivalent professional research experience.

  • Strong research background in one or more of the following areas:

    • Macroeconomics

    • Labor economics

    • Innovation economics

    • Productivity

    • Economic growth

    • Industrial organization

  • Demonstrated ability to produce rigorous economic analysis using real-world and imperfect datasets.

  • Strong empirical, econometric, and quantitative modelling skills.

  • Proficiency in Python or another relevant programming language, with the ability to independently build data pipelines, models, and forecasting tools.

  • Ability to collect, clean, structure, and analyze large amounts of messy or unstructured information.

  • Strong written communication skills, with experience producing research for audiences beyond a narrow academic specialization.

  • Evidence of widely read research, long-form journalism, essays, publications, or other analytical writing.

  • Genuine and informed interest in the economics of AI, including familiarity with transformative AI, productivity, automation, and technological growth debates.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced research environment where accuracy, originality, and speed are equally important.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience integrating large language models into quantitative research workflows, including:

    • Agent-based research pipelines

    • Structured data extraction

    • Automated classification

    • Forecasting and estimation systems

  • Previous experience at a:

    • Central bank

    • Government or policy institution

    • Sell-side economics research team

    • Investment research firm

    • Economics-focused publication

  • Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing, AI accelerators, datacenter infrastructure, energy markets, or networking systems.

  • Experience translating technical or industry-specific datasets into broader economic indicators and forecasts.

  • Strong public communication skills, including experience speaking with clients, appearing on podcasts, presenting research, or engaging with the media.

  • Ability to form independent views and challenge established economic assumptions using new evidence.

Growth Areas

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Define and build SemiAnalysis’s economics research coverage from the ground up.

  • Become a leading public voice on the macroeconomic consequences of artificial intelligence.

  • Develop proprietary economic indicators based on unique semiconductor, datacenter, energy, and supply chain datasets.

  • Expand into new research areas such as AI investment cycles, sovereign AI strategies, labor displacement, productivity measurement, and long-term economic growth.

  • Build advanced forecasting and research infrastructure using econometrics, machine learning, and LLM-driven workflows.

  • Work directly with investors, technology companies, policymakers, central banks, and other institutions shaping the development and adoption of AI.

  • Publish research with the potential to move markets, influence corporate strategy, and inform economic policy.

  • Grow into a leadership position overseeing economics research, forecasting, and broader macroeconomic coverage within SemiAnalysis.

Nemours Radiology is seeking three additional Pediatric Radiologists to join our current overnight group as a 100% remote nighthawk, 1 week on and 2 weeks off model. Emergency neuroradiology experience is preferred but not required. We offer a competitive salary and generous signing bonus.

Nemours Radiology is one of the largest pediatric radiology groups in the United States, currently composed of 46 pediatric radiologists, growing to over 50 in 2026, working together to provide state-of-the-art diagnostic and interventional radiology services at our locations in Delaware, Florida, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. Nemours Radiology provides full pediatric imaging services (diagnostic and interventional) for Nemours Children’s Hospital, Delaware, in Wilmington, Nemours Children’s Hospital, Florida, in Orlando, Nemours Children’s Specialty Care in Jacksonville, FL, Nemours Children’s Clinic at Studer Family Children's Hospital at Ascension Sacred Heart in Pensacola, FL, Wolfson Children’s Hospital in Jacksonville, FL as well as several hospital partners for pediatric radiology. Overview

The Touro University Graduate School of Social Work is seeking candidates for a full-time (10-month appointment), online, Assistant/Associate Professor in Social Work. The successful candidate must have demonstrated capability to teach in multiple modalities including synchronous (Zoom), and asynchronous online formats. Successful candidates will exhibit a commitment to excellence in teaching, mentoring, instructional design, and engaged scholarship. Experience should include curriculum development, education best practices, instruction/teaching in social work, student advising, ability to engage students both in and out of the classroom. Ideal candidates will have a defined area of research and scholarship and a social work practice area of expertise. Associate-level candidates are expected to demonstrate a sustained record of publications or contributions to an area of expertise. Demonstrated experience with CSWE Accreditation Standards is a plus. A typical workday will entail teaching, advising, and meetings. Faculty carry a 21-credit workload per academic year, with responsibilities distributed across teaching, scholarship, and service. Faculty participate in MSW program activities as needed (orientation, community days, committee meetings, and curriculum development), and will also contribute on departmental and university-wide committees.

The mission of the Touro University Graduate School of Social Work is to educate graduates for clinical social work practice in an urban, and multicultural environment. This is consistent with the general mission of Touro University, which is to provide professional education for the benefit of the individual and society. This general mission is an expression of the Jewish religious tenet of Tikkun Olam, the striving to make the world a better place for all people. In accordance with traditional social work values, the Graduate School of Social Work is committed to providing accessible and affordable quality education to all. The MSW program's educational purpose is to prepare self-reflective professionals who can meet the complex needs of a multitude of populations. The school's curriculum is informed by the person-in-environment, ecological and strengths-based perspectives. The school provides students with a social work education that offers a theoretical and evidence-based foundation in generalist social work, as well as advanced knowledge and skills for effective clinical social work. This education prepares graduates for leadership roles in clinical social work practice with varied populations in the contemporary service delivery environment.

This Is More Than a Care Coordination Role

In rural healthcare, helping a patient safely move through the healthcare system often requires creativity, persistence, and strong community relationships.

Case management, social work, and care coordination professionals help connect patients and families with the clinical care, resources, education, and support they need. They may address barriers involving transportation, housing, insurance, behavioral health, long-term care, family support, or access to specialty services far from home.

The strongest professionals understand that a discharge plan is more than paperwork. It is a bridge between the hospital, the patient's home, local providers, community resources, and the next stage of care.

  • Complex Care Manager
  • Patient Navigation Leadership

Responsibilities will vary by organization and position and may include:

  • Coordinating safe and appropriate patient transitions
  • Developing discharge and follow-up care plans
  • Assessing clinical, social, financial, and community needs
  • Connecting patients and families with local and regional resources
  • Collaborating with physicians, nurses, therapists, behavioral health professionals, and community partners
  • Supporting utilization review, medical necessity, and level-of-care processes
  • Communicating with payers and supporting authorization or denial-management processes
  • Reducing avoidable readmissions and delays in care
  • Supporting patients with complex medical or social needs
  • Coordinating referrals to home health, skilled nursing, rehabilitation, hospice, behavioral health, or specialty care
  • Helping patients navigate insurance, transportation, housing, medication, and other barriers
  • Developing policies, procedures, workflows, and documentation standards
  • Monitoring quality, outcomes, length of stay, and departmental performance
  • Leading, mentoring, and supporting case management or social work teams
  • Building stronger connections between the healthcare organization and the community

What You Will Bring

Qualifications will vary by opportunity, but organizations may seek:

  • Experience in case management, medical social work, utilization review, discharge planning, care coordination, or population health
  • Previous leadership experience for director, manager, or supervisory opportunities
  • Knowledge of healthcare delivery, payer requirements, medical necessity, and patient transitions
  • Experience working with patients and families facing complex clinical or social needs
  • Strong communication, assessment, advocacy, and problem-solving skills
  • The ability to collaborate across clinical, operational, and community teams
  • Experience with rural hospitals, Critical Access Hospitals, FQHCs, public hospital districts, long-term care, or community healthcare organizations
  • Relevant education, licensure, or certification based on the position

Some opportunities may require or prefer credentials such as RN, LMSW, LCSW, ACM, CCM, or another case management, nursing, or social work credential. Requirements will depend on the specific position.

Why Rural Wyoming?

Wyoming's rural healthcare organizations serve communities surrounded by mountains, high plains, ranchlands, rivers, open roads, and wide-open spaces. Long distances, limited transportation, workforce shortages, and fewer local services can make care transitions especially challenging.

Working in case management, social work, or care coordination in a rural setting offers the opportunity to help patients overcome real barriers, strengthen community connections, and make care feel more coordinated and humane.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager
jobs.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.
jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.

As the Senior Operations Manager, you are the company's logistics engine — owning and driving end-to-end execution across suppliers, freight, inventory, and fulfillment. You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools, automations, or workflows is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Growth mindset): continuously seeks to learn, improve, and grow.
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): operates with transparency and high ethical standards.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Efficiency: builds systems that maximize output and eliminate wasted effort.
  • Analytical skills: applies financial thinking to every operational decision.
  • Organization & Planning: manages multiple complex workflows without failure.
  • Calm under pressure: maintains performance and clarity in high-stress situations.
  • High standards: operates with a zero-error mindset on execution and reporting.
  • Enthusiasm: brings energy and passion for logistics, AI, and operational excellence.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of critical operations and supply chain performance.
  • High impact role with significant autonomy and decision-making power.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an operations leader who thrives in high-performance environments, combines analytical thinking with execution excellence, and is driven by ownership, accountability, and continuous optimization.

jobs.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.
jobs.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a highly driven, execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Senior Operations Manager opening.

As the Senior Operations Manager, you are the company's logistics engine — owning and driving end-to-end execution across suppliers, freight, inventory, and fulfillment. You don't just manage operations — you obsess over them. Every shipment is tracked, every forwarder is held accountable, and every purchase order is placed with full awareness of its financial impact.

You lead by doing — raising the execution bar of the team through hands-on involvement, system building, and continuous improvement. You actively leverage AI, not as a tool, but as a core operational layer — building systems, automations, and workflows that improve visibility, accuracy, and decision-making.

This is not a role for someone who wants to maintain what exists. It is for someone hungry to improve, optimize, and prove they can operate at a high-performance level.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Own Supply Chain Execution & Pipeline Visibility

  • Maintain live pipeline visibility at all times — including China warehouse status, vessels in transit (ETD/ETA), and inventory received stateside. The pipeline never surprises the business.
  • Deliver month-end inventory snapshots and quarter-end reconciliations to finance without being asked.
  • Ensure AI systems automatically flag anomalies across the pipeline (delays, mismatches, risks).
  • Ensure 100% on-time product launches, QC pass rate >98% on first inspection, and On Time In Full (OTIF) >95% by Month 6.
  • Maintain >98% in-stock rate on top revenue SKUs, aged inventory <8% of total units, and drive inventory turns toward 5–8x annually.
  • Secure a minimum of 3 freight quotes per booking and ensure no forwarder is retained without performance data (ETD accuracy, delays, cost benchmarks).
  • Maintain and update a rolling 12-week supply plan, with AI-driven risk detection and reorder triggers before stockouts occur.

Drive Financial Discipline in Operations

  • Maintain a standing financial analysis for every active supplier — including cash flow impact, landed cost, and MOQ trade-offs — continuously updated via AI-powered tools.
  • Ensure no purchase order is committed to excess inventory without documented financial justification.
  • Track landed cost against target COGS on every order.
  • Deliver a monthly operations cost summary (freight, duty, storage, COGS trends) — compiled and formatted automatically via AI tools.
  • Ensure 100% application of Nairobi Protocol and all applicable duty exemptions.
  • Build and maintain an AI system that verifies HS codes and eligibility before every freight booking — zero exceptions.

Build SOPs & Scalable Systems

  • Conduct a full operational audit within the first 60 days, clearly identifying what is working, broken, missing, and where AI can enhance execution.
  • First 30 days are dedicated to learning, not restructuring, followed by a prioritized improvement roadmap presented to the Head of Operations.
  • Ensure all SOPs are documented, tested, live in Asana, and followed without supervision.
  • Audit every SOP for AI acceleration opportunities.
  • Build and implement at least 2 AI-powered tools within the first 6 months, and document and hand them off as repeatable team processes.
  • Ensure SOPs are reviewed quarterly and continuously optimized.

Own DTC Fulfillment & Inventory Strategy

  • Ensure all supply planning accounts for total demand across all channels (Amazon, DTC, wholesale, and emerging channels) — no decision is made without a full demand picture.
  • Maintain an AI-powered demand model that continuously updates forecasts and surfaces risks.
  • Ensure DTC and Amazon inventory pools never compete for the same units, with AI monitoring stock levels and reorder thresholds.
  • Own DTC fulfillment performance end-to-end — cost, lead time, and service level — escalating issues with proposed solutions before customer impact.

Lead and Develop the Operations Team

  • Assess all team members within the first 30 days, identifying strengths, gaps, and development needs.
  • Define clear ownership and weekly KPIs for each team member, ensuring accountability and independent execution.
  • Address performance gaps within 7 days — no prolonged underperformance.
  • Ensure no team member requires daily oversight on core responsibilities.
  • Coach the team on financial awareness and AI adoption, ensuring each team member delivers at least one AI-driven workflow improvement within the first 6 months.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Amazon FBA operations, including shipment creation, AWD, inventory management, and compliance.
  • Proven experience managing overseas suppliers (preferably China), booking freight with multiple forwarders, and handling customs and duty optimization.
  • Strong experience managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels, with a track record of maintaining high in-stock rates and controlling aged inventory.
  • Experience leading and managing a team (minimum 2 direct reports), with clear evidence of accountability and performance management.
  • Proven experience building, following, and improving SOPs and operational processes.
  • Hands-on experience building AI tools, automations, or workflows is strongly preferred.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Growth mindset): continuously seeks to learn, improve, and grow.
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do and brings new ideas.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): operates with transparency and high ethical standards.

Leadership Competencies:

  • Efficiency: builds systems that maximize output and eliminate wasted effort.
  • Analytical skills: applies financial thinking to every operational decision.
  • Organization & Planning: manages multiple complex workflows without failure.
  • Calm under pressure: maintains performance and clarity in high-stress situations.
  • High standards: operates with a zero-error mindset on execution and reporting.
  • Enthusiasm: brings energy and passion for logistics, AI, and operational excellence.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct ownership of critical operations and supply chain performance.
  • High impact role with significant autonomy and decision-making power.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for an operations leader who thrives in high-performance environments, combines analytical thinking with execution excellence, and is driven by ownership, accountability, and continuous optimization.

jobs.excerpt: Investment AssociateThe analytical, transactional and communications engine of a lean investment team Function: Investment & Investment Operations Reporting to: CEO & COO Location: Abu Dhabi, ADGM Working arrangement: Remote The RoleRole PurposeThe Investment Associate supports the origination, evaluation, execution and monitoring of investments across the Firm, its Funds and the SPVs through which investments are held.
jobs.description:
Investment Associate

The analytical, transactional and communications engine of a lean investment team

Function: Investment & Investment Operations
Reporting to: CEO & COO
Location: Abu Dhabi, ADGM
Working arrangement: Remote

The Role

Role Purpose

The Investment Associate supports the origination, evaluation, execution and monitoring of investments across the Firm, its Funds and the SPVs through which investments are held.

Working closely with the CEO, COO and CFO, the role provides the analytical, transactional and communications support required by a lean investment team—from initial screening and SPV establishment through to transaction completion, portfolio monitoring and investor reporting.

This is a hands-on position offering broad exposure across investment management, deal execution, investor relations and investment operations.

Why This Role, Now

The Firm has onboarded executive management, including a Chief Operating Officer and Chief Financial Officer, and is building the operational platform required for its next stage of growth.

The Firm is digitalising its operations through a governed document-management system, a centralised action register and a scalable, automated operating model supporting a deliberately lean team.

This position forms part of the next stage of the Firm's growth and platform development.

Key Responsibilities

Investment and Deal Execution

  • Manage live transactions from commencement through to completion under the COO's direction.
  • Coordinate transaction timetables, data rooms, counterparties and external advisers.
  • Support commercial, financial, legal and operational due diligence.
  • Monitor transaction requirements, outstanding actions and closing deliverables.
  • Ensure transaction records and supporting documentation remain complete and audit-ready.

Financial Analysis and Modelling

  • Build and maintain financial models, valuations and sensitivity analyses.
  • Conduct commercial, market, industry and counterparty due diligence.
  • Analyse financial performance, operating metrics and investment risks.
  • Prepare clear recommendations and supporting analysis for investment decisions.
  • Review investment assumptions and identify material risks, sensitivities and value drivers.

Investment Memoranda and Committee Papers

  • Prepare investment memoranda, Investment Committee papers and transaction summaries.
  • Produce post-completion reviews and portfolio updates.
  • Ensure all materials are prepared to a Board-ready and investor-ready standard.
  • Coordinate supporting information and respond to questions arising during the approval process.

SPV Establishment and Administration

  • Work with the COO to establish and maintain investment SPVs.
  • Coordinate with external legal counsel, outsourced service providers and the fund administrator.
  • Support the preparation of constitutional documents, registers, bank accounts and closing documentation.
  • Manage SPV establishment and transaction-closing mechanics.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records throughout the SPV lifecycle.

Portfolio Monitoring and Investment Pipeline

  • Monitor portfolio performance, financial results and key operating indicators.
  • Support the CFO's quarterly valuation process using IPEV methodology.
  • Gather and analyse underlying financial and operational data from portfolio companies.
  • Maintain portfolio schedules, investment records and performance reporting.
  • Support origination through funding-round tracking, secondary-market monitoring and broker-flow analysis.
  • Maintain the investment target pipeline and transaction schedules.
  • Identify and escalate emerging market, sector and investment themes to the CEO and COO.

Investor Relations and Communications

  • Support fundraising activities and ongoing investor communications.
  • Prepare quarterly investor reports, presentations and other reporting materials.
  • Coordinate responses to due diligence questionnaires and investor information requests.
  • Prepare and maintain investor data-room content.
  • Ensure communications are accurate and appropriate for Professional Clients and Market Counterparties.
  • Contribute to investor presentations, updates and transaction announcements.

Investment Operations

  • Establish and maintain transaction, investor and portfolio data rooms.
  • Complete due diligence questionnaires and support investor due diligence processes.
  • Support Limited Partner onboarding, KYC and AML documentation requirements.
  • Assist with the administration of capital calls and distributions.
  • Act as a day-to-day liaison with the outsourced fund administrator.
  • Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready investment and investor records.
  • Support ongoing compliance, governance and regulatory reporting requirements.

Process and Operational Development

  • Contribute to the development of the Firm's operations manual and standard operating procedures.
  • Document and improve processes across fund operations, the SPV lifecycle, investor onboarding and investor reporting.
  • Support the implementation of scalable digital workflows and automated operating processes.
  • Identify operational gaps and recommend practical improvements.

Digital Profile and Firm Communications

  • Manage and update the Firm's website, LinkedIn page and other relevant communication channels.
  • Contribute to transaction announcements, market updates and thought-leadership content.
  • Ensure public communications are professional, accurate and consistent with the Firm's regulatory obligations.

General Firm Support

  • Contribute to the broader operation of a small, regulated investment firm.
  • Support record-keeping, management information and internal reporting.
  • Assist colleagues across functions where required.
  • Undertake other responsibilities typical of an associate position within a growing investment-management firm.

Candidate Profile

Qualifications

  • CFA Level III candidate or recently qualified CFA preferred.
  • Strong degree in finance, economics, accounting, business or a related discipline.
  • CA, CPA or ACCA qualifications are also highly regarded and may be considered alongside or in place of the CFA.

Experience

  • Approximately 2–5 years of relevant experience in investment management, private markets, investment banking or corporate finance.
  • Demonstrated transaction-execution and financial-modelling experience.
  • Private equity or venture capital experience is preferred.
  • Familiarity with investment funds, SPVs and private-market structures is advantageous.
  • Experience preparing investment memoranda, valuations, investor materials or Investment Committee papers is highly regarded.
  • Exposure to investor onboarding, KYC, fund administration or portfolio reporting is beneficial.

Technical Capabilities

  • Strong financial modelling, valuation and analytical skills.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint capabilities.
  • Ability to interpret financial statements, operating metrics and transaction documents.
  • Strong written communication and presentation skills.
  • High attention to detail and disciplined document-management practices.
  • Familiarity with IPEV valuation methodology is advantageous.

Personal Attributes

  • A practical problem solver who identifies gaps and takes responsibility for closing them.
  • Highly motivated, adaptable and willing to contribute across all areas of the business.
  • Collaborative and comfortable supporting colleagues outside the immediate scope of the role.
  • Commercially minded, organised and capable of managing competing priorities.
  • Discreet and trustworthy when handling confidential Board, Investment Committee, portfolio and investor information.
  • Comfortable working in a lean team where initiative, accountability and execution are essential.

Working Style

  • Able to operate effectively and independently in a remote environment.
  • Disciplined in maintaining records, deadlines, communication and reporting cadence.
  • Proactive in providing updates and escalating issues.
  • Comfortable working across multiple transactions, stakeholders and time zones.
  • Able to maintain institutional-quality standards without requiring close supervision.

Working Arrangement

This position is offered on a remote basis. The Firm is headquartered in Abu Dhabi Global Market and operates as a distributed team.

The successful candidate must:

  • Work core hours aligned with Gulf Standard Time.
  • Be available to travel to Abu Dhabi periodically when required.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality and information-security standards.
  • Comply with all document-management, record-keeping and regulatory requirements.
  • Handle material relating to the Board, Investment Committee, portfolio companies and Limited Partners to the same professional standard regardless of working location.

About the Firm

The Firm is an active technology investor headquartered in Abu Dhabi Global Market and regulated by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority.

It specialises in late-stage and pre-IPO investment opportunities across artificial intelligence, compute infrastructure, space, deep technology and fintech. Investors are provided access to private-market opportunities through professionally governed SPV structures.

The Firm has invested in more than 30 companies with a combined net asset value exceeding US$400 million. It is expanding its regulatory permissions to support the launch of pooled investment funds across private equity, venture capital and real estate.

The Firm serves a sophisticated investor base that includes sovereign wealth funds, financial institutions, family offices and professional investors. This position offers broad exposure to the development and scaling of an institutional investment platform.

How to Apply

This position description is indicative. As a growing regulated firm with a lean team, responsibilities may be shaped around the particular strengths and capabilities of the successful candidate.

Candidates who closely match the requirements and demonstrate strong capability are encouraged to apply, even if they do not meet every listed criterion.

Expressions of interest should be submitted through the introducing recruitment consultant.

jobs.excerpt: The National Technical Training Manager is responsible for developing and delivering technical, product, and practice-development training for employees and customers across the independent eye care professional channel.
jobs.description:
The National Technical Training Manager is responsible for developing and delivering technical, product, and practice-development training for employees and customers across the independent eye care professional channel. This role builds the knowledge, skills, and confidence of sales teams, customer-facing employees, and eye care professionals to support exceptional patient care, effective product positioning, and sustainable business growth.

Serving as a technical subject matter expert, the National Technical Training Manager translates complex optical concepts, technologies, and product information into engaging and practical learning experiences. The role leads both in-person and virtual training, supports new product and technology launches, develops training content and resources, and delivers continuing education programs, including ABO/NCLE-approved education.

The position partners closely with Learning & Development, Sales, Business Development, Marketing, Product Management, R&D, Global Training, and other cross-functional teams to ensure technical training is aligned with business priorities, customer needs, and evolving industry trends.

Technical Training & Facilitation

  • Develop and deliver engaging in-person, virtual, and blended learning programs covering the full product portfolio, optical principles and technologies, product positioning, and practice development.
  • Translate complex technical and optical information into clear, practical learning experiences appropriate for different audiences and levels of expertise.
  • Facilitate technical education for sales teams, customer-facing employees, customers, and eye care professionals.
  • Adapt training methods and content based on learner needs, business priorities, product developments, and market conditions.
  • Maintain a high level of technical and industry knowledge to provide credible, relevant, and current education.

National Training Program Management

  • Lead the planning and execution of annual and ongoing technical training initiatives across the organization.
  • Develop training plans and learning experiences supporting new product launches, advanced optical technologies, business initiatives, and practice-development opportunities.
  • Coordinate training calendars, audiences, content, resources, and delivery requirements to ensure effective execution.
  • Partner with Learning & Development leadership to identify training priorities and develop scalable learning solutions.
  • Evaluate training effectiveness and use learner feedback, business needs, and performance insights to continuously improve programs.

Customer & Employee Development

  • Provide specialized technical and product training to sales representatives, customer service employees, and other customer-facing teams.
  • Equip commercial teams with the technical knowledge and product-positioning capabilities needed to confidently engage customers and support business growth.
  • Develop customer-facing educational programs that strengthen product understanding and help eye care professionals apply technical knowledge to patient and practice needs.
  • Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to identify customer education needs and develop targeted learning solutions.
  • Support practice-development education designed to help customers improve patient experiences and strengthen their businesses.

Continuing Education

  • Develop, maintain, and deliver continuing education programs that meet applicable ABO/NCLE requirements.
  • Facilitate approved continuing education courses virtually and in person at customer events, trade shows, conferences, and other industry programs.
  • Maintain required speaker qualifications and ensure continuing education content remains current and compliant with applicable standards.
  • Partner with Sales, Business Development, Marketing, and other teams to develop educational workshops that combine technical expertise with practice-development opportunities.

Training Content & Curriculum Development

  • Develop, review, and continuously improve technical training materials, presentations, facilitator guides, webinars, job aids, and other learning resources.
  • Partner with Marketing, Product Management, and Learning & Development to ensure training content is technically accurate, commercially relevant, engaging, and consistent with product positioning.
  • Support the development of training materials for new products, technologies, and strategic initiatives.
  • Ensure learning content can be effectively used across multiple audiences and delivery formats.

Technical Subject Matter Expertise

  • Serve as a technical and optical subject matter expert to internal teams and customers.
  • Collaborate with Marketing, Product Management, R&D, Global Training, Sales, Business Development, and other functions to support strategic initiatives.
  • Provide technical expertise during product launches, educational events, customer meetings, and internal development programs.
  • Stay current on emerging optical technologies, products, competitive developments, professional standards, and industry trends.
  • Translate technical and market developments into relevant learning opportunities for employees and customers.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Build strong partnerships across Learning & Development, Sales, Marketing, Product Management, R&D, Customer Service, Business Development, and Global Training.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects requiring technical training or optical expertise.
  • Represent the technical training function at internal meetings, customer events, trade shows, conferences, and other industry forums.
  • Balance training priorities across multiple stakeholders while maintaining focus on organizational and customer objectives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • 3-5+ years of training, technical education, facilitation, or related experience, preferably within the optical, vision care, medical device, healthcare, or a similarly technical industry.
  • Strong knowledge of optical products, technologies, industry practices, and relevant market trends.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and delivering effective technical or product training programs.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, public-speaking, and virtual-training capabilities.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into understandable and actionable information for diverse audiences.
  • Commercial awareness and understanding of how education, product positioning, and practice-development strategies can support customer and business growth.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across functions and organizational levels.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional environment.

  • Experience supporting product launches or commercial training within the optical industry.
  • Experience delivering education at industry conferences, trade shows, or large customer events.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

Job Summary:

Location: 100% remote (US only), supporting VA medical centers in VISN 7 Term: 12-month base period plus four 12-month option periods. Pay: 25.00/hr-30.00/hr

About the role

Aptive Resources is hiring remote outpatient coders to support Veterans Affairs medical centers in Georgia, Alabama, and South Carolina. You'll code clinic visits, ancillary services, and outpatient surgery for Veterans, using the VA's electronic health record. This is the largest part of the contract, with about 240,000 outpatient encounters a year across the Atlanta, Columbia, Birmingham, Augusta, and Central Alabama facilities.

Primary Responsibilities

What you'll do

  • Code outpatient encounters, including clinic visits, urgent care, radiology, lab, other ancillary services, and outpatient surgery, using ICD-10-CM, CPT-4, and HCPCS Level II.
  • Assign E/M levels according to current E/M guidelines, CPT Assistant, and Coding Clinic.
  • Apply NCCI bundling edits, and add modifiers when appropriate to override them (for example 25, 59, and 91).
  • Check that multiple CPT codes aren't parts of a larger procedure that one code describes.
  • Assign an ICD-10 diagnosis to each ancillary or diagnostic test, based on why it was ordered.
  • Review documentation in CPRS and enter codes and data in the VistA Patient Care Encounter (PCE) package through the VA-approved encoder.
  • Decide whether an encounter is billable, and flag duplicate encounters, encounters created in error, and records that don't support the codes.
  • Re-review your coded records when the VA questions them before billing or after a claim is denied.
  • Maintain at least 95% accuracy and meet each facility's turnaround times.

Minimum Qualifications

Required qualifications

  • An active CPC, CCS, CCS-P, RHIT, RHIA, or CPC-H credential.
  • At least 2 years of recent outpatient coding experience, including E/M, ancillary services, and outpatient procedures.
  • Completion of an accredited coding, HIM, or health information technician program.
  • Formal training in anatomy and physiology, medical terminology, pathophysiology, pharmacology, and reimbursement methods.
  • Strong knowledge of CPT, HCPCS, NCCI edits, and modifiers.
  • Proficiency with an industry-standard encoder.
  • US citizenship, and the ability to pass a federal background investigation (NACI) and fingerprinting.
  • A private, secure home workspace with reliable high-speed internet.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with VA systems, including VistA, CPRS, PCE, and Integrated Billing.
  • Experience coding outpatient surgery or ambulatory surgery.
  • Experience coding radiology or lab for a hospital.

Additional requirements

  • Complete the VA's annual Privacy and Information Security Awareness and HIPAA training (TMS 10176 and 10203) before starting, and once a year after that.
  • Follow AHIMA's Standards of Ethical Coding and VA confidentiality rules. Don't use "incident to" billing rules.
  • Aptive provides the laptop, encoder, and reference materials.

About Aptive

Arrow ARC supports Veterans Health Administration facilities and offices across the U.S. with health care staffing and program support via the 10-year Integrated Critical Staffing Program (ICSP). We provide staffing solutions to address critical shortages in VHA medical facilities caused by turnover, recruitment issues, seasonal needs, surges or emergencies.

Arrow is a certified Service-Disabled, Veteran-Owned Small Business joint venture between Artemis ARC and Aptive Resources, two award-winning companies that share an agile, mission-focused, results driven approach in the federal sector.​ Arrow provides management consulting services and specializes in working with federal government agencies like the Department of Veterans Affairs and Office of Personnel Management.​

EEO Statement

Aptive is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, parental status, veteran status, age, disability, or any other protected class.

Veterans, members of the Reserve and National Guard, and transitioning active-duty service members are highly encouraged to apply.

jobs.excerpt: Crum & Forster Company OverviewCrum & Forster (C&F), with a proud history dating to 1822, provides specialty and standard commercial lines insurance products through our admitted and surplus lines insurance companies.
jobs.description:
Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F), with a proud history dating to 1822, provides specialty and standard commercial lines insurance products through our admitted and surplus lines insurance companies. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best and is proud of our superior customer service platform. Our claims and risk engineering services are recognized as among the best in the industry.

Our most valuable asset is our people: more than 2000 employees in locations throughout the United States. The company is increasingly winning recognition as a great place to work, earning several workplace and wellness awards, including the 2025 Great Place to Work® Award for our employee-first focus and our steadfast commitment to diversity, equity and Inclusion.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings, a global, billion dollar organization. For more information about Crum & Forster, please visit our website: www.cfins.com.

Job Description

Since 2000, Crum & Forster’s Accident & Health division (A&H) has offered a diverse portfolio of specialty insurance and reinsurance products nationwide. We place a strong focus on product development and creative distribution methods, along with excellent client service and support.

In addition to our robust domestic portfolio, which spans both special risk and medical solutions, A&H works on an international basis through various partnerships. Our global capabilities provide our partners with even broader flexibility in underwriting solutions. Gross premium written in 2025 surpassed $2.4B. The qualities and capabilities of Crum & Forster Accident & Health demonstrate our philosophy of building meaningful, long-term partnerships and our dedication to providing alternative strategies in an ever-changing insurance market.

The Director, Property & Casualty Claims Program Management is accountable for the carrier’s claims strategy, governance, and performance across an assigned portfolio of delegated and partner-managed P&C programs. This leader manages a team of claims program professionals and establishes a consistent operating model for Third-Party Administrators, Managing General Agents and Underwriters, independent adjusters, and other service partners. The Director will translate enterprise objectives into measurable program outcomes, oversee complex and high-severity claims, strengthen reserving and litigation discipline, and modernize claims through data, automation, and process redesign. Working in a matrixed environment, this role partners closely with Underwriting, Actuarial, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Reinsurance, Distribution, and Technology to protect policyholders, control loss and expense performance, meet regulatory obligations, and support profitable growth.

What you will do for C&F:

  • Claims strategy and leadership: Set and execute the P&C claims program strategy, operating model, service standards, and annual priorities in alignment with underwriting appetite, actuarial assumptions, reinsurance requirements, and enterprise objectives.
  • Talent and culture: Build, coach, and retain a high-performing team of program managers and specialists; set clear goals, develop technical and leadership capability, manage performance and succession, and foster accountability, inclusion, curiosity, and continuous learning.
  • Portfolio accountability: Own financial, operational, customer, quality, compliance, and talent outcomes across assigned.
  • Program governance: Establish a scalable governance framework for TPAs, MGAs/MGUs, independent adjusters, and other partners, with clear authorities, claim referral assignments, timeliness and management protocols, service-level agreements, scorecards, issue escalation, and corrective-action plans.
  • Partner due diligence and onboarding: Lead operational assessments, implementation readiness, data mapping, staffing validation, control testing, catastrophe preparedness, and go-live governance for new and renewed programs.
  • Claim oversight: Conduct annual/bi-annual audits of TPAs, MGAs/MGUs, provide direction on complex, high-severity, coverage-sensitive, extra-contractual, catastrophe, litigated, and potentially systemic claims; ensure timely escalation and accurate reporting to senior management and reinsurers
  • Litigation and vendor management: Partner with Legal to manage counsel guidelines, litigation strategy, legal spending, panel performance, alternative dispute resolution, and vendor outcomes.
  • Regulatory and control environment: Ensure adherence to state unfair claims practices laws, licensing, data privacy, market-conduct, sanctions, record-retention, and internal-control requirements; promptly address complaints and regulatory inquiries.
  • Quality assurance: Maintain a risk-based audit program that evaluates coverage, investigation, reserving, payments, communications, litigation handling, subrogation, salvage, and compliance; verify sustainable remediation.
  • Analytics and executive reporting: Develop meaningful dashboards and portfolio reviews using leading and lagging indicators; synthesize trends, emerging exposures, root causes, and recommended actions for claims, underwriting, actuarial, and executive stakeholders.
  • Fraud, recovery, and expense discipline: Strengthen special-investigation referrals, subrogation, salvage, deductible, and aggregate tracking to improve total claim outcomes.
  • Customer and broker experience: Promote timely, clear, empathetic, and brand-consistent communication while resolving service failures and balancing customer outcomes with coverage, legal, and financial obligations.

What YOU will bring to C&F:

  • Connects claims priorities to enterprise strategy and converts ambiguity into clear decisions, roadmaps, measures, and accountable execution.
  • Demonstrates strong command of coverage, liability, damages, reserving, settlement, litigation, catastrophe, recovery, and expense-management principles across commercial P&C lines.
  • Enterprise-level leadership presence with the ability to translate claims complexity into clear decisions and action.
  • Deep technical judgment across occupational injury, benefit, liability, coverage, litigation, reserving, and recovery considerations.
  • Demonstrated success managing high-dollar referral claim inventory, delegated claims operations, influencing partners, and improving performance without relying solely on direct authority.
  • Strong commercial orientation and the ability to connect claims outcomes with underwriting strategy, customer value, portfolio profitability, and growth.
  • Fluency with claims data, operational metrics, financial drivers, and executive-level storytelling.
  • A disciplined approach to governance, controls, issue management, and regulatory readiness.
  • Change leadership skills, including the ability to simplify processes, adopt technology responsibly, and lead teams through transformation.
  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, relationship management, and talent-development capabilities.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in insurance, risk management, business, finance, law, or equivalent experience.
  • 10+ years of progressively responsible P&C claims experience, including significant experience in commercial or specialty casualty and/or property claims.
  • 5+ years of people leadership, program management, or delegated claims oversight experience within an insurance carrier, TPA, MGA/MGU, or comparable organization.
  • Substantial experience with specialty products such as commercial general liability, commercial auto, property, professional liability, excess casualty, occupational accident, or other program business is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex and high-severity claims, litigation, reserves, coverage issues, audit programs, regulatory matters, and external claim partners.
  • Working knowledge of claims data, dashboards, financial metrics, system integrations, and technology-enabled process improvement.
  • Experience using claims platforms, business intelligence tools, and structured performance measures to drive operational decisions.
  • Relevant insurance designations such as CPCU, AIC, SCLA, ARM, or equivalent preferred
  • Ability to travel for partner due diligence, governance reviews, partner onboarding, business meetings and employee activities.
  • Advance knowledge in Microsoft Office tools – Outlook, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adaptable.

What C&F will bring to you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness, including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenet is owning your career development, so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry-related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee-driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community
