jobs.description:
** Part-time shift, availability for 20-29 hours/week. Must be flexible to work weekdays (days and nights) and weekends (days and nights) as scheduled

Who We Are

BGIS is a leading provider of customized facility management and real estate services. With our combined team of over 6, 500 globally, we relentlessly focus on enabling innovation through the services we deliver, while actively looking for new opportunities that will enable innovation for our clients’ businesses. Globally, we manage over 320 million square feet of client portfolios across 30,000+ locations in North America, Europe, Middle East, Australia and Asia. Further information is available at www.bgis.com

SUMMARY

The RCC Operating Technologist is responsible for remotely operating Building Automation Systems (BAS) in BGIS-managed client facilities. You will implement day-to-day operator level control changes, review trend data to support trouble shooting efforts, implement changes for energy and operational optimization initiatives, and coordinate corrective actions for complex issues.

** Part-time shift, availability for 20-29 hours/week. Must be flexible to work weekdays (days and nights) and weekends (days and nights) as scheduled

KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Support

  • Works with building operators and site managers to identify operational and energy savings in BAS operations.
  • Develops recommendations for BAS system changes and implements approved changes which may include working with contractors and BAS vendors for the programming and remote portal development coordination.
  • Provide input to Project Teams and/or BAS Vendors on scope and remote portal requirements.
  • Performs commissioning inspections to transition projects from installation to an on-going operation.

On-going Operations

  • Responds to demand service requests for BAS/Control related issues to diagnose and rectify.
  • Provides remote technical support to on-site technician team via phone support system.
  • Alarm monitoring and work order dispatch of Critical/High priority alerts.
  • Optimizes facility uptime and asset integrity of assigned facility.
  • Monitor system performance and fault events perform corrective and demand service maintenance on BAS to achieve facility uptime, uninterrupted client operations, occupants’ comfort asset integrity, and energy and operating cost objectives.
  • Coordinate maintenance repairs and implement temporary overrides to minimize impact while awaiting services.
  • Address frequent failures with site team and Vendor. Identify, record and escalate deficiencies and maintain related documentation.
  • Ensure remote platforms are up to date.
  • Receives, actions, tracks, monitors and reports status of maintenance and repair work within the work order management system including progress notes and resolution notes.
  • Upload up-to-date installation documents obtained from installation team and BAS vendors to the BAS after upgrades.
  • Performs work in accordance to established processes and practices.
  • Complies with all internal and external requirements including but not limited to environmental and health and safety.
  • Trains junior operator team members (as required) on daily operations processes and troubleshooting.
  • Must be able to work shifts, be on-call and be available to respond to emergencies.

Client Relations

  • Provides observations about facility building automation equipment and systems conditions and deficiencies and provides suggestions for enhancement and repair.
  • Assists in enhancing tenant and customer satisfaction. Maintain positive relations through the manner with which work is performed and delivered.

Administration

  • Records resolution data within service maintenance management database. Ensures work completed meets quality, contract response and all other requirements.
  • Receives, tracks, monitors and reports status of maintenance and repair work within service maintenance management database.
  • Initiates documents to obtain formal approval of work required.
  • Participates in and assists with facility-related projects.
  • Other duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • College Diploma in a related discipline.
  • BAS or Building Operations courses (Asset).
  • Remote BAS operation for multiple facilities. (3 years)
  • Demonstrated proficiency with BAS navigation, data-trend setting and extractions, trouble shooting. (3 years)
  • Medium to advance skills in word processing and spreadsheet data manipulation and analysis tools. (5 years)
  • Familiar with integration concepts and platforms such as BACnet systems. (1 year)
  • Operational experience in fault detection platform. (Asset)
  • Good knowledge of optimization and energy management strategy for BAS. (3 years)
  • Strong ability to adhere and to properly execute processes and practices relating to facility operations and maintenance. (3 years)
  • Strong client-service orientation along with a high sense of urgency. (3 years)
  • Effective communication skills for the purpose of data relay, exchange, feedback, and clarification. (3 years)
  • Mentoring skills required to support Junior BAS Operator development. (Asset)
  • On-call/standby and emergency call - outs as they arise. Occasional extended hours. (Must be available)
  • Programming, coding, on-site installation and/or maintenance of BAS. (Asset)
  • Bilingualism (Asset)
  • Valid drivers’ license (Asset)

Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation

  • None required.

This is a part-time, permanent position with a salary range of $25- $30 per hour. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.

Rate range: $100 - $500 per hour, based on experience and scope (three-tier band detailed below).

Location: Remote, with DC and agency travel as opportunities require.

A note from the founder

Federal sales is a long game built on the credibility of every conversation. The Federal Account Executive is the operator who carries our name into agency offices, prime contractor partnerships, and small business outreach events. Equal parts hunter and contracts literate. The seat is built for someone who wants to be paid for the relationships they own and the doors they open.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt.

Bench credentials: Former EEOC Administrative Law Judge, employment attorneys, clinical advisors, 32-year enterprise operations specialist.

What you own

  • Federal customer targeting across our priority verticals (HHS workforce, VA behavioral health, DoD behavioral health support, federal hospitality)
  • Account development: agency POC outreach, small business office relationships, prime contractor BD relationships, industry day attendance
  • Pipeline development feeding the Federal Capture Director with qualified opportunities
  • Federal contracts literacy: FAR/DFARS basics, SAM.gov management, set-aside qualification (8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, SDVOSB), small business certification lifecycle
  • Capability statement positioning and customer-tailored briefings
  • HubSpot CRM hygiene for the GovCon pipeline
  • Cross-coordination with the Capture Director on captured opportunities and the Proposal Manager on past performance inputs

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Foundational ($100-200/hr): Federal sales operators with 3-7 years agency or prime contractor BD experience
  • Senior ($200-350/hr): Established federal AEs with documented relationships at named agencies
  • Principal ($350-500/hr): Senior federal account principals with multi-agency portfolios and existing prime relationships

Engagement is hourly. Time commitment scales with active account development, typically 10-30 hours per week. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for awarded contracts where the engagement materially sourced the relationship.

Success milestones

  • Day 30: Target account list documented and approved. Capability statement positioning sharpened. Initial outreach cadence active.
  • Day 90: 10+ qualified agency or prime contractor conversations logged. 3+ teaming or partnership discussions advancing. Pipeline visibility documented in HubSpot.
  • Day 180: 2-4 captured opportunities handed off to the Capture Director. First responded RFP or RFI. First named agency relationship producing visible activity.

Who you are

  • 5-12 years in federal sales, agency BD, prime contractor account management, or government affairs
  • Documented relationships at one or more of: DoD (behavioral health, lodging, F&B), VA (mental health programs, workforce), HHS (workforce IDIQs), GSA, DHS
  • Working fluency in FAR/DFARS basics, set-aside qualification, and federal procurement vocabulary
  • Comfortable with SAM.gov, GSA Schedules, and small business certification mechanics
  • Strong outbound voice and the ability to convert cold outreach into recurring meetings
  • Comfortable working inside a founder-led firm building its federal motion from the ground up
  • Located in DC, NC, GA, or willing to travel to DC quarterly

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime, boutique federal sales shop, or agency BD team
  • Past role inside DoD, VA, HHS, GSA, or DHS as a contracting officer, technical representative, or program staff
  • APMP credential
  • Existing small business teaming network

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real federal opportunity or account development scenario we are actively considering
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties.

What to expect from us

As a Workforce Management (WFM) Manager, your primary responsibility is to ensure the efficient and effective management of accounts and its workforce. jobs.excerpt: Responsibilities1) ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB & Discovery Platform Administration• Administer Freshservice, Device42, or equivalent ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, and asset data platforms.
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

1) ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB & Discovery Platform Administration

  • Administer Freshservice, Device42, or equivalent ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, and asset data platforms.
  • Configure platforms from scratch or redesign existing configurations, including modules, asset types, software models, license types, CI classes, fields, forms, workflows, automation rules, notifications, dashboards, roles, permissions, and governance settings.
  • Set up and maintain discovery sources, scan ranges, schedules, credentials, collectors, agents, probes, API connections, synchronization jobs, software recognition rules, and reconciliation rules in accordance with security and change management requirements.
  • Configure request, approval, assignment, reclamation, retirement, and exception workflows for hardware assets, software assets, and CMDB updates.
  • Troubleshoot platform configuration, integration, discovery, synchronization, data import, software normalization, and data quality issues.
  • Maintain platform administration documentation, configuration standards, data dictionaries, CI class definitions, software model standards, license data standards, discovery runbooks, and operating procedures.

2) CMDB Architecture, Data Model & Governance

  • Design, configure, and maintain the CMDB structure, including CI classes, asset attributes, software and application records, lifecycle states, ownership fields, relationship types, business service mapping, and dependency structures.
  • Define and enforce CMDB standards for naming, classification, required fields, ownership, support groups, relationship mapping, lifecycle status, environment, criticality, and authoritative data sources.
  • Establish reconciliation processes between discovery tools, endpoint management systems, software inventory sources, procurement records, identity systems, ITSM records, ITAM repositories, and SAM records.
  • Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete, stale, orphaned, incorrectly classified, or conflicting asset, software, and CI records.
  • Ensure CMDB data supports incident, request, change, problem, security, audit, vulnerability, software compliance, and service management processes.
  • Maintain CMDB governance documentation, data ownership rules, exception-handling processes, and quality metrics.

3) Discovery & Application Dependency Mapping

  • Configure and maintain discovery capabilities for endpoints, servers, network devices, virtual infrastructure, cloud resources, databases, application components, and discovered software installations.
  • Set up or support ADM and service dependency mapping by enabling discovery methods, validating discovered relationships, and coordinating with application and infrastructure owners.
  • Coordinate discovery prerequisites such as service accounts, credentials, network access, firewall allowlisting, agents, probes, collectors, and access approvals with Infrastructure and Security teams.
  • Monitor discovery coverage, credential failures, scan errors, synchronization status, relationship completeness, software recognition gaps, and unmapped or unknown assets.
  • Continuously tune discovery settings, mapping rules, software normalization logic, reconciliation logic, and dependency rules to improve CMDB accuracy, ADM coverage, and SAM visibility.

4) Hardware Asset Lifecycle & Inventory Management

  • Oversee hardware and infrastructure asset lifecycle data from request, receiving, deployment, assignment, transfer, return, decommissioning, disposal, and retirement.
  • Ensure lifecycle updates are accurately reflected in ITAM, ITSM, CMDB, discovery, endpoint inventory, and reporting platforms.
  • Reconcile purchased, deployed, discovered, retired, and disposed hardware assets across procurement records, endpoint tools, discovery platforms, and ITSM/ITAM systems.
  • Maintain accurate inventory data including owner or custodian, location, serial number, model, status, environment, support group, business purpose, warranty or support status, and related CIs or services.
  • Coordinate inventory audits, physical verification, exception handling, discrepancy investigations, disposal evidence, and asset record cleanup.

5) Software Asset Management (SAM) & License Governance

  • Establish, administer, and maintain software asset records, software models, publishers, versions, editions, categories, license records, entitlement data, subscription records, renewal dates, approved software status, and software lifecycle status within ITAM, SAM, CMDB, and ITSM platforms.
  • Reconcile discovered software installations, SaaS usage, endpoint inventory, purchase records, subscriptions, entitlements, and approved software records to support license accuracy and compliance visibility.
  • Track software assignments, usage, ownership, business justification, license position, approval status, renewal risk, retirement status, and compliance status.
  • Identify unused, underused, duplicate, unauthorized, unsupported, end-of-life, or potentially non-compliant software and coordinate remediation, reclamation, renewal, or retirement actions with the appropriate owners.
  • Support software request, approval, assignment, deployment, reclamation, renewal, retirement, and decommissioning workflows in coordination with IT Support, Security, Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Application Owners.
  • Maintain software-related CIs and relationships in the CMDB, including links between applications, software products, users, devices, servers, business services, application owners, support groups, and dependency records.
  • Prepare dashboards and reports for software compliance, license utilization, renewal risk, unauthorized software, software lifecycle status, SaaS/application inventory, reclamation opportunities, and cost optimization opportunities.
  • Support software audits, true-ups, renewals, vendor reviews, and internal compliance reviews by providing accurate asset, entitlement, deployment, and usage data. Contract negotiation and legal interpretation remain owned by Procurement, Finance, and Legal.

6) Integrations, Automation & Reporting

  • Configure and maintain integrations between ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery platforms, endpoint management tools, procurement sources, identity systems, SaaS sources, and reporting tools.
  • Build workflows, automation rules, validation rules, notifications, exception reports, and data quality controls to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  • Create and maintain dashboards and reports for inventory health, lifecycle status, CMDB completeness, discovery coverage, ADM coverage, software compliance, license utilization, renewal exposure, aging assets, reconciliation exceptions, and audit readiness.
  • Analyze data quality metrics, discovery gaps, synchronization failures, software normalization issues, license gaps, and process issues to identify corrective actions and improvement opportunities.
  • Support automation, API, import/export, bulk update, and low-code workflow activities where appropriate and approved.

7) Stakeholder Coordination, Governance & Process Ownership

  • Serve as the primary administrator and subject matter expert for ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, and related ITSM configurations.
  • Partner with Infrastructure, Security, Service Desk, Procurement, Finance, Legal, Compliance, vendors, and application teams to align asset, software, license, CI, and service data with operational, audit, compliance, and business requirements.
  • Document and improve processes for asset intake, software intake, CI creation, discovery onboarding, license record maintenance, ownership validation, dependency mapping, lifecycle updates, reclamation, and decommissioning.
  • Provide guidance and training to IT teams on asset, software, license, CMDB, discovery, and platform update requirements.
  • Support audit, compliance, risk, security, and governance activities related to hardware assets, software assets, software licensing, CMDB reliability, discovery coverage, and administrative access controls.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3-5+ years of experience in ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB administration, IT operations, systems administration, infrastructure support, software asset management, or a related technical platform administration role.
  • Hands-on administration experience with ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, endpoint inventory, or asset data platforms such as Freshservice, Device42, SCCM/MECM, Intune, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience configuring asset models, software models, CI data models, fields, forms, workflows, automations, dashboards, relationships, discovery settings, synchronization rules, data imports, or system integrations.
  • Practical understanding of CMDB concepts, CI relationships, lifecycle states, service mapping, configuration management governance, and ITIL-aligned service management processes.
  • Experience with Software Asset Management processes such as software inventory, license tracking, entitlement management, software normalization, license reconciliation, usage reporting, reclamation, and compliance reporting.
  • Familiarity with common software licensing concepts such as named-user, device-based, subscription, SaaS, concurrent, enterprise agreement, server, core, processor, and usage-based licensing models.
  • Hands-on experience with discovery or inventory tools, including scan configuration, credential management, discovery troubleshooting, data normalization, software recognition, reconciliation, connector setup, or integration management.
  • Working knowledge of infrastructure environments such as Windows and Linux servers, endpoints, basic networking, virtualization, cloud resources, databases, application services, and endpoint management platforms.
  • Ability to analyze data quality issues, resolve discrepancies, and establish repeatable governance, reconciliation, exception-management, and audit-readiness processes.
  • Understanding of administrative access controls, change management, credential security, least-privilege access, and separation-of-duties expectations for ITSM, ITAM, SAM, CMDB, and discovery platforms.
  • Strong documentation, reporting, dashboarding, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with technical teams, non-technical stakeholders, vendors, auditors, procurement, finance, legal, security, and compliance partners.

Preferred

  • Direct administrator experience with Freshservice and/or Device42, including ITAM, SAM or software inventory, CMDB, discovery, integrations, dashboards, or ADM/service dependency mapping.
  • Experience implementing, rebuilding, or significantly improving ITAM, SAM, CMDB, discovery, or ITSM modules from scratch.
  • Experience with Application Dependency Mapping, service mapping, business service modeling, or infrastructure dependency validation.
  • Experience with software compliance audits, license true-ups, renewal support, vendor audit preparation, SaaS inventory, software rationalization, or cost optimization initiatives.
  • Experience with SAM or license management tools such as ServiceNow SAM, Device42 software inventory, Lansweeper, or equivalent platforms.
  • Familiarity with enterprise software licensing and administration data for platforms such as Microsoft 365, Adobe, Autodesk, Oracle, VMware/Broadcom, Atlassian, Salesforce, Zoom, or similar vendors.
  • Experience with API-based integrations, webhooks, data imports, automation scripts, SQL or reporting queries, PowerShell, Python, or low-code workflow automation.
  • Experience supporting IT audit, SOX or compliance requirements, ISO 27001, security operations, vulnerability management, change management, or software compliance use cases that rely on accurate asset, license, and CMDB data.
  • ITIL Foundation, ITIL 4 Specialist, Certified Hardware Asset Management Professional (CHAMP), Certified Software Asset Manager (CSAM), ServiceNow CIS, Freshservice certification, Device42 training or certification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with Power BI, advanced Excel reporting, Freshservice analytics, Device42 reporting, or similar reporting and analytics tools.

Job Description: ASP Program Manager

Fluke Health Solutions · Fluke Biomedical Division · Authorized Service Provider (ASP) Program

Reports to: Global Service Sales Leader · Department: Global Service Sales

Job Summary:

The ASP Program Manager owns the day-to-day health, growth, and performance governance of Fluke Health Solutions' global network of Authorized Service Providers (ASPs) — the third-party partners who deliver calibration, repair, and preventive maintenance service on Fluke Biomedical equipment outside of Fluke's direct service footprint.

This role is responsible for the full partner lifecycle: identifying and prioritizing new markets, qualifying and onboarding new ASPs, managing royalty and product-tier authorization structures, and running the ongoing quarterly/annual performance cadence that keeps the existing network reliable, compliant, and financially sound. The role blends program management, partner relationship management, and data-driven decision-making, and is measured on ASP network revenue growth, service quality/SLA compliance, and royalty revenue integrity.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the ASP performance assessment cadence (quarterly, annual, and trigger-based) as defined in the ASP Assessment Standard Work

  • Evaluate and prioritize new ASP markets using country-level revenue/opportunity modeling (install base, net incremental revenue, cannibalization risk)

  • Score and qualify new ASP candidates against the standard qualification scorecard and Phase 1 audit checklist

  • Manage royalty structure selection and reconciliation across the existing ASP portfolio

  • Own product tier authorization decisions (which service categories each ASP is certified to perform) and reassess at each quarterly review

  • Monitor SLA/turnaround-time performance and loaner pool health across all Tier 2/3 escalations

  • Maintain and report on the ASP KPI dashboard (service volume, revenue vs. plan, customer satisfaction, certification status)

  • Lead or coordinate process-improvement initiatives affecting the ASP network (e.g., contract renewal process, onboarding workflow)

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for escalated ASP or end-customer issues involving ASP-delivered service

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

  • 3-5+ years of experience in channel/partner management, service operations, or program management — medical device, biomedical, or technical equipment industry strongly preferred

  • Demonstrated experience managing partner performance against SLAs, KPIs, or contractual scorecards

  • Strong financial/analytical skills — comfortable building and interpreting revenue models, royalty structures, and ROI/breakeven analysis

  • Excellent relationship management and cross-cultural communication skills, given the global and multi-region nature of the ASP network

  • Proficiency with Excel/spreadsheet-based analysis tools; experience with CRM or partner management platforms a plus

Preferred:

  • Experience with biomedical test equipment, calibration standards (ISO 17025), or quality systems (ISO 9001/13485)

  • Experience running or participating in Kaizen / continuous-improvement events

  • Prior experience managing international distributor, dealer, or service-partner networks

  • Familiarity with royalty or licensing-based partner compensation models

  • Typing speed of over 30 words per minute (WPM).

Role Overview

The Cybersecurity Analyst is a hands-on operational role within the Cyber Operations team, responsible for frontline security monitoring, incident response support, exposure management validation, and compliance evidence. Working under the direction of the Director, Cyber Operations and senior engineers, the Analyst is the execution layer of KLDiscovery's security program monitoring what matters, responding when it counts, and keeping the team's operational processes running reliably. This is a remote opportunity with a clear growth path toward Sr. Cybersecurity Analyst.

Key Responsibilities

Security Monitoring & Alert Triage

  • Serve as first-line eyes on the environment validating and escalating CrowdStrike MDR-confirmed findings, reviewing MDR outputs, assessing context, and ensuring accurate internal escalation to the Engineers and Director
  • Monitor security alerts from tools operating outside MDR scope
    Triage alerts for AI tool misuse, anomalous AI-related activity, and other emerging threat patterns as directed by the Security Manager
  • Flag SIEM and identity health monitoring gaps, anomalies, and coverage issues to the engineering team — you are the first to notice when something looks wrong or missing

Incident Response Support

  • Serve as first-line support during security incidents like gathering evidence, documenting timelines, executing containment steps, and supporting the Security Manager through the full incident lifecycle
  • Conduct initial technical investigations to identify root cause of intrusions, anomalies, or policy violations
  • Maintain incident records, post-incident documentation, and lessons-learned notes to a standard that supports compliance evidence and future response improvement
  • Participate in on-call rotation to ensure coverage outside core business hours for escalated MDR findings or active incidents

Vulnerability & Exposure Management Support

  • Monitor the CrowdStrike Falcon Exposure Management dashboard tracking open findings, flagging severity changes, and keeping remediation status records current to support the engineer who owns the program
  • Follow up on patch deployment failures identifying affected systems and coordinating with IT on remediation timelines as directed by the engineering team
  • Support third-party penetration test logistics, internal scheduling communication, evidence gathering, and remediation ticket tracking under the direction of the engineer coordinating the engagement
  • Maintain accurate and current exposure tracking records so the engineering team always has clean data for prioritization decisions and compliance reporting

Compliance & Audit Support

  • Gather and maintain technical evidence for compliance frameworks and internal audits
  • Support internal audit and pre-assessment readiness reviews, organizing evidence packages and ensuring documentation is audit-ready at all times, not reconstructed at assessment time
  • Assist the GRC team with technical control evidence, gap tracking, and remediation documentation
  • Maintain documentation that supports annual security compliance attestations relevant to assigned business units

Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in a security operation, IT, or closely related technical role
  • Practical experience with security monitoring, alert triage, or incident response in a corporate environment
  • Familiarity with MDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon Complete or equivalent) is a strong plus
  • Working knowledge of common security tools or ticketing systems(Remedy or equivalent)

Technical Knowledge

  • Understanding of core security domains sufficient to execute assigned tasks independently: access management, encryption, network security, vulnerability management, and incident response
  • Basic familiarity with cloud security concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including IAM, logging, and posture monitoring
  • Foundational understanding of AppSec concepts is a meaningful differentiator: SAST/DAST tooling, secure SDLC, and pipeline security
  • Experience with AI security considerations (AI tool access governance, prompt injection awareness) is a plus

General Abilities

  • A strong sense of ownership, when you take on a task, it gets done; you follow through without being chased, flag blockers early, and close the loop reliably
  • Alert and attentive, you notice things others miss, take monitoring seriously, and understand that complacency in security operations has real consequences
  • Detail-oriented with high standards for accuracy and documentation, evidence, and escalation decisions require precision and you take that seriously
  • A strong communicator, able to summarize security findings clearly, escalate appropriately without overclaiming, and write incident notes that are useful to the people who read them
  • A collaborative team member, you work well within a team structure, take direction from senior staff, and contribute without needing to be the loudest voice in the room
  • Growth-oriented, you actively invest in your own development, stay current on the threat landscape, and approach each incident as a learning opportunity
  • Discreet and trusted, you handle sensitive incident data, client information, and security findings with appropriate confidentiality and professionalism

Education & Certifications

  • Formal education in Information Security, Computer Science, IT, or a related field is a plus but not required — we care more about what you can do than where you studied
  • Relevant certifications such as GSEC or CISSP are valued but not a prerequisite. If you don't have one yet, we'll support you in getting there

Headquartered in NC and Atlanta, Georgia, respectively. The next 24 months are about building and expanding a real book across the HR Advisory practice serving behavioral health and HHS clients.

About this role

TWF's HR Advisory division has product-market fit and a founding-cohort partnership pipeline. The closing motion has been founder-led until now. You're the first SDR. You'll build the outbound motion that refills the pipeline at the cadence the division needs to hit $1.2M Y1 ARR. If you're the right person, you become a partner in this division long-term.

The partner upside

  • TWF Earned Equity Ladder: Tier 2 (1-3% equity) eligible at month 6 against the 5-gate evaluation
  • Tier 3 (3-8% equity) progression by month 18 if you continue performing and take on strategic ownership
  • Tier 4 (8-15% equity, true partner level) by month 36 for the right person
  • HR Advisory engagements are bigger-ticket than Hospitality Staffing. Your commission share compounds faster per signed deal
  • The math: 8-15 signed engagements in Y1 at $40,000 to $80,000 average annualized retainer puts the division near its ARR target and puts you in Tier 2 equity range by month 6

The pay

  • Base: $0 first 90 days. Modest base ($1,500 to $2,500/month) introduced at month 4 once you've sourced 2-3 signed engagements and cash flow supports it
  • Commission: 10% of first-year contract value on every signed HR Advisory engagement you sourced
  • Bonus stack: $250 per qualified Discovery Call that converts to a proposal, $2,500 per signed HR Advisory engagement, $1,000 per completed Workup
  • Realistic Y1 total comp at target performance: $45,000 to $115,000
  • Equity: see "The partner upside" above

What this is and isn't

This is:

  • Employee-level-1 on the outbound side of a relationship-led, advisory-grade services practice
  • Founder-led with hands-on weekly support during ramp
  • Equity-bearing with a real path to partner-level ownership
  • Built around relationships and trust. We close clinical executives by sitting in their world, not pitching at them

This isn't:

  • A mature SDR org with a playbook, dashboards, and an SDR manager above you. You'll help build them

  • Iterate copy weekly. Document what works so the next SDR has a playbook

Why this role exists

TWF's HR Advisory division has the founder closing, the Director of Community Partnerships sourcing warm relationships, and the partnership pipeline showing strong proof-points. There is no dedicated outbound motion to fill the rest of the funnel. You're it. Without you, the division can't hit its $1.2M Y1 ARR target. With you, it becomes the firm's flagship practice.

  • Day 60: 8-12 HR Advisory Discovery Calls booked per month becoming routine
  • Day 90: 10% positive reply rate sustained, first 1-2 signed engagements or strong proposal pipeline
  • Day 180: Tier 2 equity grant landed if performance sustained
  • Day 365: SDR playbook documented, contribution to $1.2M Y1 ARR target traceable in HubSpot, Tier 3 equity progression on the table

Overview

Description

The Service Desk Analyst (SDA) will support MRO’s internal employee base and external customers with technical assistance, administration, configuration, and provisioning of hardware and software across our internal systems and healthcare products. The SDA is a “Tier 1” resource and is envisioned for a new or emerging professional with 1-5 years of existing experience and a broad interest in technology platforms. The SDA’s primary functions, detailed below, include handling a broad scope of end-user and customer support tickets, including intake of issues into our JIRA Service Management Platform, identity management functions, device troubleshooting, and support of our proprietary healthcare applications.

Responsibilities

Major Responsibilities:

  • End-User Support Ticketing: The SDA role will receive items submitted via our internal employees and external customers via our JIRA Service Management support portals and via telephone intake. Responsibilities include adequately identifying and classifying the issue (“ticket coding”), performing best steps to resolve using existing knowledge and/or documentation, and either resolving or escalating the issue to our “Tier 2” Support teams. Maintaining thorough, accurate, and timely ticket updates to reporters is essential.
  • User Management: The SDA will frequently utilize a suite of technology platforms related to user management functions, including AD Manager, Entra ID, and our suite of proprietary healthcare applications. Typical activities involve administrative requests to add, remove, or modify access. Some activities require additional approval from parties within and outside of the Support organization.
  • Troubleshooting and Remote Resolution: The SDA role is the first resolving party for the MRO technology organization and is a critical component to ensuring trouble tickets are closed promptly, accurately, and professionally for both internal employees and external customers. The SDA will utilize remote access tools to remotely connect and resolve issues reported or engage in direct phone calls or scheduled support sessions with issue reporters. While the primary goal is always to work to resolve an issue, the Service Desk is a fast-paced and high-volume team that requires individuals capable of differentiating between resolvable issues and those that would be better escalated. Excellent attention to detail and notetaking within the ticket is required to make the escalation process easier for both our internal team members and customers.
  • Onboarding and Offboarding: The SDA role is vital to our employee lifecycle activities and is the responsible entity for ensuring that new MRO team members are provisioned the proper user accounts and access prior to their start date and terminated team members’ accounts are terminated within our agreed timeframes to comply with internal and external regulations. The SDA role works with partners in Desktop Support and a third-party provisioning entity to facilitate the delivery of required hardware to new hires as well as a collection mechanism for retrieving hardware from terminated team members.

Principle Duties Developer enablement & secure coding support

  • Serve as the security architecture authority within the architecture organization, partnering with product architects, principal engineers, cloud partners (AWS, Azure, GCP), and business leaders to embed secure-by-design principles into hardware appliances, multi-tenant SaaS platforms, and globally distributed cloud infrastructure.
  • Coach and support developers in writing secure code, including secure patterns, common vulnerability classes, and secure use of frameworks and libraries.
  • Provide timely consulting on “how to do it right” (architecture, implementation details, and operational considerations) and help teams choose secure-by-default approaches.
  • Triage findings from SAST, SCA, DAST, container and IaC scanning; investigate, validate, and resolve false positives; and help teams prioritize true risk.
  • Partner with teams to tune security tools, reduce noise, and improve signal quality (rules, suppressions, baselines, and exception processes) while maintaining strong security posture.
  • Drive adoption of CNAPP, CWPP, WAF, service mesh security, API gateways, SIEM/SOAR, and cloud-native telemetry for protective monitoring, runtime defense, and incident-ready detection.

Secure by Design reviews

  • Conduct Secure by Design reviews for new applications and material changes to existing applications, validating security requirements and design decisions early.
  • Lead and facilitate threat modeling workshops; identify abuse cases, trust boundaries, and attack paths; and document mitigations and residual risk.
  • Review authentication/authorization design, data flows, secrets handling, logging/monitoring, and resiliency controls to ensure secure architectures.
  • Provide clear, actionable recommendations and track follow-through with engineering teams.
  • Translate regulatory and compliance requirements (FedRAMP, SOC2, ISO 27001, NIST SP 800-53, CSA CCM, SOX) into actionable, measurable, and auditable security architecture control objectives—shifting from audit-driven to architecture-driven alignment.

CI/CD and SDLC security

  • Advise on the security of CI/CD practices pipeline hardening, least privilege, artifact integrity, signing, provenance, and secure deployment patterns.
  • Advise on secure use of third-party dependencies and supply chain controls, including SCA governance and patch/vulnerability management workflows.
  • Collaborate with platform/tooling teams to integrate security controls into developer workflows with a focus on automation and self-service.

AI/ML security guidance

  • Provide security architecture guidance for AI/ML and GenAI-enabled applications, including model/data risk, prompt/agent design considerations, and safe integration patterns.
  • Help teams implement appropriate controls for data protection, access control, monitoring, and abuse prevention in AI/ML features.

Collaboration & communication

  • Act as a trusted partner to product, engineering, and leadership—translating security requirements into developer-friendly guidance.
  • Create and maintain secure coding guidance, reference architectures, and reusable patterns.
  • Support incident learnings by contributing to root cause analysis and preventative design improvements.

Engagement type: Independent consultant, 1099 hourly.
Rate range: $100 - $500 per hour, based on experience and scope (three-tier band detailed below).
Time commitment: Project-based, scales with proposal volume.
Location: Fully remote.
Reports to: GovCon Division Lead, with dotted line to the Federal Capture Director.

A note from the founder

A great proposal is the difference between a captured opportunity and an awarded contract. We have the capture motion ramping up. We need the operator who turns the captured opportunity into a compliant, compelling, on-time response, and who builds the response library so every future proposal moves faster than the last.

What is already built

The Wilkinson Firm is a workforce strategy and staffing firm headquartered across NC and Atlanta. We launched in April 2025 and are now in Year 2 of operations. Two operational divisions today (HR Advisory for the mental health industry, Premium Hospitality and Event Staffing). Government Contracting division being formally stood up this quarter. Three active staffing contracts in delivery. FY26 trajectory $425-525K. Zero loans, zero institutional debt.

Bench credentials: Former EEOC Administrative Law Judge, employment attorneys (JD, MBA), clinical advisors, 32-year enterprise operations specialist. 47 combined years HHS experience.

What you own

  • Full proposal lifecycle: kickoff, compliance matrix, schedule, color-team reviews (pink, red, gold), production, submission
  • Technical writing and editing across executive summary, technical approach, management approach, past performance, and resumes of key personnel
  • Compliance matrix ownership: every shall, every Section L and M requirement, every page count, every font and margin spec
  • Response library build: past performance citations, key personnel resumes, technical narratives, reusable management approach modules, pricing structures
  • Coordination with the Federal Capture Director on win themes, discriminators, and ghosting strategy
  • Coordination with subcontractor partners on teaming inputs and price submissions
  • Post-submission tracking, debrief capture, and lessons-learned documentation

Engagement structure

Hourly consulting rate, three tiers calibrated to experience and scope:

  • Writer ($100-175/hr): Proposal writers and coordinators with 3-7 years federal proposal experience
  • Manager ($175-325/hr): Proposal managers with documented win history and full-lifecycle ownership
  • Principal ($325-500/hr): Senior proposal directors with multi-million-dollar award history and Tier 1 prime experience

Engagement is hourly. Per-proposal scope and budget defined at proposal kickoff. Win-based bonus stack negotiable on top of hourly rate for proposals that result in awarded contracts.

Success milestones

  • First 60 days: Proposal process documented. Compliance matrix template built. Response library framework established with 5+ reusable past performance citations.
  • First 120 days: First 1-2 proposals submitted on time, compliant, and competitive. Color-team review cadence established.
  • First 180 days: 3-5 proposals submitted. First award or shortlist position. Response library covers 80% of TWF's standard content needs.

Who you are

  • 5-15 years in federal proposal management, technical writing, or capture support
  • Documented track record managing $1M+ federal proposals through full lifecycle to submission
  • Shipley-trained or equivalent. APMP credential preferred
  • Fluent in FAR/DFARS, RFP structure (Sections L and M), and compliance matrix methodology
  • Strong writing voice: clear, persuasive, and adaptable across technical and management content
  • Comfortable working both as lead writer and as orchestrator of subject matter expert input
  • Past performance citations in workforce services, HHS programs, hospitality contracting, or staffing IDIQs preferred
  • Located anywhere in the US

Bonus points

  • Prior role at a Tier 1 GovCon prime or boutique proposal shop
  • Experience with VA, HHS, DoD behavioral health, or federal hospitality contracts
  • Pricing strategy fluency (cost narrative, BOEs, indirect rate structures)
  • Experience standing up a proposal function inside an emerging GovCon firm

How we will get to know each other

  1. Initial 30-minute fit conversation with the GovCon Division Lead
  2. Working session: walk through a real proposal scenario we are actively considering or recently submitted
  3. Reference checks (3+ professional references) and work history verification
  4. Engagement letter, scope of work, and rate confirmation
  5. Kickoff within 7 days of signed engagement

What we believe

Trust before revenue. Mission before money. Real seats, real upside. We build durable federal relationships through earned credibility. We win together. We pay people in real numbers, not pizza parties.

Application tips

  1. Visit , ,
  2. Find The Wilkinson Firm on LinkedIn
  3. In your cover note, answer two questions: (1) what's the engagement shape that works best for you (project-based, retained hours, hybrid), and (2) one example of a federal proposal you would point to as your strongest reference work

What to expect from us

  • Reply within 48 hours
  • First-round conversation within 7 days of qualification
  • Full process: 2-4 weeks
  • We tell you yes or no. We do not ghost.

Monitors process, progress, and results with a focus on final resolution. Influences and navigates the organization to ensure completion.

SUMMARY:

We are seeking an experienced Strategic Sourcing Manager to lead sourcing, supplier management, and contract negotiations across technology and professional services categories for a temporary staffing and workforce solutions organization. This role will be responsible for developing sourcing strategies, optimizing supplier performance, negotiating favorable commercial terms, and driving cost savings while ensuring quality, compliance, and business continuity.

The ideal candidate combines strong procurement expertise with exceptional stakeholder management skills and experience managing complex supplier relationships in technology, consulting, professional services, and contingent workforce environments.

Location: Remote (West Coast candidates preferred)

ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Sourcing & Category Management

  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies for technology and professional services spend categories, including software, SaaS, IT services, consulting, managed services, telecommunications, and business services.
  • Conduct spend analysis, market research, and supplier assessments to identify sourcing opportunities and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Lead competitive sourcing events, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, and supplier evaluations.
  • Build category strategies that align with organizational goals, operational requirements, and growth objectives.

Supplier Relationship Management

  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with strategic suppliers and service providers.
  • Evaluate supplier performance through defined KPIs, scorecards, and business reviews.

Contract Negotiation & Management

  • Lead commercial negotiations for supplier agreements, statements of work, master service agreements, software licensing agreements, and professional services contracts.

  • Partner with legal, finance, IT, and business stakeholders throughout the contracting lifecycle.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Collaborate with department leaders to understand business requirements and sourcing needs.
  • Provide procurement guidance and recommendations to internal stakeholders.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and vendor selection decisions.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on sourcing best practices and supplier management strategies.

Cost Savings & Value Creation

  • Track sourcing project outcomes and report savings achievements.
  • Drive process improvements that increase procurement efficiency and supplier effectiveness.

EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Procurement, or related field.

CORE KNOWLEDGE and SKILLS:

  • Ability to effectively communicate and influence key stakeholders to support proposed strategies, process improvements and operational decisions.

  • Strong multi-tasker with ability to prioritize and adapt fast in an ever-changing environment
  • Effectively manage numerous projects at a given time in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to think creatively, work independently and as part of a team to solve problems given limited resources and time and, have a strong work ethic, and adhere to deadlines.
  • Solid organizational and project management skills
  • Results oriented
  • Ability to effectively interact and communicate with all levels of management to build partnerships with various departments and suppliers
  • Experience performing cost savings analysis using advanced Excel including V-look ups, pivot tables, and other related software applications
  • Experience with procurement, contract lifecycle management, or spend analytics systems (Oracle Fusion).

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

This position will not have any direct supervisory responsibilities.

Salary Range: $124,300 – $155,300 annually, depending on experience and geographic location plus eligibility for an annual bonus, subject to plan terms.

Please note that actual compensation offered may vary based on local pay requirements, and will meet or exceed state-specific minimum wage or salary thresholds.

jobs.description:
Overview

Flexible Worker Contract 

Location:Remote

About the role

We’re looking for Examiners to join our Assessment Delivery team on a flexible worker contract for the following qualification:

T Level Technical Qualification in Health (Occupational Specialism - Suporting the Midwifery Team)

As an Examiner, you’ll use your subject knowledge to mark external assessments and submit results throughout the summer 2027 marking window, helping to ensure learners receive fair, consistent and accurate results.

If you’re a Midwifery or Maternity Support teacher, lecturer, trainer or assessor, this is a great opportunity to put your expertise to use and make a valuable contribution to the assessment of learners.

Marking window dates are subject to change and will be communicated throughout the process should you be successful.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Following and maintaining the standard set by the Chief Examiner, applying the mark scheme consistently and accurately
  • Reporting suspected malpractice or safeguarding concerns to the Assessment Delivery team
  • Attending examiner standardisation and other meetings as required – standardisation events will be run remotely and scheduled for weekdays between the hours of 9.00am-5.00pm prior to the start of the marking window
  • Maintaining the confidentiality of NCFE assessment materials, learner evidence and learner details, and report any breaches to the Assessment Delivery team 

We'd love to hear from you if you offer the following:  

  • A relevant qualification at Level 3 or above in midwifery or a closely related subject area
  • Current or recent teaching experience at Level 3 or above in a midwifery related subject, or significant recent occupational experience within the sector
  • An understanding of effective quality assurance and assessment processes
  • The ability to work consistently within tight deadlines 
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills

Feeling inspired? Read the full Job Description to find out more.

Why work as a flexible worker for NCFE?

Our flexible workforce provides supportive quality assurance to ensure that learners taking NCFE qualifications are getting the best education possible. If you become a flexible worker with us, you’ll choose how to fit your work around your other personal and professional commitments – making this a great opportunity to make a difference in a way that suits you.

You’ll receive full training and the materials, tools or equipment needed to ensure you’re able to complete your duties in line with NCFE requirements, with the ability to take on flexible worker contract alongside other work, without the need to be registered as self-employed.

All applicants will be expected to adhere to NCFE’s behavioural framework and to uphold our core values.

You can find out more about how our flexible arrangements work, the flexible worker roles we recruit, and frequently asked questions around the application, induction and training process, and your rights and protections by visiting our Flexible worker opportunities page.  

Shape real change with an NCFE career 

Imagine a career where your contributions affect not only what people learn, but the way that learning is developed and delivered.

With over 170 years of education experience our core purpose remains at the heart of the organisation – to promote and advance learning to create a fairer, more inclusive society, making sure no learner is left behind.   

Want to know more? Take a look at our website 

How to apply 

Before applying, please note that we require all candidates to be able to demonstrate proof of Right to Work in the UK.

Ready to join us and shape real change? Apply with your CV and answer the associated application questions.  

Closing Date: Wednesday 2 December 2026

Interview Date: Ongoing

Interview Details: Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. If your application is shortlisted, we’ll contact you to complete a short task.

 Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) statement 

We're committed to building rich diversity into our workforce at all levels, to ensure that we understand and are representative of the communities and customers we serve.  

We do not discriminate against anyone due to their gender, sexuality, race, age, religion, beliefs, identity, social background, visible or hidden disability, or neurodiversity. Instead, we pride ourselves on our collaborative, vibrant and high-performance culture which embraces everyone, celebrates uniqueness, and enables everyone's voice to be heard.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

Provides subject matter expertise in the delivery, execution and maintenance of products. Accountable for maximizing the value of assigned technical products that support enterprise operations. Owns the product vision, backlog, and delivery outcomes and serves as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams.
Defines what is built and why, ensuring solutions align to business outcomes, regulatory requirements, and enterprise strategy, while partnering closely with engineering, architecture, data, QA, and operations teams on how solutions are delivered. Maintains ownership of products across the full lifecycle—from discovery and intake through implementation, stabilization, optimization, and eventual retirement.

Job Duties

  • Owns and communicates a clear product vision aligned to enterprise strategy and operational outcomes.
  • Maximizes product value by continuously prioritizing work based on business impact, regulatory requirements, risk, dependencies, and sustainability.
  • Acts as the single point of accountability for product decisions, tradeoffs, and acceptance of delivered work.
  • Serves as the primary escalation point for scope, priority, and requirement decisions.
  • Owns the end‑to‑end product lifecycle, including enhancements, defect prioritization, technical debt, and modernization efforts.
  • Creates, refines, and maintains a prioritized product backlog reflecting stakeholder needs and technical realities.
  • Writes and maintains high‑quality epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Leads backlog refinement and actively participates in Agile ceremonies (planning, reviews, retrospectives).
  • Accepts or rejects completed work based on defined acceptance criteria, quality standards, and regulatory alignment.
  • Partners with business stakeholders to understand problems, desired outcomes, constraints, and regulatory obligations.
  • Collaborates closely with engineering, architecture, data, QA, operations teams, and Health Plans to ensure solutions are feasible, scalable, and supportable.
  • Translates complex technical concepts into business‑understandable terms and business needs into actionable technical requirements.

About AMZ Advisers:

AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Working at AMZ Advisers allows you to apply your skills, expertise, and passions to directly impact the lives and business of other people and entrepreneurs. Our staff solves dynamic, quickly evolving problems with our Founders, in-house team, and network of partnered tech companies. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. This structure fosters knowledge sharing, mentorship, and continuous learning.

About the Role:

We’re seeking a driven and self-motivated problem solver with exceptionally strong communication skills and the ability to build long-lasting client relationships. We offer a fast-paced, challenging, and creative environment where you will be provided the opportunity to sharpen your analytical, communication, and strategic development skills. You will be offered resources and growth opportunities to learn more about online marketing to enhance your professional career.

The ideal candidate is an independent thinker who can confidently manage multiple Amazon Seller and Vendor Central accounts while leading client relationships with a high level of ownership and professionalism. As an Account Manager, this person will be responsible for building strong strategies, guiding clients through clear and proactive communication, and ensuring their portfolio is progressing toward the right goals. They should be comfortable working closely with their Brand Strategist and cross-functional pod members, while taking the lead on day-to-day account direction, strategic execution, and client success.

This is a fully remote position. If hired, you will join a company with an amazing and talented staff.

What You’ll Do:

General Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, gradually growing to approximately 10 accounts, while maintaining a high retention rate.

  • Build strong, long-term client relationships through clear, proactive, and confident communication.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring they feel informed, supported, and strategically guided at all times.

  • Set clear expectations with clients and manage those expectations throughout the lifecycle of the account.

  • Conduct regular strategy calls with clients to review performance, communicate progress, explain results, and align on upcoming priorities.

  • Build, track, and monitor KPIs for all accounts under personal portfolio management.

  • Conduct audits of client accounts and use data to identify opportunities, blockers, and areas for improvement.

  • Develop strategic growth plans tailored to each client’s goals, lifecycle stage, and account conditions.

  • Proactively identify and recommend strategies to improve account performance across sales, traffic, conversion, profitability, inventory, content, and advertising.

  • Report on account progress, key action items, and next-step priorities in a clear and organized way.

  • Plan, coordinate, and oversee promotions, launches, and marketplace initiatives in alignment with the broader account strategy.

  • Coordinate the resolution of account issues by working with internal teams and escalating through the appropriate channels when needed.

  • Use internal and external software tools to analyze account performance and support strategy development.

  • Work cross-functionally with Ads, Specialists, Content, Onboarding, and Strategists to ensure strategies are executed effectively and aligned to client goals.

  • Attend Account Management meetings, trainings, and ongoing development sessions on a weekly or bi-weekly basis.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise blockers, align on priorities, and maintain execution momentum.

Strategy Ownership

  • Conduct account audits and turn findings into clear, actionable strategies.

  • Build client strategies based on data, marketplace trends, account health, business goals, and realistic opportunity areas.

  • Understand how to prioritize focus SKUs based on performance, profitability, traffic potential, conversion, and growth opportunity.

  • Adjust strategies as needed based on data, seasonality, competitive changes, and evolving client objectives.

  • Ensure every recommendation has a clear reason behind it and can be explained confidently to the client.

Advertising & Amazon Knowledge

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of Amazon as a whole, including traffic, conversion, listing quality, profitability, inventory, account health, and category dynamics.

  • Understand Amazon advertising strategy well enough to contribute meaningfully to planning, decision-making, and client communication.

  • Be able to interpret ad performance, identify high-level opportunities or inefficiencies, and connect advertising decisions to the broader business strategy.

  • Work closely with the Ads team and Strategist to align ad direction with overall account goals, whether those goals are growth, profitability, ranking, launch velocity, or market share.

  • Communicate ad strategy and performance to clients in a way that is clear, accurate, and tied back to business outcomes.

Pod Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Brand Strategist within the pod to refine account strategy, validate recommendations, and escalate higher-level concerns when needed.

  • Collaborate with pod members regularly through meetings, brainstorming sessions, and strategy discussions.

  • Keep internal teams aligned by ensuring priorities, deadlines, and strategic direction are clearly communicated.

  • Support a collaborative pod environment where ideas, blockers, and opportunities are surfaced early.

Client Communication & Relationship Management

  • Lead proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients.

  • Build trust by not only reporting on what happened, but clearly explaining why it happened, what it means, and what should happen next.

  • Be able to handle difficult conversations, performance concerns, and conflicting client goals with confidence and professionalism.

  • Guide clients toward the right strategic decisions, even when those decisions require pushback or expectation resetting.

  • Ensure clients feel that their accounts are being actively managed, thoughtfully reviewed, and strategically guided.

  • Encourage client feedback and use it to strengthen the relationship and improve the service experience.

  • Help identify retention risks early and take action before they become larger client issues.

Check-ins, Accountability & Growth Opportunities

  • Regularly review account progress and raise issues, risks, or missed opportunities early.

  • Stay proactive in identifying upsell and expansion opportunities where appropriate.

  • Take ownership of account outcomes and maintain strong follow-through on action items.

  • Continuously look for ways to improve account performance, internal processes, and the client experience.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate - Percentage of retained clients from month to month.

  • Blocker/ Conflict Resolution Time - Monitor and decrease the time taken to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication - Assess the quality and frequency of client interactions for improved satisfactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness - Evaluate the success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

Qualifications:

  • BA in Marketing, Business Development, Management, or other related studies.

  • 2+ years with client account management.

  • 2+ years digital marketing or eCommerce experience.

  • 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller and or Vendor Central.

  • Ability to build and maintain client relations.

  • Active listening and the ability to understand client needs.

  • Proactive, go-getter mindset who functions well within a team setting but can work independently.

  • Strong ability to think outside the box, willingness to test new ideas, and develop and implement growth strategies.

  • Strong time management skills and the ability to multitask.

  • Ability and desire to learn new skills.

Technologies We Use:

  • G-Suite: Gmail, Google Drive, Google Meets, Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides

  • Microsoft: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

  • ClickUp

  • Nordpass

  • Slack

  • Sellerboard

  • Data Dive

  • Zoom

To Apply Please Include the Following:

  • Your CV/ Resume in English (ONLY English Resumes will be considered)

  • Two references who can attest to your competency in this line of work

  • Answers to the following questions:

    • Describe your experience with Amazon Seller or Vendor Central.

    • Do you have any experience leading a team?

    • Why are you interested in a new job/ this position?

    • Describe a situation in your career in which you were faced with a challenging problem and how you overcame it.

Position duration: ASAP – January 30, 2028

Coverage location: Jordan, Egypt, Lebanon, India, Philippines and Indonesia

Project Overview

Catholic Relief Services is implementing a global emergency response initiative designed to deliver timely, life‑saving humanitarian assistance in rapidly evolving crises worldwide. Over 18 months, the program enables fast, flexible action to address urgent needs arising from sudden shocks and protracted emergencies. It supports critical humanitarian sectors through context‑appropriate assistance while emphasizing operational readiness, locally led implementation, accountability to affected communities, and safe, dignified programming. Emergency Operations Technical Advisors will support Jordan, Egypt, Lebanon, India, Philippines and Indonesia, providing readiness and response support based on evolving needs, with the composition of countries adapted according to context and operational priorities. The initiative strengthens the organization’s ability to respond at speed and scale in complex and resource‑constrained environments, ensuring help reaches people most in need when it matters most.

Job Summary

The RAPID Humanitarian Operations Technical Advisor I provides deployable, technical and operational support to CRS humanitarian emergency responses under the guidance of HRD staff. The role contributes to CRS’ capacity, supporting target countries across a specified focus region, of emergency operations across core humanitarian functions, with primary emphasis on supply chain management—particularly procurement and logistics—and emergency sub￼office setup.

The Humanitarian Operations Technical Advisor I works closely with colleagues and other technical departments to support the establishment and strengthening operational functions, including human resources, finance, security, ICT, administration, and fleet management. S/he supports the application of CRS operational standards and donor requirements, contributes to operational learning and guidance implementation, and assists with capacity strengthening efforts for CRS country programs and partners to promote efficient, compliant, and effective humanitarian response operations.

Roles & Responsibilities

General

  • Provide rapid deployment, in￼country operational surge support during humanitarian emergencies, applying operational experience to support procurement, logistics, supply chain processes, and emergency sub￼office setup.
  • Support emergency operations planning, implementation, and close out through remote and onsite technical assistance, aligned with CRS standards, donor requirements, and good humanitarian practice.
  • Assist with the setup and functioning of relief delivery systems, tools, and operational processes in active emergency contexts.

  • Provide operational support across HR, finance, security, GKIM, administration, and fleet management, in coordination with relevant CRS technical and departmental leads.

Capacity Strengthening and Accompaniment

  • Provide on the job support and basic technical accompaniment to CRS staff and local partners during emergency responses.
  • Support delivery of operations focused trainings, briefings, and orientations for emergency staff and partners.

  • Contribute to collaboration with local organizations and national and international CRS teams to strengthen operational capacity for emergency response.

Technical Standards, Learning, and Compliance

  • Support the application of humanitarian operations standards, tools, and guidance for field operations and emergency supply chains.
  • Contribute to updates and dissemination of tools and resources related to the Emergency Field Operations Manual (EFOM).
  • Support operational learning by helping document lessons learned, challenges, and good practices from emergency deployments.
  • Assist with emergency budgeting, basic cost tracking and support compliance with public donor regulations and operational requirements.
  • Management of supply chain and accounting systems in new or rapidly evolving emergency responses.

  • Promote awareness of staff care, safety, and security practices in emergency environments.

Coordination and Representation Support

  • Support CRS participation in humanitarian coordination, cluster, and operations forums, as requested and under guidance.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Knowledge of emergency coordination mechanisms.
  • Working knowledge of humanitarian supply chain operations, including procurement, logistics, warehousing, and basic commodity tracking in emergency contexts.
  • Basic understanding of emergency field operations setup, including sub-office establishment, relief delivery processes, and operational coordination.
  • Familiarity with donor regulations and compliance requirements relevant to humanitarian operations.
  • Awareness of CRS operational standards, tools, and policies, including emergency operations guidance
  • Strong familiarity with SPHERE, Core Humanitarian Standards
  • Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills
  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and make decisions independently.
  • Extremely flexible and can cope with stressful situations in emergency environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide leadership in strategic planning initiatives
  • Ability to work both as a motivating member and a leader of a diverse team
  • Strong knowledge of effective management practices desired
  • Strong MS Office skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience setting up and managing humanitarian supply chains
  • Experience engaging partners and strengthening partnerships. Knowledge of CRS partnership strategy is a plus.
  • Familiarity with ICT/GIS an asset.
  • Familiarity with CRS programming principles preferred.

Required Languages: Proficiency (verbal and written) in English and Arabic required specifically for Middle East focused position.

ABOUT UNRAVEL CARBON

Unravel Carbon is an enterprise software that helps companies track and reduce their carbon emissions, focusing on Asia, based in Singapore.

It is the first AI-powered decarbonization platform in Asia that converts any company's accounting data into full supply chain carbon data in seconds, generates climate solutions automatically and auto-populates regulatory disclosure reports.

We aim to accelerate the participation of all companies, big and small, in the global fight against climate change. And we want to do it the 21st century way—autonomous, painless, and beautiful.

Unravel consists of a team of software engineers, data scientists, founders and climate experts with a passion to solve the world's most pressing issue—climate change. Collectively, our leadership team has launched and invested in multiple companies, and are now combining their experience and knowledge here at Unravel.

We are backed by some of the world's best funds and investors such as Y Combinator, Sequoia.

Unravel was founded in Q4/2021 with headquarters in Singapore.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role is dedicated to expanding Unravel Carbon's partner base in Japan; identifying, recruiting and formalising relationships with resellers, consultancies that can extend our commercial reach well beyond what is direct.

As Account Executive you will own the full partner lifecycle, from researching the landscape and approaching the right firms, Onboarding and enabling partners. You understand how indirect sales motion works, you know how to build trust, relationship at Partner level, and you are energized for creating a network of companies that sell on our behalf.

This is a strategic role with real ownership. You will shape Unravel Carbon's partner programme in Japan from the ground up, define the ideal partner profile and build the infrastructure onboarding process, joint business plans, enablement materials that makes the broader Japan commercial motion scale. You will report to the Japan Country Manager and contribute insights to Unravel Carbon's growth.

Prioritise and approach high-potential partner candidates aligned with Unravel Carbon's target customer profiles and verticals.Lead partnership pitches, commercial negotiations, and contract execution with prospective partner organizations.Maintain a partner pipeline with full visibility into Partner recruitment stages, onboarding, timeline and activation status.

​

ABOUT YOU

4+ years with experiences similar to being a quota carrying sales representative in an Enterprise Saas organisation or selling/consulting in the sustainability domain with a track record of excelling, bonus experience with the business development/partnerships.

Excited and motivated by a new challenge and see the potential for growth of Unravel Carbon in Japan

  • Proven track record of building and activating reseller or channel partner network from scratch
  • Deep understanding of how indirect sales motion works in the Japanese enterprise market.

​

  • Focused and driven - achieving your objectives is critical to you

​

A bachelor's degree (or a post-degree diploma) in business/economics, sustainability, with working experience in a related Sales / Business Development role.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

The opportunity to get in at the early stage of our market expansion and to shape what Unravel Carbon is for the Japanese market.

Overview

POSITION SUMMARY: The Portfolio Reporting & Analytics Analyst – EPMO is responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing enterprise portfolio reporting, analytics, dashboards, and executive-level communications that support organizational decision-making. This role serves as a key contributor within the Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO), providing visibility into portfolio performance, project health, strategic initiative progress, resource utilization, and organizational priorities. The Portfolio Reporting & Analytics Analyst – EPMO partners closely with business stakeholders, project teams, program leadership, information technology, finance, and executive leadership to collect, validate, analyze, and present portfolio data. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining Smartsheet reports and dashboards, Power BI reporting solutions, portfolio KPIs, governance reporting, and executive-level report-outs used in weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual business reviews. This role combines analytical expertise, data visualization, portfolio management knowledge, and executive communication skills to transform project and portfolio data into actionable insights that support organizational strategy and operational excellence.

The base pay estimate for this role is $66,900-$113,700 annually. The final offer will depend on the skills, experience, and qualifications of the selected candidate. This range is for base pay only and does not include bonuses or other compensation. This position is eligible for an annual bonus. Bonuses are not guaranteed and are awarded based on company and individual performance.

Job Highlights

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: (The ideal candidate must be able to complete all physical requirements of the job with or without a reasonable accommodation)

  • Develops, maintains, and enhances enterprise portfolio dashboards, reports, and analytics using Power BI, Smartsheet, Excel, and other reporting tools.

  • Develops reporting standards, data definitions, KPI frameworks, and portfolio metrics to ensure consistency across the organization.
