  • Supports demand management, capacity planning, resource planning, and portfolio prioritization activities through data analysis and reporting.
  • Develops and maintains Power BI datasets, dashboards, data models, calculated measures, and visualizations.
  • Partners with project managers, program managers, and business leaders to ensure reporting requirements are understood and delivered.
  • Monitors portfolio reporting accuracy and performs ongoing data quality assessments and corrective actions.
  • Develops executive-level presentations and report-outs using data visualization and storytelling techniques.
  • Supports EPMO governance processes by tracking and reporting project status, milestones, risks, issues, budgets, benefits realization, and strategic alignment.
  • Recommends and implements reporting process improvements, automation opportunities, and dashboard enhancements.
  • Maintains documentation for reporting processes, KPI definitions, dashboard specifications, and reporting procedures.

  • Supports audits and compliance activities related to project and portfolio reporting.
  • Participates in EPMO continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES (KSAs):

  • Bachelor's degree required; business analytics, information systems, data analytics, finance, business administration, or related field preferred.
  • 3-7 years of experience in portfolio reporting, business intelligence, data analytics, PMO operations, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated experience developing Power BI dashboards and executive reporting solutions required.
  • Experience working within a Project Management Office (PMO), Enterprise PMO (EPMO), Portfolio Management, or Program Management environment preferred.
  • Experience administering and reporting from the Smartsheet platform strongly preferred.
  • Experience with portfolio management, project management, governance reporting, and KPI development preferred.
  • Experience supporting executive leadership reporting and strategic decision-making preferred.
  • Healthcare IT experience strongly preferred.
  • Microsoft Power BI certification preferred but not required.
  • PMP, CAPM, PMI-PBA, or related certification is a plus, but not required.
  • Advanced knowledge of portfolio reporting, business intelligence, and data analytics principles.
  • Advanced experience with Microsoft Power BI, including dashboard development, data modeling, Power Query, and DAX.
  • Strong experience with Smartsheet reporting, dashboards, and portfolio management solutions.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends and translate data into actionable insights.
  • Ability to develop executive-level dashboards, scorecards, and visual presentations.
  • Understanding of project, program, and portfolio management principles and methodologies.
  • Knowledge of project management metrics, KPIs, governance reporting, and performance management frameworks.
  • Strong written, verbal, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to present complex information in a concise and meaningful manner to executive leadership.

Position Summary:

A Penske Virtual Diagnostic Assistant’s (VDA) primary function is to assist field service technicians in the proper execution of the diagnostic process on a variety of vehicle classes and makes. Guiding field technicians to troubleshoot vehicle diagnostic fault codes accurately and quickly, following required repair procedures, and updating engine parameters or calibrations are critical aspects of Penske’s business model. The VDA answers incoming calls from field technicians and provides remote diagnostic support with a high level of customer service. A VDA uses their own experience and training, the latest OE programs and documentation, and visual and audio communication links to coach our field associates through their troubleshooting challenges.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Working daily with Penske field locations / service associates to assist in resolving their vehicle diagnostic troubleshooting issues.
  • Reducing a locations “diagnostic time per repair”.
  • Bring to the attention of the Manager Diagnostics & e-Tools any repeated OEM software or diagnostic system issues.
  • Reduce PTL locations “diagnostic repair expense” and “Outside Repair” expense.
  • Supports field customers with phone and remote vehicle diagnostic expertise and assistance using various OEM diagnostic programs / OEM web-sites / manuals / internal case base knowledge database systems, etc.
  • Complete specific EM diagnostic software program training
  • Follow-up on previously completed diagnostic troubleshooting calls and complete “Customer Satisfaction Survey.
  • Update “Case Base Knowledge” database system.
  • Maneuver through various truck OEM diagnostic programs (fault –codes, component tests, calibration, reports, etc. to name a few).
  • Complete the diagnostic issue that was called in from start to finish by the field customer.
  • Complete “minor” diagnostic system repair / setting adjustments.
  • Receiving in-bound calls from the field customer and assist in their diagnosis using various OEM diagnostic software programs as they relate to fault-codes, diagnostic repairs and diagnostic system issues (minor).
  • Place out-bound calls and act a liaison for conference calls with various OEM call centers, PTL locations and other suppliers.
  • Enter call information supplied by the field customer and corrective actions taken concerning the diagnostic repair into Penske’s VDA Support Call Center case base knowledge database.
  • Make outbound calls to follow-up on previous in-bound call requests to confirm a locations OEM diagnostic program(s)/diagnostic system(s) are continuing to operate properly after a previous logged call and/or repair has occurred.
  • Act as a liaison between the Penske location field customer and OEM, Penske and / or Snap-On / Nexiq Technologies Support Call Center, as necessary, for additional troubleshooting assistance.
  • Demonstrate excellent phone skills to interact effectively with internal (field customers) and external customers.
  • Provide customer service, assuring that customers are satisfied with their experience which includes complete issue resolution.
  • Manage multiple diagnostic issue situations (more than one call at a time) remotely at the same time on a daily basis.
  • Resolve or escalate field customer service issues as they arise.
  • Perform various duties as assigned by the Manager-Diagnostics & e-Tools to support the efficient operation of the VDA Support Call Center.

Job Title: Senior Full Stack Engineer

Location: Remote

Reports to: Program Manager

FLSA Status: Exempt

Supervisory: No supervisory/management authority

Prepared Date: 10/2/2026

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.

Position Summary:

We are seeking a capable and mission-focused Senior Full Stack Engineer to support the deployment, configuration, integration, and ongoing operation of HUD’s data infrastructure, including Databricks, within HUD’s enterprise environment. This hands-on engineering role will work alongside cloud, data, security, and DevSecOps teams to establish secure and repeatable data, analytics, and AI/ML infrastructure to enable modern data engineering and governance. The ideal candidate combines practical Databricks deployment and operations experience with cloud engineering, automation, and troubleshooting skills and is comfortable learning and working across multiple technologies in a dynamic federal environment. As a senior member of the team, this individual will also work directly with HUD stakeholders, help guide technical approaches, and provide technical leadership to other engineers.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Senior Full Stack Engineer: $140,000 – $160,000

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

•Paid holidays

•Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support
  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:

Includes the following:

  • Deploy, configure, and support enterprise data platform workspaces and associated cloud infrastructure.
  • Configure compute, storage, identity, access controls, Unity Catalog, and related platform services.
  • Automate deployments and configuration using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), scripting, APIs, and CI/CD tools.
  • Integrate data platform with enterprise data sources, cloud services, security capabilities, and development tools.
  • Support data engineering workloads, ingestion pipelines, and Databricks-based applications.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve platform, integration, performance, and access issues.
  • Collaborate with data, cloud, cybersecurity, DevSecOps, and application teams to implement secure and reliable solutions.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, and operational guidance.
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No supervisory/management authority

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 10+ years of relevant cloud, data engineering, platform engineering, or DevOps experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks deployments and operations.
  • Experience working with AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD tools and practices.
  • Working knowledge of Python, SQL, and/or scripting languages.
  • Understanding of cloud networking, identity and access management, security, and data integration concepts.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaborative problem-solving skills.

•Must be a US Citizen.

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Remote but desire someone in the Greater Washington DC Metro area or Huntsville, AL to support on-site meetings with the client as needed.
  • Databricks or relevant cloud certification.
  • Experience with Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, and Databricks automation tools.
  • Experience with enterprise data pipelines, data governance, or modern lakehouse architectures.
  • Familiarity with federal cybersecurity requirements, including NIST, FedRAMP, or RMF.
  • Experience supporting federal government technology environments.

Work Environment:

Work is performed primarily in a climate-controlled environment.

Company Information:

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. Cherokee Nation Businesses Corp - CFED, part of Cherokee Federal, the federal contracting division of Cherokee Nation Businesses, is that team. We modernize aging systems, deliver care where it’s needed most, and keep missions supplied, staffed, and moving across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. For more than 60 federal clients, we take on the work others won’t, and deliver where it counts. If that’s the kind of work you’re looking for, you’ve found your team. Learn more at cherokee-federal.com.

#CherokeeFederal

Cherokee Federal is a military friendly employer. Veterans and active military transitioning to civilian status are encouraged to apply.

Legal Disclaimer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected veteran status, disability or any other status protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Many of our job openings require access to government buildings or military installations. Candidates must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

For applicants located in Colorado, New York, California, Washington, Illinois, Hawaii, Massachusetts, or other states with pay transparency requirements: the estimated annual salary range for this position is $140,000 – $160,000. Actual compensation varies based on qualifications, experience, and location.

As required by VEVRAA, we take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans. Protected veterans are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified individuals with disabilities or those with sincerely held religious beliefs. To request an accommodation in the application or interview process, please contact Human Resources at .

jobs.description:
Senior Full Stack Developer

Blurb.fm · Remote (Canada) · Full-Time

THE COMPANY

Who We Are

Blurb builds revenue-generating content products for the most influential media companies in the world. We scale content from what already exists — turning catalogs and brand assets into high performing formats for every major platform.

Our mission is simple: help media companies unlock growth through high volume, high impact content.

THE TEAM

How We Work

We are a nimble, execution obsessed team of engineers who thrive on solving real business problems with smart, scalable solutions. Engineering at Blurb is about building the backbone that powers performant content systems for our clients, not writing speculative code.

We are a small, high trust team. There is no handoff culture here. Every engineer scopes, architects, builds and ships. You will work closely with designers, product, and creative leads and you will own your work end to end.

We care about impact, not just implementation. We engineer with speed, stability and long term adaptability in mind.

THE ROLE

What You Will Do

As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a core contributor to the platform that makes content at scale possible. You will architect, build and maintain systems that handle high volume video and content workflows for major media clients.

This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role. You will not be managing or delegating, you will be doing. Priority is execution.

In your first 30–60 days

  • Work closely with the team to deeply understand our products, APIs, and infrastructure.

  • Get comfortable in the codebases by shipping bug fixes and small features.

  • Begin identifying areas of improvement in architecture, developer experience, or tooling.

Once you are fully ramped

  • Architect new products and features with stability, flexibility and performance in mind.

  • Own large scale efforts from technical scoping through to production delivery.

  • Lead the development of new tools and production pipelines.

  • Maintain and evolve infrastructure proactively, not just reactively.

  • Ensure quality of all deliverables. Set the bar, then hold it.

  • Contribute ideas that improve how we build and what we build.

This role is NOT right for you if

  • Your best work is coordinating and delegating rather than writing code.

  • You prefer a structured corporate environment with established processes and a full team around you.

  • You expect someone else to resolve ambiguity before you can move.

  • You rely on AI to produce code you do not fully understand or cannot defend.

This is a builder role. You will write code every single day.

﻿

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Hard Skills

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful back-end or full-stack ownership.

  • Strong, production-grade TypeScript (Node.js) — this is a core requirement, not a nice-to-have.

  • Solid Python skills, especially for data-heavy or ML-adjacent work.

  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Services (Firebase/Firestore, Cloud Functions, Cloud Run, Compute Engine).

  • Proven ability to own the full product lifecycle: architecture build delivery maintenance.

  • Experience designing and scaling systems for high-volume, performance-sensitive workloads.

  • Comfort working in a Linux environment; Bash/shell scripting is a regular part of the job.

How You Work

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You define requirements when they are unclear instead of waiting for them to be handed to you.

  • You are a self directed executor. You pick up tasks, figure them out and ship without needing to be unblocked at every step.

  • You are comfortable using AI as a productivity multiplier (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) while maintaining your own critical thinking, you architect and analyze code yourself, you do not outsource it.

  • You communicate clearly and proactively across any medium, async messages, docs, code reviews or live calls.

  • You are an advocate for documentation and organized codebases, but pragmatic about what actually gets read and used.

  • You are adaptable. Priorities shift in a startup, you shift with them without losing momentum.

  • You have genuine curiosity about the work: side projects, new tools, emerging patterns in your domain.

Bonus points

  • Experience with video processing, media pipelines, or content-at-scale infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with PyTorch or TensorFlow for ML adjacent tasks.

  • Experience with Next.js, Tailwind CSS, or modern React patterns.

  • Prior startup experience — especially as a hands on IC in a small team.

  • Passion for the music or media industry.

THE STACK

Technologies You Will Work With

  • TypeScript (Node.js)
  • Python
  • Google Cloud Services
  • Firebase / Firestore
  • Cloud Functions / Cloud Run
  • Compute Engine
  • Next.js
  • Tailwind CSS
  • PyTorch / TensorFlow
  • Linux
  • Bash / Shell Scripting
  • Adobe After Effects

LIFE AT BLURB

What to Expect

  • Fully remote. We are a distributed team and have been from the start. We have an office in Calgary where you can use.

  • High ownership, low bureaucracy. You will have real influence over how we build and what we build.

  • A small, senior team. No layers, your work ships directly to production and to clients.

  • Fast moving environment. We iterate quickly and expect the same from the people we hire.

We move quickly when we find someone great. If this sounds like the right environment for you, we'd love to hear from you.

Overview

Lead Data Engineer | Build the Future of Data at GATX

Remote (Chicago-area preferred)

Founded in 1898 and headquartered in Chicago, IL, GATX Corporation (NYSE: GATX) is an industry leader with 125+ years of success - success that is powered by our people. We are proud of our high-performance culture, hard-working and enthusiastic management team, and beautiful office space in the Willis Tower.

Now we are investing in the next evolution of our data, analytics, and artificial intelligence ecosystem. We are looking for a Lead Data Engineer who’s ready to do more than just build pipelines on Databricks and AWS. You will help shape enterprise analytics strategy, influence architecture, and partner directly with the business to drive smarter decisions.

Why This Role? This is a high-impact, highly visible role where you’ll:

  • Lead the design and implementation of a modern AWS + Databricks Lakehouse platform;
  • Partner across IT, analytics, and business teams to turn data into decisions;
  • Drive scalable, governed, high-performance data solutions; and
  • Influence how data powers analytics, reporting, and AI across the company

Responsibilities

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design and lead enterprise-grade pipelines, supporting both batch and streaming data processing;
  • Own the full ETL/ELT lifecycle, from design through production support;
  • Drive data engineering standards, best practices, and architecture across the data ecosystem;
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, high-performance data solutions;
  • Mentor a small team while remaining hands-on; and
  • Ensure data reliability, performance, governance, and cost optimization.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of IT experience, including deep expertise in data engineering
  • 4-6+ years of recent hands-on experience in designing, building, and scaling data pipelines;
  • Strong hands-on experience with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and AWS (S3, IAM, networking);
  • A passion for continued learning and an interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving data and analytics space;
  • Experience working in an Agile analytics environment where close collaboration with key stakeholders to address evolving requirements is the norm;
  • Expertise in SQL, Python, data modeling, and distributed processing;
  • Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, and modern data architecture (lakehouse, medallion, etc.); and
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into solutions that deliver business outcomes.

What Sets You Apart

  • You’re analytical, curious, and solutions-oriented;
  • You thrive in environments where you balance priorities and drive outcomes;
  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and can quickly learn the business; and
  • You build strong partnerships and bring a “get things done” mindset.

Why GATX

  • 125+ years of stability with a forward-looking, innovation mindset;
  • A high-performing, collaborative culture where your work matters;
  • Flexibility to work remote, with access to our iconic Willis Tower headquarters; and
  • Opportunities to grow and shape a modern enterprise data and AI platform.

Ready to lead and build something meaningful? Apply today.
